Next from the transcript is the Practical Problem-Solution Pattern Engine: turning the proposed common language of transferable solutions (PatternCard, PatternApplication, ApplicationEvidence, and compatibility-checked strategy composition) into a self-contained Rust prototype.
Like src/contact.rs, these two files drop into chat-world with no changes to existing crate files (requiring only pub mod patterns; in src/lib.rs when you want to run them). The prototype implements:
 * Explicit separation of PatternCard, PatternApplication, and ApplicationEvidence: A pattern is a signed conditional claim with its eight core sections (problem/goal, context, applicability, transformation, mechanism, tradeoffs/failures, provenance, and typed requires/provides/destroys interfaces); an application binds the pattern's abstract roles into a concrete domain while checking preconditions and exclusions; evidence attaches an observed verdict (Supported, Partial, Failed, Inapplicable) to a specific application hash.
 * Revision lineage without silent inheritance: Publishing a narrowed revision (derived_from: Some(parent_hash)) checks that the parent exists and version increments, while keeping earlier evidence anchored strictly to the revision that was actually tested.
 * Honest confidential-source reporting: SourceVisibility::ConfidentialUninspectable allows someone to publish a general lesson or failure report without exposing the underlying case, while forcing the ledger's EvidenceSummary to count it separately from publicly inspectable reports.
 * Compatibility-checked strategy composition (check_composition): Verifies a sequence of patterns step by step—checking that every step's requires are available, flagging when an earlier step's destroys wiped out a prerequisite needed downstream, and refusing any step whose exclusions are active.
src/patterns.rs
//! Practical Problem-Solution Pattern Engine.
//!
//! Separates reusable conditional claims (`PatternCard`), domain-specific
//! bindings (`PatternApplication`), and observed outcomes (`ApplicationEvidence`),
//! with deterministic compatibility checks for multi-pattern strategy composition.

use crate::did::{DidKey, Keypair};
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::hash::{body_for_signing, hash_of};
use crate::proof::{Proof, ProofOrArray};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PatternContext {
    pub roles: Vec<String>,
    pub constraints: Vec<String>,
    pub assumptions: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PatternTransformation {
    pub actions: Vec<String>,
    pub observations: Vec<String>,
    pub stop_conditions: Vec<String>,
}

/// Unsigned payload used to create a signed `PatternCard`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PatternDraft {
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub version: u64,
    pub derived_from: Option<String>,
    pub title: String,
    pub problem: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub context: PatternContext,
    pub requires: Vec<String>,
    pub provides: Vec<String>,
    pub destroys: Vec<String>,
    pub exclusions: Vec<String>,
    pub transformation: PatternTransformation,
    pub mechanism: String,
    pub costs: Vec<String>,
    pub known_failures: Vec<String>,
    pub sharing_terms: String,
    pub created_at: u64,
}

/// A signed, versioned, conditional problem-solution pattern.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PatternCard {
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub version: u64,
    pub derived_from: Option<String>,
    pub title: String,
    pub problem: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub context: PatternContext,
    pub requires: Vec<String>,
    pub provides: Vec<String>,
    pub destroys: Vec<String>,
    pub exclusions: Vec<String>,
    pub transformation: PatternTransformation,
    pub mechanism: String,
    pub costs: Vec<String>,
    pub known_failures: Vec<String>,
    pub sharing_terms: String,
    pub author: DidKey,
    pub created_at: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl PatternCard {
    pub fn sign(draft: PatternDraft, author_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        if draft.pattern_id.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("pattern_id cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        if draft.version == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy("pattern version must be >= 1".into()));
        }
        if draft.version == 1 && draft.derived_from.is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "version 1 pattern cannot declare derived_from".into(),
            ));
        }
        if draft.problem.trim().is_empty() || draft.goal.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("pattern problem and goal must be non-empty".into()));
        }
        if draft.transformation.actions.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "pattern transformation must specify at least one action".into(),
            ));
        }

        let mut card = PatternCard {
            pattern_id: draft.pattern_id,
            version: draft.version,
            derived_from: draft.derived_from,
            title: draft.title,
            problem: draft.problem,
            goal: draft.goal,
            context: draft.context,
            requires: draft.requires,
            provides: draft.provides,
            destroys: draft.destroys,
            exclusions: draft.exclusions,
            transformation: draft.transformation,
            mechanism: draft.mechanism,
            costs: draft.costs,
            known_failures: draft.known_failures,
            sharing_terms: draft.sharing_terms,
            author: author_kp.did(),
            created_at: draft.created_at,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&card)?;
        let sig = author_kp.sign(&body);
        card.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(author_kp, &sig));
        Ok(card)
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.pattern_id.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Verification("pattern: empty pattern_id".into()));
        }
        if self.version == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Verification("pattern: version must be >= 1".into()));
        }
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.author)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("pattern: missing author proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

/// Unsigned payload describing one concrete application of a `PatternCard`
/// in a receiving domain.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ApplicationDraft {
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub pattern_version: u64,
    pub pattern_hash: String,
    pub domain: String,
    pub setting_summary: String,
    /// Maps each abstract role declared in `PatternCard::context.roles`
    /// to a concrete role or entity in the receiving domain.
    pub role_mapping: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// Preconditions verified present in the receiving domain.
    pub present_conditions: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub applied_at: u64,
}

/// Signed record binding a specific `PatternCard` revision to a concrete domain.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PatternApplication {
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub pattern_version: u64,
    pub pattern_hash: String,
    pub domain: String,
    pub setting_summary: String,
    pub role_mapping: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub present_conditions: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub actor: DidKey,
    pub applied_at: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl PatternApplication {
    pub fn sign(draft: ApplicationDraft, actor_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        if draft.domain.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("application domain cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        let mut app = PatternApplication {
            pattern_id: draft.pattern_id,
            pattern_version: draft.pattern_version,
            pattern_hash: draft.pattern_hash,
            domain: draft.domain,
            setting_summary: draft.setting_summary,
            role_mapping: draft.role_mapping,
            present_conditions: draft.present_conditions,
            actor: actor_kp.did(),
            applied_at: draft.applied_at,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&app)?;
        let sig = actor_kp.sign(&body);
        app.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(actor_kp, &sig));
        Ok(app)
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.domain.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Verification("application: empty domain".into()));
        }
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.actor)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("application: missing actor proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }

    /// Check that this application legitimately maps the target `PatternCard`,
    /// satisfies every declared prerequisite, and triggers no exclusion.
    pub fn verify_against(&self, card: &PatternCard) -> Result<()> {
        self.verify()?;
        card.verify()?;

        let expected_hash = card.hash()?;
        if self.pattern_hash != expected_hash {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "application pattern_hash does not match card".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.pattern_id != card.pattern_id || self.pattern_version != card.version {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "application pattern_id or version does not match card".into(),
            ));
        }
        for role in &card.context.roles {
            match self.role_mapping.get(role) {
                Some(mapped) if !mapped.trim().is_empty() => {}
                _ => {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "application missing mapping for required role {:?}",
                        role
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
        for excl in &card.exclusions {
            if self.present_conditions.contains(excl) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "application triggers exclusion condition {:?}",
                    excl
                )));
            }
        }
        for req in &card.requires {
            if !self.present_conditions.contains(req) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "application missing required precondition {:?}",
                    req
                )));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum EvidenceVerdict {
    Supported,
    Partial,
    Failed,
    Inapplicable,
}

/// Explicitly separates inspectable public source cases from confidential
/// cases whose general lesson is shared without exposing the originating room.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "visibility", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SourceVisibility {
    Public { source_ref: String },
    ConfidentialUninspectable,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct EvidenceDraft {
    pub application_hash: String,
    pub verdict: EvidenceVerdict,
    pub observed_effects: Vec<String>,
    pub failure_or_limit_note: Option<String>,
    pub source_visibility: SourceVisibility,
    pub reported_at: u64,
}

/// Signed empirical report attached to one `PatternApplication`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ApplicationEvidence {
    pub application_hash: String,
    pub verdict: EvidenceVerdict,
    pub observed_effects: Vec<String>,
    pub failure_or_limit_note: Option<String>,
    pub source_visibility: SourceVisibility,
    pub reporter: DidKey,
    pub reported_at: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl ApplicationEvidence {
    pub fn sign(draft: EvidenceDraft, reporter_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        if draft.observed_effects.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "evidence must record at least one observed effect".into(),
            ));
        }
        if matches!(
            draft.verdict,
            EvidenceVerdict::Failed | EvidenceVerdict::Inapplicable
        ) && draft
            .failure_or_limit_note
            .as_deref()
            .unwrap_or("")
            .trim()
            .is_empty()
        {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "failed or inapplicable evidence must include a failure_or_limit_note".into(),
            ));
        }
        if let SourceVisibility::Public { ref source_ref } = draft.source_visibility {
            if source_ref.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "public source visibility requires a non-empty source_ref".into(),
                ));
            }
        }

        let mut ev = ApplicationEvidence {
            application_hash: draft.application_hash,
            verdict: draft.verdict,
            observed_effects: draft.observed_effects,
            failure_or_limit_note: draft.failure_or_limit_note,
            source_visibility: draft.source_visibility,
            reporter: reporter_kp.did(),
            reported_at: draft.reported_at,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&ev)?;
        let sig = reporter_kp.sign(&body);
        ev.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(reporter_kp, &sig));
        Ok(ev)
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.reporter)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("evidence: missing reporter proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }

    pub fn verify_against(&self, app: &PatternApplication) -> Result<()> {
        self.verify()?;
        app.verify()?;
        if self.application_hash != app.hash()? {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "evidence application_hash does not match application".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.reported_at < app.applied_at {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "evidence reported_at precedes application applied_at".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// STRATEGY COMPOSITION CHECKER
// =====================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CompositionStep {
    pub step_index: usize,
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub pattern_version: u64,
    pub active_after: BTreeSet<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CompositionTrace {
    pub steps: Vec<CompositionStep>,
    pub final_conditions: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub cumulative_costs: Vec<String>,
}

/// Checks whether an ordered sequence of `PatternCard`s can compose from
/// `initial_conditions`: verifies every card, enforces prerequisites,
/// detects conditions destroyed by earlier steps, and blocks triggered exclusions.
pub fn check_composition(
    initial_conditions: &BTreeSet<String>,
    steps: &[&PatternCard],
) -> Result<CompositionTrace> {
    if steps.is_empty() {
        return Err(Error::Policy("composition requires at least one pattern".into()));
    }

    let mut active: BTreeSet<String> = initial_conditions.clone();
    let mut destroyed_by: HashMap<String, (usize, String)> = HashMap::new();
    let mut trace_steps = Vec::with_capacity(steps.len());
    let mut cumulative_costs = Vec::new();

    for (idx, card) in steps.iter().enumerate() {
        card.verify()?;

        for excl in &card.exclusions {
            if active.contains(excl) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "composition step {idx} ({}): active condition {:?} triggers exclusion",
                    card.pattern_id, excl
                )));
            }
        }

        for req in &card.requires {
            if !active.contains(req) {
                if let Some((by_idx, by_id)) = destroyed_by.get(req) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "composition step {idx} ({}): prerequisite {:?} was destroyed by step {by_idx} ({by_id})",
                        card.pattern_id, req
                    )));
                }
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "composition step {idx} ({}): missing prerequisite {:?}",
                    card.pattern_id, req
                )));
            }
        }

        for d in &card.destroys {
            if active.remove(d) {
                destroyed_by.insert(d.clone(), (idx, card.pattern_id.clone()));
            }
        }
        for p in &card.provides {
            active.insert(p.clone());
            destroyed_by.remove(p);
        }
        cumulative_costs.extend(card.costs.iter().cloned());

        trace_steps.push(CompositionStep {
            step_index: idx,
            pattern_id: card.pattern_id.clone(),
            pattern_version: card.version,
            active_after: active.clone(),
        });
    }

    Ok(CompositionTrace {
        steps: trace_steps,
        final_conditions: active,
        cumulative_costs,
    })
}

// =====================================================================
// VERIFIABLE PATTERN LEDGER
// =====================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EvidenceSummary {
    pub pattern_id: String,
    pub version: u64,
    pub applications: usize,
    pub distinct_domains: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub supported: usize,
    pub partial: usize,
    pub failed: usize,
    pub inapplicable: usize,
    pub public_reports: usize,
    pub confidential_reports: usize,
    pub recorded_limits: Vec<String>,
}

/// Verified catalog linking patterns, their domain applications, and
/// observed evidence without collapsing failures into a single popularity score.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct PatternLedger {
    cards: HashMap<String, PatternCard>,
    applications: HashMap<String, PatternApplication>,
    evidence: HashMap<String, ApplicationEvidence>,
}

impl PatternLedger {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn register_card(&mut self, card: PatternCard) -> Result<String> {
        card.verify()?;
        if let Some(parent_hash) = &card.derived_from {
            let parent = self.cards.get(parent_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Policy("derived_from references unknown parent pattern hash".into())
            })?;
            if parent.pattern_id != card.pattern_id {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "derived pattern must preserve pattern_id of its parent".into(),
                ));
            }
            if card.version <= parent.version {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "derived pattern version must be strictly greater than parent version".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let h = card.hash()?;
        self.cards.insert(h.clone(), card);
        Ok(h)
    }

    pub fn register_application(&mut self, app: PatternApplication) -> Result<String> {
        let card = self.cards.get(&app.pattern_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
            Error::Policy("application references unknown pattern_hash".into())
        })?;
        app.verify_against(card)?;
        let h = app.hash()?;
        self.applications.insert(h.clone(), app);
        Ok(h)
    }

    pub fn register_evidence(&mut self, ev: ApplicationEvidence) -> Result<String> {
        let app = self.applications.get(&ev.application_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
            Error::Policy("evidence references unknown application_hash".into())
        })?;
        ev.verify_against(app)?;
        let h = ev.hash()?;
        self.evidence.insert(h.clone(), ev);
        Ok(h)
    }

    pub fn get_card(&self, hash: &str) -> Option<&PatternCard> {
        self.cards.get(hash)
    }

    /// Find all registered patterns that claim to provide a given capability or state.
    pub fn find_providing(&self, capability: &str) -> Vec<&PatternCard> {
        let mut out: Vec<&PatternCard> = self
            .cards
            .values()
            .filter(|c| c.provides.iter().any(|p| p == capability))
            .collect();
        out.sort_by(|a, b| {
            a.pattern_id
                .cmp(&b.pattern_id)
                .then_with(|| a.version.cmp(&b.version))
        });
        out
    }

    /// Compute an auditable summary for one exact `PatternCard` hash.
    /// Evidence on an earlier revision stays on that revision.
    pub fn evidence_summary(&self, card_hash: &str) -> Result<EvidenceSummary> {
        let card = self
            .cards
            .get(card_hash)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("pattern hash not found".into()))?;

        let mut app_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut distinct_domains = BTreeSet::new();
        for (ah, app) in &self.applications {
            if app.pattern_hash == card_hash {
                app_hashes.insert(ah.clone());
                distinct_domains.insert(app.domain.clone());
            }
        }

        let mut supported = 0;
        let mut partial = 0;
        let mut failed = 0;
        let mut inapplicable = 0;
        let mut public_reports = 0;
        let mut confidential_reports = 0;
        let mut recorded_limits = Vec::new();

        for ev in self.evidence.values() {
            if app_hashes.contains(&ev.application_hash) {
                match ev.verdict {
                    EvidenceVerdict::Supported => supported += 1,
                    EvidenceVerdict::Partial => partial += 1,
                    EvidenceVerdict::Failed => failed += 1,
                    EvidenceVerdict::Inapplicable => inapplicable += 1,
                }
                match ev.source_visibility {
                    SourceVisibility::Public { .. } => public_reports += 1,
                    SourceVisibility::ConfidentialUninspectable => confidential_reports += 1,
                }
                if let Some(note) = &ev.failure_or_limit_note {
                    recorded_limits.push(note.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        recorded_limits.sort();

        Ok(EvidenceSummary {
            pattern_id: card.pattern_id.clone(),
            version: card.version,
            applications: app_hashes.len(),
            distinct_domains,
            supported,
            partial,
            failed,
            inapplicable,
            public_reports,
            confidential_reports,
            recorded_limits,
        })
    }
}

tests/patterns.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::patterns::{
    check_composition, ApplicationDraft, ApplicationEvidence, EvidenceDraft, EvidenceVerdict,
    PatternApplication, PatternCard, PatternContext, PatternDraft, PatternLedger,
    PatternTransformation, SourceVisibility,
};
use chat_world::Keypair;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

fn make_probe_pattern(author: &Keypair) -> Result<PatternCard> {
    PatternCard::sign(
        PatternDraft {
            pattern_id: "pat/bounded-reversible-probe".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            title: "Bounded Reversible Probe".into(),
            problem: "A consequential choice depends on uncertainty that a smaller action could reduce.".into(),
            goal: "Reduce decision uncertainty before committing full resources.".into(),
            context: PatternContext {
                roles: vec!["prober".into(), "subject".into()],
                constraints: vec!["material effects must stay within reversible bounds".into()],
                assumptions: vec!["small-scale response is informative about target decision".into()],
            },
            requires: vec![
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
            ],
            provides: vec!["reduced_uncertainty".into()],
            destroys: vec!["untested_assumption".into()],
            exclusions: vec!["irreversible_disclosure_required".into()],
            transformation: PatternTransformation {
                actions: vec![
                    "define informative bounded trial".into(),
                    "run trial on disposable copy or limited audience".into(),
                ],
                observations: vec!["compare observed effect against prediction".into()],
                stop_conditions: vec!["uncertainty resolved or trial budget exhausted".into()],
            },
            mechanism: "A smaller commitment reveals failure modes at lower cost than full execution.".into(),
            costs: vec!["trial_time".into()],
            known_failures: vec!["trial is unrepresentative of full scale".into()],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            created_at: 100,
        },
        author,
    )
}

fn make_separate_states_pattern(author: &Keypair) -> Result<PatternCard> {
    PatternCard::sign(
        PatternDraft {
            pattern_id: "pat/separate-independent-states".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            title: "Separate Independent States".into(),
            problem: "Two coupled lifecycles prevent changing one without disrupting the other.".into(),
            goal: "Allow independent transitions while declaring explicit dependencies.".into(),
            context: PatternContext {
                roles: vec!["designer".into()],
                constraints: vec!["dependencies between lifecycles remain auditable".into()],
                assumptions: vec!["the two concerns can validly vary independently".into()],
            },
            requires: vec!["reduced_uncertainty".into()],
            provides: vec!["decoupled_lifecycles".into()],
            destroys: vec![],
            exclusions: vec!["strictly_atomic_invariants_only".into()],
            transformation: PatternTransformation {
                actions: vec![
                    "split state container into separate records".into(),
                    "declare explicit cross-lifecycle guards".into(),
                ],
                observations: vec!["verify independent transitions leave sibling state intact".into()],
                stop_conditions: vec!["all target transitions verified independently".into()],
            },
            mechanism: "Explicit state boundaries eliminate accidental coupling during change.".into(),
            costs: vec!["extra_boundary_checks".into()],
            known_failures: vec!["stale permissions if genuine coupling is omitted".into()],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            created_at: 105,
        },
        author,
    )
}

fn make_divide_reconcile_pattern(author: &Keypair) -> Result<PatternCard> {
    PatternCard::sign(
        PatternDraft {
            pattern_id: "pat/divide-then-reconcile".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            title: "Divide Work, Then Reconcile".into(),
            problem: "Independent subquestions are unnecessarily serialized.".into(),
            goal: "Explore separable branches in parallel and synthesize without erasing dissent.".into(),
            context: PatternContext {
                roles: vec!["coordinator".into(), "branch_contributors".into()],
                constraints: vec!["shared baseline frozen before branching".into()],
                assumptions: vec!["subquestions are separable over the branch interval".into()],
            },
            requires: vec!["shared_baseline".into()],
            provides: vec![
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
            ],
            destroys: vec![],
            exclusions: vec!["tightly_coupled_live_state".into()],
            transformation: PatternTransformation {
                actions: vec![
                    "freeze baseline and assign separable branches".into(),
                    "compare results and publish attributable synthesis".into(),
                ],
                observations: vec!["record agreements, conflicts, and open remainders".into()],
                stop_conditions: vec!["synthesis reviewed or branches closed".into()],
            },
            mechanism: "Parallel independent work preserves diverse formulations before convergence.".into(),
            costs: vec!["reconciliation_effort".into()],
            known_failures: vec!["drifting assumptions across long branches".into()],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            created_at: 90,
        },
        author,
    )
}

#[test]
fn pattern_transfers_across_domains_and_accumulates_auditable_evidence() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let carol = Keypair::generate();
    let mut ledger = PatternLedger::new();

    let probe = make_probe_pattern(&alice)?;
    let probe_hash = ledger.register_card(probe.clone())?;

    // Application 1: Writing domain (Bob)
    let mut write_roles = BTreeMap::new();
    write_roles.insert("prober".into(), "author".into());
    write_roles.insert("subject".into(), "first_reader".into());
    let app_writing = PatternApplication::sign(
        ApplicationDraft {
            pattern_id: probe.pattern_id.clone(),
            pattern_version: probe.version,
            pattern_hash: probe_hash.clone(),
            domain: "writing".into(),
            setting_summary: "Test revised introduction on one reader before full rewrite.".into(),
            role_mapping: write_roles,
            present_conditions: BTreeSet::from([
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
            ]),
            applied_at: 200,
        },
        &bob,
    )?;
    let app_writing_hash = ledger.register_application(app_writing)?;

    // Application 2: Software domain (Carol)
    let mut sw_roles = BTreeMap::new();
    sw_roles.insert("prober".into(), "maintainer".into());
    sw_roles.insert("subject".into(), "throwaway_branch".into());
    let app_sw = PatternApplication::sign(
        ApplicationDraft {
            pattern_id: probe.pattern_id.clone(),
            pattern_version: probe.version,
            pattern_hash: probe_hash.clone(),
            domain: "software".into(),
            setting_summary: "Run schema migration on disposable copy with sample corpus.".into(),
            role_mapping: sw_roles,
            present_conditions: BTreeSet::from([
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
            ]),
            applied_at: 210,
        },
        &carol,
    )?;
    let app_sw_hash = ledger.register_application(app_sw)?;

    // Evidence 1: Writing trial succeeded partially
    let ev1 = ApplicationEvidence::sign(
        EvidenceDraft {
            application_hash: app_writing_hash,
            verdict: EvidenceVerdict::Partial,
            observed_effects: vec!["reader caught ambiguous term before full rewrite".into()],
            failure_or_limit_note: Some("single reader did not test expert audience".into()),
            source_visibility: SourceVisibility::Public {
                source_ref: "commons/room-editorial/seq-42".into(),
            },
            reported_at: 220,
        },
        &bob,
    )?;
    ledger.register_evidence(ev1)?;

    // Evidence 2: Software trial supported, from a confidential uninspectable source
    let ev2 = ApplicationEvidence::sign(
        EvidenceDraft {
            application_hash: app_sw_hash,
            verdict: EvidenceVerdict::Supported,
            observed_effects: vec!["disposable migration caught duplicate key edge case".into()],
            failure_or_limit_note: None,
            source_visibility: SourceVisibility::ConfidentialUninspectable,
            reported_at: 230,
        },
        &carol,
    )?;
    ledger.register_evidence(ev2)?;

    let summary = ledger.evidence_summary(&probe_hash)?;
    assert_eq!(summary.applications, 2);
    assert_eq!(
        summary.distinct_domains,
        BTreeSet::from(["software".to_string(), "writing".to_string()])
    );
    assert_eq!(summary.supported, 1);
    assert_eq!(summary.partial, 1);
    assert_eq!(summary.failed, 0);
    assert_eq!(summary.public_reports, 1);
    assert_eq!(summary.confidential_reports, 1);
    assert_eq!(ledger.find_providing("reduced_uncertainty").len(), 1);

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn failed_application_leads_to_narrowed_revision_without_migrating_old_evidence() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let mut ledger = PatternLedger::new();

    let v1 = make_probe_pattern(&alice)?;
    let v1_hash = ledger.register_card(v1.clone())?;

    // Exclusion check: trying to apply v1 where irreversible disclosure is required -> refused.
    let mut bad_roles = BTreeMap::new();
    bad_roles.insert("prober".into(), "alice".into());
    bad_roles.insert("subject".into(), "public_board".into());
    let excluded_app = PatternApplication::sign(
        ApplicationDraft {
            pattern_id: v1.pattern_id.clone(),
            pattern_version: 1,
            pattern_hash: v1_hash.clone(),
            domain: "governance".into(),
            setting_summary: "Publish private draft publicly as a test.".into(),
            role_mapping: bad_roles.clone(),
            present_conditions: BTreeSet::from([
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
                "irreversible_disclosure_required".into(),
            ]),
            applied_at: 300,
        },
        &bob,
    )?;
    assert!(ledger.register_application(excluded_app).is_err());

    // Valid application that fails empirically because trial scale was unrepresentative.
    let app = PatternApplication::sign(
        ApplicationDraft {
            pattern_id: v1.pattern_id.clone(),
            pattern_version: 1,
            pattern_hash: v1_hash.clone(),
            domain: "networking".into(),
            setting_summary: "Test gossip sync on 2 local nodes.".into(),
            role_mapping: bad_roles,
            present_conditions: BTreeSet::from([
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
            ]),
            applied_at: 310,
        },
        &bob,
    )?;
    let app_hash = ledger.register_application(app)?;

    let fail_ev = ApplicationEvidence::sign(
        EvidenceDraft {
            application_hash: app_hash,
            verdict: EvidenceVerdict::Failed,
            observed_effects: vec!["2-node test passed but 50-node mesh saturated".into()],
            failure_or_limit_note: Some("scale-dependent bottleneck invisible in tiny trial".into()),
            source_visibility: SourceVisibility::Public {
                source_ref: "commons/room-net/seq-18".into(),
            },
            reported_at: 320,
        },
        &bob,
    )?;
    ledger.register_evidence(fail_ev)?;

    // Publish narrowed version 2 derived from v1 requiring representative scale.
    let v2 = PatternCard::sign(
        PatternDraft {
            pattern_id: v1.pattern_id.clone(),
            version: 2,
            derived_from: Some(v1_hash.clone()),
            title: "Bounded Reversible Probe (Scale-Checked)".into(),
            problem: v1.problem.clone(),
            goal: v1.goal.clone(),
            context: v1.context.clone(),
            requires: vec![
                "identified_uncertainty".into(),
                "reversible_trial_scope".into(),
                "representative_failure_mode".into(),
            ],
            provides: v1.provides.clone(),
            destroys: v1.destroys.clone(),
            exclusions: v1.exclusions.clone(),
            transformation: v1.transformation.clone(),
            mechanism: v1.mechanism.clone(),
            costs: v1.costs.clone(),
            known_failures: vec![
                "trial is unrepresentative of full scale".into(),
                "scale-dependent bottlenecks may not trigger below threshold".into(),
            ],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            created_at: 350,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    let v2_hash = ledger.register_card(v2)?;

    // v1 keeps its failure evidence; v2 starts fresh with 0 applications.
    let s1 = ledger.evidence_summary(&v1_hash)?;
    let s2 = ledger.evidence_summary(&v2_hash)?;
    assert_eq!(s1.failed, 1);
    assert_eq!(s1.recorded_limits.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(s2.applications, 0);
    assert_eq!(s2.failed, 0);

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn strategy_composition_validates_prerequisites_destroyed_conditions_and_exclusions() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let divide = make_divide_reconcile_pattern(&alice)?;
    let probe = make_probe_pattern(&alice)?;
    let separate = make_separate_states_pattern(&alice)?;

    // 1. Valid 3-step strategy: divide -> probe -> separate
    let initial = BTreeSet::from(["shared_baseline".to_string(), "untested_assumption".to_string()]);
    let trace = check_composition(&initial, &[&divide, &probe, &separate])?;
    assert_eq!(trace.steps.len(), 3);
    assert!(trace.final_conditions.contains("decoupled_lifecycles"));
    assert!(!trace.final_conditions.contains("untested_assumption"));
    assert_eq!(trace.cumulative_costs.len(), 3);

    // 2. Missing prerequisite: starting at `separate` without `reduced_uncertainty` -> refused.
    assert!(check_composition(&initial, &[&separate]).is_err());

    // 3. Destroyed prerequisite: a step that depends on `untested_assumption` after `probe`
    // destroyed it -> refused with explicit error.
    let needs_untested = PatternCard::sign(
        PatternDraft {
            pattern_id: "pat/needs-untested".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            title: "Needs Untested Assumption".into(),
            problem: "Test step".into(),
            goal: "Verify destroyed-condition check".into(),
            context: PatternContext {
                roles: vec!["actor".into()],
                constraints: vec![],
                assumptions: vec![],
            },
            requires: vec!["untested_assumption".into()],
            provides: vec!["done".into()],
            destroys: vec![],
            exclusions: vec![],
            transformation: PatternTransformation {
                actions: vec!["act".into()],
                observations: vec![],
                stop_conditions: vec![],
            },
            mechanism: "test".into(),
            costs: vec![],
            known_failures: vec![],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            created_at: 110,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    let err = check_composition(&initial, &[&divide, &probe, &needs_untested]).unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.to_string().contains("destroyed"));

    // 4. Triggered exclusion: initial condition contains `tightly_coupled_live_state` -> refused.
    let coupled_start = BTreeSet::from([
        "shared_baseline".to_string(),
        "tightly_coupled_live_state".to_string(),
    ]);
    assert!(check_composition(&coupled_start, &[&divide]).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn tampered_pattern_and_unknown_json_fields_are_refused() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let mut card = make_probe_pattern(&alice)?;
    card.verify()?;

    // Mutating mechanism after signing invalidates the proof.
    card.mechanism = "altered mechanism".into();
    assert!(card.verify().is_err());

    // Injecting an unknown JSON field into PatternCard is refused by deny_unknown_fields.
    let honest = make_probe_pattern(&alice)?;
    let mut val = serde_json::to_value(&honest).unwrap();
    val["endorsement_score"] = serde_json::json!(999);
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<PatternCard>(val).is_err());

    Ok(())
}
