/// Shared Library holding immutable editions, byte blobs, shelves, and
/// annotations. All lookup, search, and download methods take `&self` so
/// reading leaves zero persistent history.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct SharedLibrary {
    editions: HashMap<String, Edition>,
    preferred_edition: HashMap<String, String>,
    work_author: HashMap<String, DidKey>,
    blobs: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    shelves: HashMap<String, Shelf>,
    annotations: HashMap<String, Annotation>,
}

impl SharedLibrary {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Publish a verified edition alongside all of its declared file blobs.
    pub fn publish_edition(
        &mut self,
        edition: Edition,
        files: Vec<(String, Vec<u8>)>,
    ) -> Result<String> {
        edition.verify()?;

        if let Some(parent_hash) = &edition.derived_from {
            let parent = self.editions.get(parent_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Policy("derived_from references unknown parent edition".into())
            })?;
            if parent.work_id != edition.work_id {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "derived edition must preserve parent work_id".into(),
                ));
            }
            if edition.version <= parent.version {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "derived edition version must exceed parent version".into(),
                ));
            }
        }

        if let Some(existing_author) = self.work_author.get(&edition.work_id) {
            if edition
                .vetting_labels
                .contains(&VettingLabel::AuthorDesignatedEdition)
                && existing_author != &edition.author
            {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "only the original work author may publish an AuthorDesignatedEdition".into(),
                ));
            }
        }

        for ann_hash in &edition.addresses_annotations {
            if !self.annotations.contains_key(ann_hash) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "addresses_annotations references unknown annotation".into(),
                ));
            }
        }

        let mut supplied: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
        for (claimed_sha, bytes) in files {
            let actual_sha = sha256_hex(&bytes);
            if actual_sha != claimed_sha {
                return Err(Error::Verification(
                    "supplied file bytes do not match claimed sha256".into(),
                ));
            }
            supplied.insert(claimed_sha, bytes);
        }

        for rep in &edition.representations {
            let bytes = supplied
                .get(&rep.sha256)
                .or_else(|| self.blobs.get(&rep.sha256))
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Policy(format!(
                        "missing file bytes for representation {}",
                        rep.filename
                    ))
                })?;
            if bytes.len() as u64 != rep.byte_len {
                return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                    "byte_len mismatch for {}: declared {}, actual {}",
                    rep.filename,
                    rep.byte_len,
                    bytes.len()
                )));
            }
        }

        let ed_hash = edition.hash()?;
        let is_designated = edition
            .vetting_labels
            .contains(&VettingLabel::AuthorDesignatedEdition);
        let work_id = edition.work_id.clone();
        let author = edition.author.clone();

        for (sha, bytes) in supplied {
            self.blobs.entry(sha).or_insert(bytes);
        }
        self.editions.insert(ed_hash.clone(), edition);
        self.work_author.entry(work_id.clone()).or_insert(author);
        if is_designated || !self.preferred_edition.contains_key(&work_id) {
            self.preferred_edition.insert(work_id, ed_hash.clone());
        }

        Ok(ed_hash)
    }

    pub fn publish_shelf(&mut self, shelf: Shelf) -> Result<String> {
        shelf.verify()?;
        for entry in &shelf.entries {
            let ed = self.editions.get(&entry.edition_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Policy("shelf references unknown edition_hash".into())
            })?;
            if shelf.public && !ed.access.is_discoverable_publicly() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "public shelf cannot reference a hidden private edition".into(),
                ));
            }
            if !shelf.public && !ed.access.can_discover(&ed.author, Some(&shelf.curator)) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "curator does not have access to reference this private edition".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let h = shelf.hash()?;
        self.shelves.insert(h.clone(), shelf);
        Ok(h)
    }

    pub fn publish_annotation(&mut self, ann: Annotation) -> Result<String> {
        ann.verify()?;
        let ed = self.editions.get(&ann.edition_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
            Error::Policy("annotation references unknown edition_hash".into())
        })?;
        if ann.public && !ed.access.is_discoverable_publicly() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "public annotation cannot attach to a hidden private edition".into(),
            ));
        }
        if !ann.public && !ed.access.can_discover(&ed.author, Some(&ann.author)) {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "annotator does not have access to this private edition".into(),
            ));
        }

        match &ann.kind {
            AnnotationKind::AuthorResponse { in_reply_to } => {
                if ann.author != ed.author {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(
                        "only the edition's author may publish an AuthorResponse".into(),
                    ));
                }
                let parent = self.annotations.get(in_reply_to).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Policy("AuthorResponse references unknown annotation".into())
                })?;
                if parent.edition_hash != ann.edition_hash {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(
                        "AuthorResponse must target an annotation on the same edition".into(),
                    ));
                }
            }
            AnnotationKind::ComparativeNote { other_edition_hash } => {
                let other = self.editions.get(other_edition_hash).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Policy(
                        "ComparativeNote references unknown other_edition_hash".into(),
                    )
                })?;
                if ann.public && !other.access.is_discoverable_publicly() {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(
                        "public ComparativeNote cannot reference a hidden private edition".into(),
                    ));
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }

        let h = ann.hash()?;
        self.annotations.insert(h.clone(), ann);
        Ok(h)
    }

    // ---- Read-only, zero-history query interface (`&self` only) ----

    pub fn preferred_edition(&self, work_id: &str) -> Option<(&str, &Edition)> {
        let h = self.preferred_edition.get(work_id)?;
        let ed = self.editions.get(h)?;
        Some((h.as_str(), ed))
    }

    pub fn catalogue_card(
        &self,
        edition_hash: &str,
        requester: Option<&DidKey>,
    ) -> Result<CatalogueCard> {
        let ed = self
            .editions
            .get(edition_hash)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("edition not found".into()))?;
        if !ed.access.can_discover(&ed.author, requester) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("edition is private".into()));
        }
        let is_preferred = self
            .preferred_edition
            .get(&ed.work_id)
            .map(|h| h == edition_hash)
            .unwrap_or(false);
        let public_shelf_count = self
            .shelves
            .values()
            .filter(|s| s.public && s.entries.iter().any(|e| e.edition_hash == edition_hash))
            .count();
        let public_annotation_count = self
            .annotations
            .values()
            .filter(|a| a.public && a.edition_hash == edition_hash)
            .count();

        Ok(CatalogueCard {
            edition_hash: edition_hash.to_string(),
            work_id: ed.work_id.clone(),
            title: ed.title.clone(),
            attribution: ed.attribution.clone(),
            description: ed.description.clone(),
            edition_label: ed.edition_label.clone(),
            version: ed.version,
            is_preferred_edition: is_preferred,
            downloadable_by_public: ed.access.is_downloadable_publicly(),
            sharing_terms: ed.sharing_terms.clone(),
            discussion_room: ed.discussion_room.clone(),
            representations: ed.representations.clone(),
            vetting_labels: ed.vetting_labels.clone(),
            public_shelf_count,
            public_annotation_count,
        })
    }

    /// Download exact verified bytes for a declared representation.
    /// Takes `&self`: leaves no record of who downloaded what.
    pub fn download_bytes(
        &self,
        edition_hash: &str,
        sha256: &str,
        requester: Option<&DidKey>,
    ) -> Result<&[u8]> {
        let ed = self
            .editions
            .get(edition_hash)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("edition not found".into()))?;
        if !ed.access.can_read_file(&ed.author, requester) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("download refused: requester not authorized".into()));
        }
        let rep = ed
            .representations
            .iter()
            .find(|r| r.sha256 == sha256)
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Policy("requested sha256 does not belong to this edition".into())
            })?;
        let bytes = self
            .blobs
            .get(&rep.sha256)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("blob missing from storage".into()))?;
        if sha256_hex(bytes) != rep.sha256 {
            return Err(Error::Verification("stored blob failed digest check".into()));
        }
        Ok(bytes.as_slice())
    }

    /// Plain word search over publicly discoverable editions only.
    /// Private drafts never appear in public search results.
    pub fn search_public(&self, query: &str, scope: SearchScope) -> Vec<SearchHit> {
        let terms: Vec<String> = query
            .split_whitespace()
            .map(|w| w.to_lowercase())
            .filter(|w| !w.is_empty())
            .collect();
        if terms.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        let mut hits = Vec::new();
        for (ed_hash, ed) in &self.editions {
            if !ed.access.is_discoverable_publicly() {
                continue;
            }
            let title_lc = ed.title.to_lowercase();
            let desc_lc = ed.description.to_lowercase();
            let attr_lc = ed.attribution.to_lowercase();
            let outline_lc = ed.contents_outline.join(" ").to_lowercase();

            let mut all_matched = true;
            let mut matched_fields = Vec::new();
            for term in &terms {
                let in_title = title_lc.contains(term);
                let in_desc = desc_lc.contains(term);
                let in_attr = attr_lc.contains(term);
                let in_outline =
                    scope == SearchScope::MetadataAndOutline && outline_lc.contains(term);
                if !(in_title || in_desc || in_attr || in_outline) {
                    all_matched = false;
                    break;
                }
                if in_title && !matched_fields.contains(&"title".to_string()) {
                    matched_fields.push("title".to_string());
                }
                if in_desc && !matched_fields.contains(&"description".to_string()) {
                    matched_fields.push("description".to_string());
                }
                if in_attr && !matched_fields.contains(&"attribution".to_string()) {
                    matched_fields.push("attribution".to_string());
                }
                if in_outline && !matched_fields.contains(&"contents_outline".to_string()) {
                    matched_fields.push("contents_outline".to_string());
                }
            }
            if all_matched {
                hits.push(SearchHit {
                    edition_hash: ed_hash.clone(),
                    work_id: ed.work_id.clone(),
                    title: ed.title.clone(),
                    edition_label: ed.edition_label.clone(),
                    version: ed.version,
                    scope,
                    matched_fields,
                });
            }
        }

        hits.sort_by(|a, b| {
            a.work_id
                .cmp(&b.work_id)
                .then_with(|| b.version.cmp(&a.version))
                .then_with(|| a.edition_hash.cmp(&b.edition_hash))
        });
        hits
    }

    pub fn shelves_for_edition(
        &self,
        edition_hash: &str,
        requester: Option<&DidKey>,
    ) -> Vec<&Shelf> {
        let mut out: Vec<&Shelf> = self
            .shelves
            .values()
            .filter(|s| {
                (s.public || requester.map(|r| r == &s.curator).unwrap_or(false))
                    && s.entries.iter().any(|e| e.edition_hash == edition_hash)
            })
            .collect();
        out.sort_by(|a, b| a.shelf_id.cmp(&b.shelf_id));
        out
    }

    /// Returns annotations anchored strictly to `edition_hash` (never redirected
    /// from or to another edition of the same work).
    pub fn annotations_for_edition(
        &self,
        edition_hash: &str,
        requester: Option<&DidKey>,
    ) -> Vec<&Annotation> {
        let mut out: Vec<&Annotation> = self
            .annotations
            .values()
            .filter(|a| {
                a.edition_hash == edition_hash
                    && (a.public || requester.map(|r| r == &a.author).unwrap_or(false))
            })
            .collect();
        out.sort_by(|a, b| a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at).then_with(|| a.body.cmp(&b.body)));
        out
    }
}

tests/library.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::hash::sha256_hex;
use chat_world::library::{
    AccessPolicy, Annotation, AnnotationDraft, AnnotationKind, Edition, EditionDraft,
    FileRepresentation, PassageLocator, SearchScope, SharedLibrary, Shelf, ShelfDraft, ShelfEntry,
    ShelfKind, VettingLabel,
};
use chat_world::Keypair;

#[test]
fn amto_public_release_catalogue_shelves_plain_search_and_edition_bound_annotations() -> Result<()>
{
    let author = Keypair::generate();
    let curator_a = Keypair::generate();
    let curator_b = Keypair::generate();
    let reader = Keypair::generate();
    let discussion_room = Keypair::generate().did();

    let mut lib = SharedLibrary::new();

    // 1. Author releases Revision 20 of A Mathematical Theory of Opposites
    //    with a primary PDF and a clearly marked derived text representation.
    let pdf_bytes = b"%PDF-1.7 A Mathematical Theory of Opposites Revision 20".to_vec();
    let pdf_sha = sha256_hex(&pdf_bytes);
    let txt_bytes = b"Plain text extraction of Revision 20".to_vec();
    let txt_sha = sha256_hex(&txt_bytes);

    let ed20 = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/amto".into(),
            title: "A Mathematical Theory of Opposites".into(),
            attribution: "Anonymous / Public Domain".into(),
            description: "A mathematical and philosophical study of relational opposition.".into(),
            edition_label: "Revision 20".into(),
            version: 20,
            derived_from: None,
            contents_outline: vec![
                "Part II: Four Regions of a Predicate Pair".into(),
                "Part X: Choice, Value, and Ethical Life".into(),
                "Part XI: Composition and Generation".into(),
            ],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            discussion_room: Some(discussion_room.clone()),
            representations: vec![
                FileRepresentation {
                    format: "pdf".into(),
                    filename: "AMTO_Revision_20_Complete.pdf".into(),
                    byte_len: pdf_bytes.len() as u64,
                    sha256: pdf_sha.clone(),
                    is_primary_source: true,
                    derived_from_sha256: None,
                    encrypted: false,
                },
                FileRepresentation {
                    format: "txt".into(),
                    filename: "AMTO_Revision_20_Master.txt".into(),
                    byte_len: txt_bytes.len() as u64,
                    sha256: txt_sha.clone(),
                    is_primary_source: false,
                    derived_from_sha256: Some(pdf_sha.clone()),
                    encrypted: false,
                },
            ],
            vetting_labels: vec![
                VettingLabel::AuthorDesignatedEdition,
                VettingLabel::FileIdentityChecked,
                VettingLabel::FormatRecognized,
                VettingLabel::MetadataReviewed,
                VettingLabel::PlaintextInspected,
            ],
            access: AccessPolicy::Public,
            addresses_annotations: vec![],
            published_at: 1000,
        },
        &author,
    )?;
    let ed20_hash = lib.publish_edition(
        ed20,
        vec![(pdf_sha.clone(), pdf_bytes.clone()), (txt_sha, txt_bytes)],
    )?;

    // 2. Anonymous visitor fetches catalogue card and downloads exact bytes without mutating lib.
    let card = lib.catalogue_card(&ed20_hash, None)?;
    assert!(card.is_preferred_edition);
    assert!(card.downloadable_by_public);
    assert_eq!(card.discussion_room, Some(discussion_room));
    let downloaded = lib.download_bytes(&ed20_hash, &pdf_sha, None)?;
    assert_eq!(downloaded, pdf_bytes.as_slice());

    // 3. Two independent curators place the same immutable edition on two different shelves.
    let q_shelf = Shelf::sign(
        ShelfDraft {
            shelf_id: "shelf/false-oppositions".into(),
            title: "Distinguishing Useful Contrasts".into(),
            kind: ShelfKind::QuestionShelf {
                question: "How do we distinguish a useful contrast from a false opposition?".into(),
            },
            public: true,
            entries: vec![ShelfEntry {
                edition_hash: ed20_hash.clone(),
                curator_note: "Start with Part II on the four regions of a predicate pair.".into(),
                guiding_question: Some("When does neither-case defeat coverage?".into()),
            }],
            created_at: 1010,
        },
        &curator_a,
    )?;
    lib.publish_shelf(q_shelf)?;

    let path_shelf = Shelf::sign(
        ShelfDraft {
            shelf_id: "shelf/ethics-path".into(),
            title: "Formal Models in Practical Ethics".into(),
            kind: ShelfKind::ReadingPath,
            public: true,
            entries: vec![ShelfEntry {
                edition_hash: ed20_hash.clone(),
                curator_note: "Read Part X alongside game-theoretic controls.".into(),
                guiding_question: None,
            }],
            created_at: 1020,
        },
        &curator_b,
    )?;
    lib.publish_shelf(path_shelf)?;

    let shelves = lib.shelves_for_edition(&ed20_hash, None);
    assert_eq!(shelves.len(), 2);
    assert_ne!(shelves[0].curator, author.did());

    // 4. Plain word search distinguishes MetadataOnly vs MetadataAndOutline.
    let meta_hits = lib.search_public("predicate pair", SearchScope::MetadataOnly);
    assert!(meta_hits.is_empty());
    let outline_hits = lib.search_public("predicate pair", SearchScope::MetadataAndOutline);
    assert_eq!(outline_hits.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(outline_hits[0].edition_hash, ed20_hash);
    assert_eq!(outline_hits[0].matched_fields, vec!["contents_outline"]);

    // 5. Reader attaches an errata proposal to a fixed ChapterSection on Revision 20.
    let errata = Annotation::sign(
        AnnotationDraft {
            edition_hash: ed20_hash.clone(),
            locator: PassageLocator::ChapterSection {
                chapter: 106,
                section: Some("106.2".into()),
            },
            kind: AnnotationKind::ErrataProposal,
            body: "Check repeated word fragment in opening sentence of 106.2.".into(),
            public: true,
            created_at: 1030,
        },
        &reader,
    )?;
    let errata_hash = lib.publish_annotation(errata)?;

    // Non-author cannot forge an AuthorResponse.
    let fake_response = Annotation::sign(
        AnnotationDraft {
            edition_hash: ed20_hash.clone(),
            locator: PassageLocator::ChapterSection {
                chapter: 106,
                section: Some("106.2".into()),
            },
            kind: AnnotationKind::AuthorResponse {
                in_reply_to: errata_hash.clone(),
            },
            body: "Impostor reply.".into(),
            public: true,
            created_at: 1035,
        },
        &curator_a,
    )?;
    assert!(lib.publish_annotation(fake_response).is_err());

    // Real author responds.
    let author_reply = Annotation::sign(
        AnnotationDraft {
            edition_hash: ed20_hash.clone(),
            locator: PassageLocator::ChapterSection {
                chapter: 106,
                section: Some("106.2".into()),
            },
            kind: AnnotationKind::AuthorResponse {
                in_reply_to: errata_hash.clone(),
            },
            body: "Confirmed; fixed in Revision 21.".into(),
            public: true,
            created_at: 1040,
        },
        &author,
    )?;
    lib.publish_annotation(author_reply)?;

    // 6. Author publishes Revision 21 addressing the errata.
    //    Preferred edition advances, while Revision 20's annotations stay anchored to Revision 20!
    let pdf21_bytes = b"%PDF-1.7 A Mathematical Theory of Opposites Revision 21".to_vec();
    let pdf21_sha = sha256_hex(&pdf21_bytes);
    let ed21 = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/amto".into(),
            title: "A Mathematical Theory of Opposites".into(),
            attribution: "Anonymous / Public Domain".into(),
            description: "Print-cleaned edition removing repetitive prose caveats.".into(),
            edition_label: "Revision 21".into(),
            version: 21,
            derived_from: Some(ed20_hash.clone()),
            contents_outline: vec!["Part X: Choice, Value, and Ethical Life".into()],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            discussion_room: None,
            representations: vec![FileRepresentation {
                format: "pdf".into(),
                filename: "AMTO_Revision_21_Complete.pdf".into(),
                byte_len: pdf21_bytes.len() as u64,
                sha256: pdf21_sha.clone(),
                is_primary_source: true,
                derived_from_sha256: None,
                encrypted: false,
            }],
            vetting_labels: vec![
                VettingLabel::AuthorDesignatedEdition,
                VettingLabel::FileIdentityChecked,
            ],
            access: AccessPolicy::Public,
            addresses_annotations: vec![errata_hash],
            published_at: 2000,
        },
        &author,
    )?;
    let ed21_hash = lib.publish_edition(ed21, vec![(pdf21_sha, pdf21_bytes)])?;

    let (pref_hash, pref_ed) = lib.preferred_edition("work/amto").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(pref_hash, ed21_hash);
    assert_eq!(pref_ed.version, 21);

    // Annotations on Revision 20 did NOT silently redirect to Revision 21.
    assert_eq!(lib.annotations_for_edition(&ed20_hash, None).len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(lib.annotations_for_edition(&ed21_hash, None).len(), 0);

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn discoverability_access_control_and_private_search_isolation() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let outsider = Keypair::generate();
    let mut lib = SharedLibrary::new();

    // 1. PublicCardRestrictedFile: discoverable publicly, downloadable only by Alice or Bob.
    let restr_bytes = b"Early pre-release chapter".to_vec();
    let restr_sha = sha256_hex(&restr_bytes);
    let restr_ed = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/prerelease".into(),
            title: "Pre-release Geometry Notes".into(),
            attribution: "Alice".into(),
            description: "Available on request.".into(),
            edition_label: "Draft 1".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            contents_outline: vec![],
            sharing_terms: "All rights reserved".into(),
            discussion_room: None,
            representations: vec![FileRepresentation {
                format: "txt".into(),
                filename: "prerelease.txt".into(),
                byte_len: restr_bytes.len() as u64,
                sha256: restr_sha.clone(),
                is_primary_source: true,
                derived_from_sha256: None,
                encrypted: false,
            }],
            vetting_labels: vec![VettingLabel::FileIdentityChecked],
            access: AccessPolicy::PublicCardRestrictedFile {
                allowed_readers: vec![bob.did()],
            },
            addresses_annotations: vec![],
            published_at: 100,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    let restr_hash = lib.publish_edition(restr_ed, vec![(restr_sha.clone(), restr_bytes.clone())])?;

    // Discoverable in public search and catalogue card, even by outsider.
    assert_eq!(
        lib.search_public("Geometry", SearchScope::MetadataOnly).len(),
        1
    );
    let card = lib.catalogue_card(&restr_hash, Some(&outsider.did()))?;
    assert!(!card.downloadable_by_public);

    // Placing it on a public shelf succeeds, but still does NOT grant outsider file download!
    let shelf = Shelf::sign(
        ShelfDraft {
            shelf_id: "shelf/upcoming".into(),
            title: "Upcoming Works".into(),
            kind: ShelfKind::AuthorShelf,
            public: true,
            entries: vec![ShelfEntry {
                edition_hash: restr_hash.clone(),
                curator_note: "Preview catalogue card.".into(),
                guiding_question: None,
            }],
            created_at: 110,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    lib.publish_shelf(shelf)?;
    assert!(lib
        .download_bytes(&restr_hash, &restr_sha, Some(&outsider.did()))
        .is_err());
    assert!(lib.download_bytes(&restr_hash, &restr_sha, None).is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        lib.download_bytes(&restr_hash, &restr_sha, Some(&bob.did()))?,
        restr_bytes.as_slice()
    );

    // 2. PrivatePersonal draft: completely invisible to public search, outsiders, and public shelves.
    let priv_bytes = b"ciphertext: private journal draft".to_vec();
    let priv_sha = sha256_hex(&priv_bytes);
    let priv_ed = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/secret-diary".into(),
            title: "Secret Quantum Geometry Diary".into(),
            attribution: "Alice".into(),
            description: "Personal notes.".into(),
            edition_label: "v1".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            contents_outline: vec![],
            sharing_terms: "Private".into(),
            discussion_room: None,
            representations: vec![FileRepresentation {
                format: "enc".into(),
                filename: "diary.enc".into(),
                byte_len: priv_bytes.len() as u64,
                sha256: priv_sha.clone(),
                is_primary_source: true,
                derived_from_sha256: None,
                encrypted: true,
            }],
            vetting_labels: vec![VettingLabel::EncryptedClientSideCheckOnly],
            access: AccessPolicy::PrivatePersonal { owner: alice.did() },
            addresses_annotations: vec![],
            published_at: 120,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    let priv_hash = lib.publish_edition(priv_ed, vec![(priv_sha.clone(), priv_bytes.clone())])?;

    assert!(lib.search_public("Secret", SearchScope::MetadataAndOutline).is_empty());
    assert!(lib.catalogue_card(&priv_hash, Some(&outsider.did())).is_err());
    assert!(lib.catalogue_card(&priv_hash, Some(&alice.did())).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(
        lib.download_bytes(&priv_hash, &priv_sha, Some(&alice.did()))?,
        priv_bytes.as_slice()
    );

    // Public shelf trying to reference the hidden private edition is refused.
    let leaky_shelf = Shelf::sign(
        ShelfDraft {
            shelf_id: "shelf/leaky".into(),
            title: "Leaky".into(),
            kind: ShelfKind::AuthorShelf,
            public: true,
            entries: vec![ShelfEntry {
                edition_hash: priv_hash,
                curator_note: "Should not leak.".into(),
                guiding_question: None,
            }],
            created_at: 130,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;
    assert!(lib.publish_shelf(leaky_shelf).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn honest_vetting_labels_and_json_strictness_enforced() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bytes = b"encrypted payload".to_vec();
    let sha = sha256_hex(&bytes);

    // Claiming PlaintextInspected on an encrypted representation is refused at signing time.
    let dishonest = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/enc".into(),
            title: "Encrypted Work".into(),
            attribution: "Alice".into(),
            description: "Encrypted.".into(),
            edition_label: "v1".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            contents_outline: vec![],
            sharing_terms: "Private".into(),
            discussion_room: None,
            representations: vec![FileRepresentation {
                format: "enc".into(),
                filename: "work.enc".into(),
                byte_len: bytes.len() as u64,
                sha256: sha.clone(),
                is_primary_source: true,
                derived_from_sha256: None,
                encrypted: true,
            }],
            vetting_labels: vec![VettingLabel::PlaintextInspected],
            access: AccessPolicy::PrivatePersonal { owner: alice.did() },
            addresses_annotations: vec![],
            published_at: 100,
        },
        &alice,
    );
    assert!(dishonest.is_err());

    // Honest edition refuses tampered signature and unknown JSON fields (e.g. reader tracking).
    let mut honest = Edition::sign(
        EditionDraft {
            work_id: "work/clean".into(),
            title: "Clean Work".into(),
            attribution: "Alice".into(),
            description: "Clean.".into(),
            edition_label: "v1".into(),
            version: 1,
            derived_from: None,
            contents_outline: vec![],
            sharing_terms: "CC0-1.0".into(),
            discussion_room: None,
            representations: vec![FileRepresentation {
                format: "txt".into(),
                filename: "clean.txt".into(),
                byte_len: bytes.len() as u64,
                sha256: sha,
                is_primary_source: true,
                derived_from_sha256: None,
                encrypted: false,
            }],
            vetting_labels: vec![VettingLabel::FileIdentityChecked],
            access: AccessPolicy::Public,
            addresses_annotations: vec![],
            published_at: 100,
        },
        &alice,
    )?;

    let mut val = serde_json::to_value(&honest).unwrap();
    val["download_readers"] = serde_json::json!([alice.did().as_str()]);
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<Edition>(val).is_err());

    honest.title = "Tampered Title".into();
    assert!(honest.verify().is_err());

    Ok(())
}

::Sounds great. Please proceed: ➡️


Here is the Continuing Project & Multi-AI Handoff layer, turning the collaboration infrastructure from the transcript into a self-contained Rust prototype (src/project.rs and tests/project.rs) that drops into chat-world with a single pub mod project; line in src/lib.rs.
The prototype enforces six operational invariants across apps and sessions:
 * Project as the durable anchor: Connects captured conversations, versioned artifacts, bounded task assignments, reviews with explicit coverage, and acceptance decisions under one verifiable ProjectWorkspace that exports and restores cleanly via ProjectSnapshot.
 * Honest capture provenance and visible gaps: Distinguishes CaptureProvenance::NativeSigned (signed directly by the speaking participant) from CaptureProvenance::Imported (signed by the submitter, preserving the raw source digest without forging the original speaker's signature), and records explicit GapMarkers (MissingPrompt, TruncatedResponse, UnavailableAttachment, UnknownCompleteness).
 * Revision-bound proposals and stale-write protection: Every EditProposal names its exact base_revision_hash; accept_revision refuses any stale proposal targeting a superseded revision (forcing explicit reconciliation against the current head) while remaining idempotent on duplicate delivery of an already-accepted decision.
 * Explicit review coverage: ReviewRecord separates supplied sections, examined sections, checks performed, and missing_or_unexamined gaps so a partial pass never masquerades as a complete audit when passed to the next collaborator.
 * Authority-filtered generated handoffs: generate_handoff compiles a portable HandoffPackage directly from authoritative state—delivering settled terminology, current approved content, active decisions, open questions, and partial-review warnings while hiding competing drafts whenever an assignment declares independent_of_other_drafts: true.
 * Strict JSON boundaries: Every serializable record uses #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] and deterministic u64 timestamps so exported packages remain tamper-evident and offline-verifiable.
src/project.rs
//! Continuing Project & Multi-AI Handoff Infrastructure.
//!
//! Makes the project the durable unit of collaboration across apps, models,
//! and sessions: native and imported conversation records, revision-bound
//! edit proposals, explicit review coverage, stale-safe acceptance decisions,
//! and authority-filtered generated handoff packages.

use crate::did::{DidKey, Keypair};
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::hash::{body_for_signing, hash_of, sha256_hex};
use crate::proof::{Proof, ProofOrArray};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

fn looks_like_hash(s: &str) -> bool {
    s.len() == 64 && s.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit())
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProjectPermission {
    Read,
    CommentOrReview,
    ProposeChanges,
    AcceptChanges,
    AssignTasks,
    Publish,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ParticipantRole {
    pub participant_id: DidKey,
    pub label: String,
    pub permissions: Vec<ProjectPermission>,
}

// CONVERSATION CAPTURE & IMPORT PROVENANCE

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "turn_role", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum TurnRole {
    Prompt,
    Response,
    RegeneratedAlternative,
    EditedPrompt { supersedes_turn_hash: String },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "gap", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum GapMarker {
    MissingPrompt,
    TruncatedResponse,
    UnavailableAttachment { name: String },
    UnknownCompleteness,
}

/// Distinguishes direct authenticated participation from an imported transcript.
/// An importer's signature attests to what the importer submitted, never
/// retrospectively forging the original speaker's signature.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "provenance", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CaptureProvenance {
    NativeSigned,
    Imported {
        submitted_by: DidKey,
        claimed_speaker: String,
        source_format: String,
        raw_source_sha256: String,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct TurnDraft {
    pub project_id: String,
    pub thread_id: String,
    pub turn_index: u64,
    pub role: TurnRole,
    pub text: String,
    pub attachments: Vec<String>,
    pub gaps: Vec<GapMarker>,
    pub provenance: CaptureProvenance,
    pub ts: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ConversationTurn {
    pub project_id: String,
    pub thread_id: String,
    pub turn_index: u64,
    pub role: TurnRole,
    pub text: String,
    pub attachments: Vec<String>,
    pub gaps: Vec<GapMarker>,
    pub provenance: CaptureProvenance,
    pub signer: DidKey,
    pub ts: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl ConversationTurn {
    pub fn sign(draft: TurnDraft, signer_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        let mut turn = ConversationTurn {
            project_id: draft.project_id,
            thread_id: draft.thread_id,
            turn_index: draft.turn_index,
            role: draft.role,
            text: draft.text,
            attachments: draft.attachments,
            gaps: draft.gaps,
            provenance: draft.provenance,
            signer: signer_kp.did(),
            ts: draft.ts,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        turn.validate_fields()?;
        let body = body_for_signing(&turn)?;
        let sig = signer_kp.sign(&body);
        turn.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(signer_kp, &sig));
        Ok(turn)
    }

    fn validate_fields(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.project_id.trim().is_empty() || self.thread_id.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "conversation turn: project_id and thread_id must be non-empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        if let TurnRole::EditedPrompt {
            ref supersedes_turn_hash,
        } = self.role
        {
            if !looks_like_hash(supersedes_turn_hash) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "conversation turn: supersedes_turn_hash must be 64 hex chars".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        if let CaptureProvenance::Imported {
            ref submitted_by,
            ref claimed_speaker,
            ref source_format,
            ref raw_source_sha256,
        } = self.provenance
        {
            if submitted_by != &self.signer {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "imported turn: signer must match provenance.submitted_by".into(),
                ));
            }
            if claimed_speaker.trim().is_empty() || source_format.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "imported turn: claimed_speaker and source_format must be non-empty".into(),
                ));
            }
            if !looks_like_hash(raw_source_sha256) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "imported turn: raw_source_sha256 must be 64 hex chars".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate_fields()?;
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.signer)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("conversation turn: missing signer proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RevisionDraft {
    pub project_id: String,
    pub artifact_id: String,
    pub revision_num: u64,
    pub parent_revision_hash: Option<String>,
    pub content: String,
    pub derived_from_proposals: Vec<String>,
    pub summary: String,
    pub created_at: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ArtifactRevision {
    pub project_id: String,
    pub artifact_id: String,
    pub revision_num: u64,
    pub parent_revision_hash: Option<String>,
    pub content: String,
    pub content_sha256: String,
    pub derived_from_proposals: Vec<String>,
    pub summary: String,
    pub author: DidKey,
    pub created_at: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl ArtifactRevision {
    pub fn sign(draft: RevisionDraft, author_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        let content_sha256 = sha256_hex(draft.content.as_bytes());
        let mut rev = ArtifactRevision {
            project_id: draft.project_id,
            artifact_id: draft.artifact_id,
            revision_num: draft.revision_num,
            parent_revision_hash: draft.parent_revision_hash,
            content: draft.content,
            content_sha256,
            derived_from_proposals: draft.derived_from_proposals,
            summary: draft.summary,
            author: author_kp.did(),
            created_at: draft.created_at,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        rev.validate_fields()?;
        let body = body_for_signing(&rev)?;
        let sig = author_kp.sign(&body);
        rev.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(author_kp, &sig));
        Ok(rev)
    }

    fn validate_fields(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.project_id.trim().is_empty() || self.artifact_id.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "artifact revision: project_id and artifact_id must be non-empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.revision_num == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "artifact revision: revision_num must be >= 1".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.revision_num == 1 && self.parent_revision_hash.is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "artifact revision: revision 1 cannot declare parent_revision_hash".into(),
            ));
        }
        if let Some(parent) = &self.parent_revision_hash {
            if !looks_like_hash(parent) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "artifact revision: parent_revision_hash must be 64 hex chars".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        if self.content_sha256 != sha256_hex(self.content.as_bytes()) {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "artifact revision: content_sha256 does not match content".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate_fields()?;
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.author)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("artifact revision: missing author proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct TaskAssignment {
    pub task_id: String,
    pub project_id: String,
    pub assignee: DidKey,
    pub artifact_id: String,
    pub base_revision_hash: String,
    pub objective: String,
    pub constraints: Vec<String>,
    pub stop_condition: String,
    pub independent_of_other_drafts: bool,
    pub assigner: DidKey,
    pub assigned_at: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl TaskAssignment {
    pub fn sign(draft: TaskDraft, assigner_kp: &Keypair) -> Result<Self> {
        if draft.task_id.trim().is_empty() || draft.objective.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "task assignment: task_id and objective must be non-empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        if !looks_like_hash(&draft.base_revision_hash) {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "task assignment: base_revision_hash must be 64 hex chars".into(),
            ));
        }
        let mut task = TaskAssignment {
            task_id: draft.task_id,
            project_id: draft.project_id,
            assignee: draft.assignee,
            artifact_id: draft.artifact_id,
            base_revision_hash: draft.base_revision_hash,
            objective: draft.objective,
            constraints: draft.constraints,
            stop_condition: draft.stop_condition,
            independent_of_other_drafts: draft.independent_of_other_drafts,
            assigner: assigner_kp.did(),
            assigned_at: draft.assigned_at,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&task)?;
        let sig = assigner_kp.sign(&body);
        task.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(assigner_kp, &sig));
        Ok(task)
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.task_id.trim().is_empty() || self.objective.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "task assignment: empty task_id or objective".into(),
            ));
        }
        if !looks_like_hash(&self.base_revision_hash) {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "task assignment: invalid base_revision_hash".into(),
            ));
        }
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.assigner)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("task assignment: missing assigner proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}
