#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ObservationRecord {
    WorldOpened(WorldOpened),
    ParticipantJoined(ParticipantJoined),
    PredictionSubmitted(PredictionSubmitted),
    ProbeRecorded(ProbeRecorded),
    SecretRevealed(SecretRevealed),
}

impl ObservationRecord {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn seq(&self) -> u64 {
        match self {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(_) => 0,
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => r.seq,
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(r) => r.seq,
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(r) => r.seq,
            ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(r) => r.seq,
        }
    }

    pub fn prev(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(_) => None,
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(r) => Some(&r.prev),
        }
    }

    pub fn world_id(&self) -> &DidKey {
        match self {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(r) => &r.world_id,
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => &r.world_id,
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(r) => &r.world_id,
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(r) => &r.world_id,
            ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(r) => &r.world_id,
        }
    }

    pub fn proof(&self) -> &ProofOrArray {
        match self {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(r) => &r.proof,
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => &r.proof,
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(r) => &r.proof,
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(r) => &r.proof,
            ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(r) => &r.proof,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ObservationLog {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub law: ObservationLaw,
    pub hidden_commitment: String,
    pub records: Vec<ObservationRecord>,
}

// =====================================================================
// PURE ANALYSIS HELPERS (COMPATIBILITY & EXPERIMENT DESIGN)
// =====================================================================

/// Returns the names of every candidate in `law.candidates` consistent with
/// all recorded probes so far.
pub fn compatible_candidates(law: &ObservationLaw, probes: &[ProbeRecorded]) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for cand in &law.candidates {
        let mut ok = true;
        for probe in probes {
            let readout = law.find_readout(&probe.readout_name).ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Verification(format!("unknown readout {:?}", probe.readout_name))
            })?;
            match cand.rule.eval(probe.input) {
                Ok(val) => {
                    if !readout.kind.is_consistent(val, &probe.reading) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if ok {
            out.push(cand.name.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DiscriminatingProbe {
    pub input: i64,
    pub readout_name: String,
    pub cost: u64,
    pub splits_pair: (String, String),
}

/// Searches `candidate_inputs` and affordable admitted readouts (cheapest first)
/// for a probe guaranteed to separate at least two currently compatible models.
pub fn suggest_discriminating_probe(
    law: &ObservationLaw,
    probes: &[ProbeRecorded],
    remaining_budget: u64,
    candidate_inputs: &[i64],
) -> Result<Option<DiscriminatingProbe>> {
    let compat_names = compatible_candidates(law, probes)?;
    if compat_names.len() <= 1 {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let compat_models: Vec<&CandidateModel> = law
        .candidates
        .iter()
        .filter(|c| compat_names.contains(&c.name))
        .collect();

    let mut readouts: Vec<&ReadoutSpec> = law
        .admitted_readouts
        .iter()
        .filter(|r| r.cost <= remaining_budget)
        .collect();
    readouts.sort_by(|a, b| a.cost.cmp(&b.cost).then_with(|| a.name.cmp(&b.name)));

    for readout in readouts {
        for &input in candidate_inputs {
            if input < law.input_min || input > law.input_max {
                continue;
            }
            for i in 0..compat_models.len() {
                let Ok(v1) = compat_models[i].rule.eval(input) else {
                    continue;
                };
                for j in (i + 1)..compat_models.len() {
                    let Ok(v2) = compat_models[j].rule.eval(input) else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    if readout.kind.guarantees_separation(v1, v2) {
                        return Ok(Some(DiscriminatingProbe {
                            input,
                            readout_name: readout.name.clone(),
                            cost: readout.cost,
                            splits_pair: (
                                compat_models[i].name.clone(),
                                compat_models[j].name.clone(),
                            ),
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(None)
}

// =====================================================================
// EXECUTABLE OBSERVATION WORLD & OFFLINE VERIFIER
// =====================================================================

fn sign_obs_dual<T, F>(
    mut rec: T,
    actor: &Keypair,
    world: &Keypair,
    wrap: fn(T) -> ObservationRecord,
    set_proof: F,
) -> Result<T>
where
    T: Clone,
    F: FnOnce(&mut T, ProofOrArray),
{
    let body = body_for_signing(&wrap(rec.clone()))?;
    let a_sig = actor.sign(&body);
    let w_sig = world.sign(&body);
    set_proof(
        &mut rec,
        ProofOrArray::array(vec![
            Proof::create(actor, &a_sig),
            Proof::create(world, &w_sig),
        ]),
    );
    Ok(rec)
}

pub struct ObservationWorld {
    world_id: DidKey,
    law: ObservationLaw,
    keypair: Keypair,
    secret: HiddenSecret,
    hidden_commitment: String,
    revealed: bool,
    remaining_budget: u64,
    participants: HashSet<DidKey>,
    open_predictions: HashMap<(DidKey, i64, String), ProbeReading>,
    records: Vec<ObservationRecord>,
}

impl ObservationWorld {
    pub fn open(
        law: ObservationLaw,
        hidden_model_index: u64,
        salt: &str,
        world_kp: Keypair,
        creator_kp: &Keypair,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        law.validate()?;
        if salt.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("observation world: salt cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        let cand = law
            .candidates
            .get(hidden_model_index as usize)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("hidden_model_index out of bounds".into()))?;
        let secret = HiddenSecret {
            model_index: hidden_model_index,
            model_name: cand.name.clone(),
            rule: cand.rule.clone(),
            salt: salt.to_string(),
        };
        let hidden_commitment = secret.commitment()?;
        let world_id = world_kp.did();
        let creator_id = creator_kp.did();
        let budget = law.probe_budget;

        let opened = WorldOpened {
            world_id: world_id.clone(),
            law: law.clone(),
            hidden_commitment: hidden_commitment.clone(),
            creator_id: creator_id.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_obs_dual(
            opened,
            creator_kp,
            &world_kp,
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let mut participants = HashSet::new();
        participants.insert(creator_id);

        Ok(ObservationWorld {
            world_id,
            law,
            keypair: world_kp,
            secret,
            hidden_commitment,
            revealed: false,
            remaining_budget: budget,
            participants,
            open_predictions: HashMap::new(),
            records: vec![ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(signed)],
        })
    }

    pub fn world_id(&self) -> &DidKey {
        &self.world_id
    }

    pub fn law(&self) -> &ObservationLaw {
        &self.law
    }

    pub fn remaining_budget(&self) -> u64 {
        self.remaining_budget
    }

    pub fn probes(&self) -> Vec<ProbeRecorded> {
        self.records
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|r| match r {
                ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(p) => Some(p.clone()),
                _ => None,
            })
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn compatible_candidates(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        compatible_candidates(&self.law, &self.probes())
    }

    pub fn log(&self) -> ObservationLog {
        ObservationLog {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            law: self.law.clone(),
            hidden_commitment: self.hidden_commitment.clone(),
            records: self.records.clone(),
        }
    }

    fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {
        self.records.len() as u64
    }

    fn last_hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        self.records
            .last()
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Chain("observation world has no seed record".into()))?
            .hash()
    }

    pub fn join(&mut self, participant_kp: &Keypair, now: u64) -> Result<ObservationRecord> {
        if self.revealed {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "cannot join after hidden model has been revealed".into(),
            ));
        }
        let pid = participant_kp.did();
        if self.participants.contains(&pid) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("participant already joined".into()));
        }
        let rec = ParticipantJoined {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            participant_id: pid.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_obs_dual(
            rec,
            participant_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let wrapped = ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(signed);
        self.participants.insert(pid);
        self.records.push(wrapped.clone());
        Ok(wrapped)
    }

    pub fn predict(
        &mut self,
        actor_kp: &Keypair,
        input: i64,
        readout_name: &str,
        expected_reading: ProbeReading,
        hypothesis_name: &str,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<ObservationRecord> {
        if self.revealed {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "cannot submit prediction after reveal".into(),
            ));
        }
        let actor_id = actor_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        if input < self.law.input_min || input > self.law.input_max {
            return Err(Error::Policy("prediction input outside admitted range".into()));
        }
        let readout = self
            .law
            .find_readout(readout_name)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy(format!("unknown readout {:?}", readout_name)))?;
        if !readout.kind.matches_reading_shape(&expected_reading) {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "expected_reading shape does not match readout instrument".into(),
            ));
        }
        if hypothesis_name.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("hypothesis_name cannot be empty".into()));
        }

        let rec = PredictionSubmitted {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            actor_id: actor_id.clone(),
            input,
            readout_name: readout_name.to_string(),
            expected_reading: expected_reading.clone(),
            hypothesis_name: hypothesis_name.to_string(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_obs_dual(
            rec,
            actor_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let wrapped = ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(signed);
        self.open_predictions
            .insert((actor_id, input, readout_name.to_string()), expected_reading);
        self.records.push(wrapped.clone());
        Ok(wrapped)
    }

    pub fn probe(
        &mut self,
        actor_kp: &Keypair,
        input: i64,
        readout_name: &str,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<ProbeRecorded> {
        self.probe_with_offset(actor_kp, input, readout_name, 0, now)
    }

    pub fn probe_with_offset(
        &mut self,
        actor_kp: &Keypair,
        input: i64,
        readout_name: &str,
        noise_offset: i64,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<ProbeRecorded> {
        if self.revealed {
            return Err(Error::Policy("cannot probe after reveal".into()));
        }
        let actor_id = actor_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        if input < self.law.input_min || input > self.law.input_max {
            return Err(Error::Policy("probe input outside admitted range".into()));
        }
        let readout = self
            .law
            .find_readout(readout_name)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy(format!("unknown readout {:?}", readout_name)))?
            .clone();
        if readout.cost > self.remaining_budget {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "insufficient probe budget: need {}, remaining {}",
                readout.cost, self.remaining_budget
            )));
        }

        let true_val = self.secret.rule.eval(input)?;
        let reading = readout.kind.observe(true_val, noise_offset)?;
        let next_budget = self.remaining_budget - readout.cost;
        let pred_key = (actor_id.clone(), input, readout_name.to_string());
        let prediction_matched = self
            .open_predictions
            .remove(&pred_key)
            .map(|expected| reading.matches_prediction(&expected));

        let rec = ProbeRecorded {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            actor_id,
            input,
            readout_name: readout_name.to_string(),
            cost: readout.cost,
            remaining_budget: next_budget,
            reading,
            prediction_matched,
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_obs_dual(
            rec,
            actor_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        self.remaining_budget = next_budget;
        self.records
            .push(ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(signed.clone()));
        Ok(signed)
    }

    pub fn reveal(&mut self, now: u64) -> Result<HiddenSecret> {
        if self.revealed {
            return Err(Error::Policy("hidden model already revealed".into()));
        }
        let mut rec = SecretRevealed {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            secret: self.secret.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(rec.clone()))?;
        let sig = self.keypair.sign(&body);
        rec.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&self.keypair, &sig));
        self.revealed = true;
        self.records.push(ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(rec));
        Ok(self.secret.clone())
    }
}

/// Independently verifies an `ObservationLog` offline.
/// Works on both in-progress logs and revealed logs; once `SecretRevealed`
/// is present, verifies the opening commitment and retroactively checks
/// every recorded probe reading against the committed hidden model.
pub fn verify_observation_log(log: &ObservationLog) -> Result<()> {
    log.law.validate()?;
    if !looks_like_hash(&log.hidden_commitment) {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "observation log: invalid hidden_commitment".into(),
        ));
    }
    let Some(ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(seed)) = log.records.first() else {
        return Err(Error::Chain(
            "observation log must start with world_opened".into(),
        ));
    };
    if seed.world_id != log.world_id {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "observation log: seed world_id mismatch".into(),
        ));
    }
    if seed.law.hash()? != log.law.hash()? {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "observation log: seed law does not match log law".into(),
        ));
    }
    if seed.hidden_commitment != log.hidden_commitment {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "observation log: seed hidden_commitment mismatch".into(),
        ));
    }

    let mut prev: Option<String> = None;
    let mut participants: HashSet<DidKey> = HashSet::new();
    let mut remaining_budget = log.law.probe_budget;
    let mut open_predictions: HashMap<(DidKey, i64, String), ProbeReading> = HashMap::new();
    let mut recorded_probes: Vec<&ProbeRecorded> = Vec::new();
    let mut revealed_secret: Option<&HiddenSecret> = None;

    for (i, rec) in log.records.iter().enumerate() {
        if rec.seq() != i as u64 {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "observation log record {i}: seq {} != expected {i}",
                rec.seq()
            )));
        }
        if rec.world_id() != &log.world_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "observation log record {i}: world_id mismatch"
            )));
        }
        match rec {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(_) => {
                if i != 0 {
                    return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                        "observation log record {i}: world_opened not at start"
                    )));
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if rec.prev() != prev.as_deref() {
                    return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                        "observation log record {i}: prev hash mismatch"
                    )));
                }
            }
        }

        if revealed_secret.is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "observation log record {i}: no records allowed after secret_revealed"
            )));
        }

        let body = body_for_signing(rec)?;
        let world_proof = rec
            .proof()
            .find_by_method(&log.world_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing world proof")))?;
        world_proof.verify(&body)?;

        match rec {
            ObservationRecord::WorldOpened(r) => {
                let cp = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.creator_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("seed: missing creator proof".into()))?;
                cp.verify(&body)?;
                participants.insert(r.creator_id.clone());
            }
            ObservationRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => {
                if !participants.insert(r.participant_id.clone()) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: participant already joined"
                    )));
                }
                let pp = r.proof.find_by_method(&r.participant_id).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing participant proof"))
                })?;
                pp.verify(&body)?;
            }
            ObservationRecord::PredictionSubmitted(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.actor_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: actor not a participant")));
                }
                if r.input < log.law.input_min || r.input > log.law.input_max {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: prediction input out of bounds"
                    )));
                }
                let readout = log.law.find_readout(&r.readout_name).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: unknown readout {:?}", r.readout_name))
                })?;
                if !readout.kind.matches_reading_shape(&r.expected_reading) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: prediction reading shape mismatch"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.actor_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing actor proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
                open_predictions.insert(
                    (r.actor_id.clone(), r.input, r.readout_name.clone()),
                    r.expected_reading.clone(),
                );
            }
            ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.actor_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: actor not a participant")));
                }
                if r.input < log.law.input_min || r.input > log.law.input_max {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: probe input out of bounds"
                    )));
                }
                let readout = log.law.find_readout(&r.readout_name).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: unknown readout {:?}", r.readout_name))
                })?;
                if r.cost != readout.cost {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: probe cost {} != readout cost {}",
                        r.cost, readout.cost
                    )));
                }
                if r.cost > remaining_budget {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: probe exceeds remaining budget"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_budget = remaining_budget - r.cost;
                if r.remaining_budget != expected_budget {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: remaining_budget {} != expected {}",
                        r.remaining_budget, expected_budget
                    )));
                }
                if !readout.kind.matches_reading_shape(&r.reading) {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: probe reading shape does not match readout"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_match = open_predictions
                    .remove(&(r.actor_id.clone(), r.input, r.readout_name.clone()))
                    .map(|pred| r.reading.matches_prediction(&pred));
                if r.prediction_matched != expected_match {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: prediction_matched mismatch"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.actor_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing actor proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
                remaining_budget = expected_budget;
                recorded_probes.push(r);
            }
            ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(r) => {
                let cand = log
                    .law
                    .candidates
                    .get(r.secret.model_index as usize)
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        Error::Verification("secret_revealed: model_index out of bounds".into())
                    })?;
                if cand.name != r.secret.model_name || cand.rule != r.secret.rule {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(
                        "secret_revealed: secret does not match candidate in law".into(),
                    ));
                }
                if r.secret.commitment()? != log.hidden_commitment {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(
                        "secret_revealed: secret commitment does not match WorldOpened".into(),
                    ));
                }
                revealed_secret = Some(&r.secret);
            }
        }

        prev = Some(rec.hash()?);
    }

    if let Some(secret) = revealed_secret {
        for probe in recorded_probes {
            let readout = log.law.find_readout(&probe.readout_name).unwrap();
            let true_val = secret.rule.eval(probe.input)?;
            if !readout.kind.is_consistent(true_val, &probe.reading) {
                return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                    "probe at seq {}: reading {:?} is inconsistent with revealed model value {}",
                    probe.seq, probe.reading, true_val
                )));
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

tests/observe.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::hash::body_for_signing;
use chat_world::observe::{
    suggest_discriminating_probe, verify_observation_log, CandidateModel, HiddenSecret, ModelRule,
    ObservationLaw, ObservationLog, ObservationRecord, ObservationWorld, ProbeReading,
    ProbeRecorded, ReadoutKind, ReadoutSpec, SecretRevealed,
};
use chat_world::{Keypair, Proof, ProofOrArray};

#[test]
fn finite_agreement_at_zero_and_one_fails_to_identify_quadratic_until_input_two() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();

    // Chapter 119.7: f(x) = x and g(x) = x^2 agree at 0 and 1, and diverge at 2.
    let law = ObservationLaw {
        topic: "Distinguish f(x) = x from g(x) = x^2".into(),
        candidates: vec![
            CandidateModel {
                name: "linear".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::Affine {
                    slope: 1,
                    intercept: 0,
                },
            },
            CandidateModel {
                name: "quadratic".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::Quadratic { a: 1, b: 0, c: 0 },
            },
        ],
        admitted_readouts: vec![ReadoutSpec {
            name: "exact".into(),
            kind: ReadoutKind::Exact,
            cost: 1,
        }],
        probe_budget: 5,
        input_min: 0,
        input_max: 5,
    };

    let mut world = ObservationWorld::open(law, 1, "salt-ch119-01", world_kp, &alice, 100)?;

    // Probing 0 and 1 yields exact agreement between both candidates.
    let p0 = world.probe(&alice, 0, "exact", 101)?;
    let p1 = world.probe(&alice, 1, "exact", 102)?;
    assert_eq!(p0.reading, ProbeReading::Exact { value: 0 });
    assert_eq!(p1.reading, ProbeReading::Exact { value: 1 });
    assert_eq!(
        world.compatible_candidates()?,
        vec!["linear".to_string(), "quadratic".to_string()]
    );

    // Alice commits to a prediction under the mistaken "linear" hypothesis at x = 2.
    world.predict(
        &alice,
        2,
        "exact",
        ProbeReading::Exact { value: 2 },
        "linear",
        103,
    )?;
    let p2 = world.probe(&alice, 2, "exact", 104)?;
    assert_eq!(p2.reading, ProbeReading::Exact { value: 4 });
    assert_eq!(p2.prediction_matched, Some(false));

    // Only quadratic remains compatible.
    assert_eq!(world.compatible_candidates()?, vec!["quadratic".to_string()]);
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_budget(), 2);

    // Log verifies both before reveal and after reveal.
    verify_observation_log(&world.log())?;
    let revealed = world.reveal(110)?;
    assert_eq!(revealed.model_name, "quadratic");

    let json = serde_json::to_string(&world.log()).unwrap();
    let restored: ObservationLog = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
    verify_observation_log(&restored)?;

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn sign_only_hides_diverging_gain_until_bounded_error_resolution_splits_candidates() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();

    // Chapter 119.5–119.6: e_n = (-a)^n * 1 for a = 1 vs a = 4.
    // Both alternate +1, -1, +1, -1 forever under SignOnly.
    // At step 1: -1 vs -4 (distance 3).
    //   coarse_radius_2: 2*2 = 4 >= 3 (cannot guarantee separation at step 1)
    //   fine_radius_1:   2*1 = 2 < 3  (guarantees separation at step 1!)
    let law = ObservationLaw {
        topic: "Separating persistent alternation from growing oscillation".into(),
        candidates: vec![
            CandidateModel {
                name: "unit_gain".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::AlternatingPower {
                    gain: 1,
                    initial: 1,
                },
            },
            CandidateModel {
                name: "diverging_gain".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::AlternatingPower {
                    gain: 4,
                    initial: 1,
                },
            },
        ],
        admitted_readouts: vec![
            ReadoutSpec {
                name: "sign".into(),
                kind: ReadoutKind::SignOnly,
                cost: 1,
            },
            ReadoutSpec {
                name: "coarse_r2".into(),
                kind: ReadoutKind::BoundedError { radius: 2 },
                cost: 2,
            },
            ReadoutSpec {
                name: "fine_r1".into(),
                kind: ReadoutKind::BoundedError { radius: 1 },
                cost: 3,
            },
        ],
        probe_budget: 10,
        input_min: 0,
        input_max: 4,
    };

    let mut world = ObservationWorld::open(law, 1, "salt-ch119-02", world_kp, &alice, 200)?;
    world.join(&bob, 201)?;

    // Four sign-only probes never separate the two models.
    for step in 0..=3 {
        let p = world.probe(&alice, step, "sign", 210 + step as u64)?;
        let expected_sign = if step % 2 == 0 { 1 } else { -1 };
        assert_eq!(p.reading, ProbeReading::Sign { sign: expected_sign });
    }
    assert_eq!(world.compatible_candidates()?.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_budget(), 6);

    // Asking for a discriminating probe on step 1 skips sign (fails) and coarse_r2 (3 <= 4),
    // selecting fine_r1 (3 > 2).
    let suggestion =
        suggest_discriminating_probe(world.law(), &world.probes(), world.remaining_budget(), &[1])?
            .expect("fine_r1 should split candidates at step 1");
    assert_eq!(suggestion.readout_name, "fine_r1");
    assert_eq!(suggestion.input, 1);

    // Bob runs fine_r1 at step 1 with worst-case +1 error offset (true -4 reported as -3).
    let p_fine = world.probe_with_offset(&bob, 1, "fine_r1", 1, 220)?;
    assert_eq!(
        p_fine.reading,
        ProbeReading::Bounded {
            reported: -3,
            radius: 1
        }
    );
    // Even with +1 error, |-1 - (-3)| = 2 > 1 rules out unit_gain!
    assert_eq!(
        world.compatible_candidates()?,
        vec!["diverging_gain".to_string()]
    );

    world.reveal(230)?;
    verify_observation_log(&world.log())?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn budget_limits_dishonest_host_probes_and_swapped_secrets_are_refused() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();

    let law = ObservationLaw {
        topic: "Threshold check".into(),
        candidates: vec![
            CandidateModel {
                name: "cut_at_3".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::PiecewiseThreshold {
                    threshold: 3,
                    low_value: 0,
                    high_value: 10,
                },
            },
            CandidateModel {
                name: "cut_at_5".into(),
                rule: ModelRule::PiecewiseThreshold {
                    threshold: 5,
                    low_value: 0,
                    high_value: 10,
                },
            },
        ],
        admitted_readouts: vec![ReadoutSpec {
            name: "exact".into(),
            kind: ReadoutKind::Exact,
            cost: 2,
        }],
        probe_budget: 2,
        input_min: 0,
        input_max: 10,
    };

    let mut world = ObservationWorld::open(law, 0, "salt-honest", world_kp.clone(), &alice, 10)?;

    // Out-of-range input is refused.
    assert!(world.probe(&alice, 11, "exact", 11).is_err());

    // First probe uses the full budget (2); a second probe is refused.
    world.probe(&alice, 4, "exact", 12)?;
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_budget(), 0);
    assert!(world.probe(&alice, 2, "exact", 13).is_err());

    // Attack 1: Host attempts to swap to cut_at_5 at reveal time -> commitment mismatch!
    let mut bad_reveal_log = world.log();
    let prev = bad_reveal_log.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let mut forged_reveal = SecretRevealed {
        world_id: world.world_id().clone(),
        seq: bad_reveal_log.records.len() as u64,
        prev,
        secret: HiddenSecret {
            model_index: 1,
            model_name: "cut_at_5".into(),
            rule: world.law().candidates[1].rule.clone(),
            salt: "salt-honest".into(),
        },
        ts: 20,
        proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
    };
    let body = body_for_signing(&ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(forged_reveal.clone()))?;
    forged_reveal.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&world_kp, &world_kp.sign(&body)));
    bad_reveal_log
        .records
        .push(ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(forged_reveal));
    assert!(verify_observation_log(&bad_reveal_log).is_err());

    // Attack 2: Dishonest host reports a lying probe reading (0 instead of 10 at x = 4)
    // and then reveals the true committed secret cut_at_3 -> caught retroactively on reveal!
    let mut lying_log = ObservationLog {
        world_id: world.world_id().clone(),
        law: world.law().clone(),
        hidden_commitment: world.log().hidden_commitment,
        records: vec![world.log().records[0].clone()],
    };
    let seed_hash = lying_log.records[0].hash()?;
    let mut lying_probe = ProbeRecorded {
        world_id: world.world_id().clone(),
        seq: 1,
        prev: seed_hash,
        actor_id: alice.did(),
        input: 4,
        readout_name: "exact".into(),
        cost: 2,
        remaining_budget: 0,
        reading: ProbeReading::Exact { value: 0 }, // lie! cut_at_3 gives 10 at x = 4
        prediction_matched: None,
        ts: 12,
        proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
    };
    let p_body = body_for_signing(&ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(lying_probe.clone()))?;
    lying_probe.proof = ProofOrArray::array(vec![
        Proof::create(&alice, &alice.sign(&p_body)),
        Proof::create(&world_kp, &world_kp.sign(&p_body)),
    ]);
    let probe_hash = ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(lying_probe.clone()).hash()?;
    lying_log
        .records
        .push(ObservationRecord::ProbeRecorded(lying_probe));

    // Before reveal, the lying probe is indistinguishable from an honest cut_at_5 world.
    verify_observation_log(&lying_log)?;

    // Once the committed secret (cut_at_3) is revealed, verification catches the lie!
    let mut true_reveal = SecretRevealed {
        world_id: world.world_id().clone(),
        seq: 2,
        prev: probe_hash,
        secret: HiddenSecret {
            model_index: 0,
            model_name: "cut_at_3".into(),
            rule: world.law().candidates[0].rule.clone(),
            salt: "salt-honest".into(),
        },
        ts: 25,
        proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
    };
    let r_body = body_for_signing(&ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(true_reveal.clone()))?;
    true_reveal.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&world_kp, &world_kp.sign(&r_body)));
    lying_log
        .records
        .push(ObservationRecord::SecretRevealed(true_reveal));
    assert!(verify_observation_log(&lying_log).is_err());

    // Attack 3: Unknown JSON field injected into ObservationLog is refused.
    let mut val = serde_json::to_value(&world.log()).unwrap();
    val["leaked_secret"] = serde_json::json!("cut_at_3");
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<ObservationLog>(val).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

You now have seven self-contained drop-in prototypes covering the core creative arcs from the transcript (contact, patterns, circuit, library, project, transform, and observe). Whenever Claude sends the next formal crate specification, we can pivot straight back to it—or if you want to prototype one more world mechanic next, Repair World (World Type #14: cooperative multi-station fault diagnosis where two participants hold partial views and test adjustments in a trial branch before committing a fix) pairs naturally with observe and circuit. How would you like to proceed?


::W have some time until Claude is free. Let’s keep going: ➡️


Here is the Repair World prototype (src/repair.rs and tests/repair.rs), turning World Type #14 and the cooperative multi-station diagnosis scenario from the transcript into a verifiable, drop-in Rust module (requiring only pub mod repair; in src/lib.rs and zero changes to existing crate files).
The prototype enforces five core invariants:
 * Asymmetric station views and partitioned controls: RoutingStation observes link topology, delays, and signal travel (RoutingView) and can adjust links within physical bounds, while TimingStation observes gate windows and pass/block timings (TimingView) and can adjust gate windows—neither station can inspect the other's hidden structure without communicating or explicitly swapping stations via assign_station.
 * Non-destructive trial branches: test_trial_branch clones the live mechanism, applies a candidate adjustment bundle, and evaluates the declared test suite against a finite trial budget without mutating live_config or consuming repair materials.
 * Authorized, budgeted commits: commit_adjustment requires the actor to occupy the station that owns the target control, enforces per-link and per-gate physical limits (min_delay, max_delay, max_close_at), deducts from material_budget, and logs the resulting configuration hash.
 * Honest coverage beyond the passing suite: Passing declared_suite does not claim universal correctness; simulate lets participants test out-of-suite edge cases and record any unresolved failure modes explicitly inside a signed, portable RepairReport.
 * Offline replay verification: verify_repair_log replays the full hash chain, dual signatures, station authorizations, budget accounting, trial outcomes, and final report consistency from RepairLog alone.
src/repair.rs
//! Repair World: cooperative multi-station fault diagnosis, non-destructive
//! trial branches, station-scoped commits, and offline-verifiable repair logs.

use crate::did::{DidKey, Keypair};
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::hash::{body_for_signing, hash_of};
use crate::proof::{Proof, ProofOrArray};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct LinkSpec {
    pub link_id: String,
    pub from: String,
    pub to: String,
    pub delay: u64,
    pub min_delay: u64,
    pub max_delay: u64,
    pub enabled: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GateSpec {
    pub gate_id: String,
    pub open_at: u64,
    pub close_at: u64,
    pub max_close_at: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MechanismConfig {
    pub source_node: String,
    pub sink_node: String,
    pub links: Vec<LinkSpec>,
    pub gates: Vec<GateSpec>,
}

impl MechanismConfig {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.source_node.trim().is_empty() || self.sink_node.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "mechanism: source_node and sink_node must be non-empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.links.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "mechanism: must declare at least one link".into(),
            ));
        }
        let mut seen_links = HashSet::new();
        for link in &self.links {
            if link.link_id.trim().is_empty() || !seen_links.insert(link.link_id.clone()) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: link_ids must be non-empty and unique".into(),
                ));
            }
            if link.from.trim().is_empty() || link.to.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: link endpoints must be non-empty".into(),
                ));
            }
            if link.min_delay == 0 || link.min_delay > link.max_delay {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: link min_delay must be >= 1 and <= max_delay".into(),
                ));
            }
            if link.delay < link.min_delay || link.delay > link.max_delay {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: link delay outside [min_delay, max_delay]".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let mut seen_gates = HashSet::new();
        for gate in &self.gates {
            if gate.gate_id.trim().is_empty() || !seen_gates.insert(gate.gate_id.clone()) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: gate_ids must be non-empty and unique".into(),
                ));
            }
            if gate.open_at > gate.close_at || gate.close_at > gate.max_close_at {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "mechanism: gate must satisfy open_at <= close_at <= max_close_at".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RepairTestCase {
    pub name: String,
    pub input_time: u64,
    pub max_delivery_time: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RepairLaw {
    pub topic: String,
    pub initial_config: MechanismConfig,
    pub declared_suite: Vec<RepairTestCase>,
    pub horizon: u64,
    pub material_budget: u64,
    pub max_trials: u64,
}

impl RepairLaw {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.topic.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("repair law: topic cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        self.initial_config.validate()?;
        if self.declared_suite.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "repair law: declared_suite must contain at least one test case".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.horizon == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy("repair law: horizon must be >= 1".into()));
        }
        let mut seen_cases = HashSet::new();
        for tc in &self.declared_suite {
            if tc.name.trim().is_empty() || !seen_cases.insert(tc.name.clone()) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "repair law: test case names must be non-empty and unique".into(),
                ));
            }
            if tc.input_time > tc.max_delivery_time || tc.max_delivery_time > self.horizon {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "repair law: test case must satisfy input_time <= max_delivery_time <= horizon"
                        .into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum StationRole {
    RoutingStation,
    TimingStation,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "adjustment", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Adjustment {
    SetLinkDelay { link_id: String, new_delay: u64 },
    SetLinkEnabled { link_id: String, enabled: bool },
    SetGateWindow {
        gate_id: String,
        open_at: u64,
        close_at: u64,
    },
}

impl Adjustment {
    pub fn required_station(&self) -> StationRole {
        match self {
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay { .. } | Adjustment::SetLinkEnabled { .. } => {
                StationRole::RoutingStation
            }
            Adjustment::SetGateWindow { .. } => StationRole::TimingStation,
        }
    }
}

pub fn apply_adjustment(config: &MechanismConfig, adj: &Adjustment) -> Result<MechanismConfig> {
    let mut next = config.clone();
    match adj {
        Adjustment::SetLinkDelay { link_id, new_delay } => {
            let link = next
                .links
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|l| &l.link_id == link_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy(format!("unknown link {:?}", link_id)))?;
            if *new_delay < link.min_delay || *new_delay > link.max_delay {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "link {:?} delay {} outside physical bounds [{}..={}]",
                    link_id, new_delay, link.min_delay, link.max_delay
                )));
            }
            link.delay = *new_delay;
        }
        Adjustment::SetLinkEnabled { link_id, enabled } => {
            let link = next
                .links
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|l| &l.link_id == link_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy(format!("unknown link {:?}", link_id)))?;
            link.enabled = *enabled;
        }
        Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
            gate_id,
            open_at,
            close_at,
        } => {
            let gate = next
                .gates
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|g| &g.gate_id == gate_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy(format!("unknown gate {:?}", gate_id)))?;
            if open_at > close_at || *close_at > gate.max_close_at {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "gate {:?} window [{}..={}] exceeds physical limit {}",
                    gate_id, open_at, close_at, gate.max_close_at
                )));
            }
            gate.open_at = *open_at;
            gate.close_at = *close_at;
        }
    }
    Ok(next)
}

// =====================================================================
// DETERMINISTIC MECHANISM SIMULATION & STATION-SCOPED VIEWS
// =====================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct LinkObservation {
    pub link_id: String,
    pub from: String,
    pub to: String,
    pub sent_at: u64,
    pub arrived_at: u64,
    pub within_horizon: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GateObservation {
    pub gate_id: String,
    pub arrival_time: u64,
    pub open_at: u64,
    pub close_at: u64,
    pub passed: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SimulationOutcome {
    pub input_time: u64,
    pub delivered_at: Option<u64>,
    pub link_events: Vec<LinkObservation>,
    pub gate_events: Vec<GateObservation>,
}

/// Pure deterministic propagation of one pulse injected at `source_node` at `input_time`.
/// Because every link has `delay >= 1`, simulation terminates strictly within `horizon`.
pub fn simulate(config: &MechanismConfig, input_time: u64, horizon: u64) -> SimulationOutcome {
    let mut arrivals: BTreeMap<u64, BTreeSet<String>> = BTreeMap::new();
    if input_time <= horizon {
        arrivals
            .entry(input_time)
            .or_default()
            .insert(config.source_node.clone());
    }

    let mut link_events = Vec::new();
    let mut gate_events = Vec::new();
    let mut delivered_at: Option<u64> = None;

    while let Some(&t) = arrivals.keys().next() {
        let nodes = arrivals.remove(&t).unwrap();
        if t > horizon {
            break;
        }
        for node in nodes {
            let mut passed = true;
            if let Some(gate) = config.gates.iter().find(|g| g.gate_id == node) {
                passed = gate.open_at <= t && t <= gate.close_at;
                gate_events.push(GateObservation {
                    gate_id: gate.gate_id.clone(),
                    arrival_time: t,
                    open_at: gate.open_at,
                    close_at: gate.close_at,
                    passed,
                });
            }
            if !passed {
                continue;
            }
            if node == config.sink_node && delivered_at.is_none() {
                delivered_at = Some(t);
            }
            for link in &config.links {
                if link.enabled && link.from == node {
                    let arrived_at = t.saturating_add(link.delay);
                    let within_horizon = arrived_at <= horizon;
                    link_events.push(LinkObservation {
                        link_id: link.link_id.clone(),
                        from: link.from.clone(),
                        to: link.to.clone(),
                        sent_at: t,
                        arrived_at,
                        within_horizon,
                    });
                    if within_horizon {
                        arrivals
                            .entry(arrived_at)
                            .or_default()
                            .insert(link.to.clone());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    SimulationOutcome {
        input_time,
        delivered_at,
        link_events,
        gate_events,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CaseResult {
    pub case_name: String,
    pub input_time: u64,
    pub max_delivery_time: u64,
    pub delivered_at: Option<u64>,
    pub passed: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SuiteResult {
    pub all_passed: bool,
    pub cases: Vec<CaseResult>,
}

pub fn run_suite(
    config: &MechanismConfig,
    suite: &[RepairTestCase],
    horizon: u64,
) -> SuiteResult {
    let mut cases = Vec::with_capacity(suite.len());
    for tc in suite {
        let outcome = simulate(config, tc.input_time, horizon);
        let passed = outcome
            .delivered_at
            .map(|d| d <= tc.max_delivery_time)
            .unwrap_or(false);
        cases.push(CaseResult {
            case_name: tc.name.clone(),
            input_time: tc.input_time,
            max_delivery_time: tc.max_delivery_time,
            delivered_at: outcome.delivered_at,
            passed,
        });
    }
    let all_passed = cases.iter().all(|c| c.passed);
    SuiteResult { all_passed, cases }
}

/// Partitioned partial observation exposed to one station.
/// Routing sees links only; Timing sees gate windows only.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "station_view", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum StationView {
    Routing {
        input_time: u64,
        links: Vec<LinkSpec>,
        link_events: Vec<LinkObservation>,
        delivered_at: Option<u64>,
    },
    Timing {
        input_time: u64,
        gates: Vec<GateSpec>,
        gate_events: Vec<GateObservation>,
        delivered_at: Option<u64>,
    },
}
