#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CheckSuiteRun {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub seq: u64,
    pub prev: String,
    pub actor_id: DidKey,
    pub config_hash: String,
    pub suite_result: SuiteResult,
    pub ts: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ReportExported {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub seq: u64,
    pub prev: String,
    pub report: RepairReport,
    pub ts: u64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum RepairRecord {
    WorldOpened(WorldOpened),
    ParticipantJoined(ParticipantJoined),
    StationAssigned(StationAssigned),
    TrialBranchTested(TrialBranchTested),
    AdjustmentCommitted(AdjustmentCommitted),
    CheckSuiteRun(CheckSuiteRun),
    ReportExported(ReportExported),
}

impl RepairRecord {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn seq(&self) -> u64 {
        match self {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(_) => 0,
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => r.seq,
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned(r) => r.seq,
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(r) => r.seq,
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(r) => r.seq,
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(r) => r.seq,
            RepairRecord::ReportExported(r) => r.seq,
        }
    }

    pub fn prev(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(_) => None,
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(r) => Some(&r.prev),
            RepairRecord::ReportExported(r) => Some(&r.prev),
        }
    }

    pub fn world_id(&self) -> &DidKey {
        match self {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(r) => &r.world_id,
            RepairRecord::ReportExported(r) => &r.world_id,
        }
    }

    pub fn proof(&self) -> &ProofOrArray {
        match self {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(r) => &r.proof,
            RepairRecord::ReportExported(r) => &r.proof,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RepairLog {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub law: RepairLaw,
    pub records: Vec<RepairRecord>,
}

// =====================================================================
// EXECUTABLE REPAIR WORLD & OFFLINE VERIFIER
// =====================================================================

fn sign_repair_dual<T, F>(
    mut rec: T,
    actor: &Keypair,
    world: &Keypair,
    wrap: fn(T) -> RepairRecord,
    set_proof: F,
) -> Result<T>
where
    T: Clone,
    F: FnOnce(&mut T, ProofOrArray),
{
    let body = body_for_signing(&wrap(rec.clone()))?;
    let a_sig = actor.sign(&body);
    let w_sig = world.sign(&body);
    set_proof(
        &mut rec,
        ProofOrArray::array(vec![
            Proof::create(actor, &a_sig),
            Proof::create(world, &w_sig),
        ]),
    );
    Ok(rec)
}

pub struct RepairWorld {
    world_id: DidKey,
    law: RepairLaw,
    keypair: Keypair,
    participants: HashSet<DidKey>,
    stations: HashMap<DidKey, StationRole>,
    live_config: MechanismConfig,
    committed_adjustments: Vec<Adjustment>,
    remaining_material: u64,
    remaining_trials: u64,
    records: Vec<RepairRecord>,
}

impl RepairWorld {
    pub fn open(
        law: RepairLaw,
        world_kp: Keypair,
        creator_kp: &Keypair,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        law.validate()?;
        let world_id = world_kp.did();
        let creator_id = creator_kp.did();
        let live_config = law.initial_config.clone();
        let remaining_material = law.material_budget;
        let remaining_trials = law.max_trials;

        let opened = WorldOpened {
            world_id: world_id.clone(),
            law: law.clone(),
            creator_id: creator_id.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            opened,
            creator_kp,
            &world_kp,
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let mut participants = HashSet::new();
        participants.insert(creator_id);

        Ok(RepairWorld {
            world_id,
            law,
            keypair: world_kp,
            participants,
            stations: HashMap::new(),
            live_config,
            committed_adjustments: Vec::new(),
            remaining_material,
            remaining_trials,
            records: vec![RepairRecord::WorldOpened(signed)],
        })
    }

    pub fn world_id(&self) -> &DidKey {
        &self.world_id
    }

    pub fn law(&self) -> &RepairLaw {
        &self.law
    }

    pub fn live_config(&self) -> &MechanismConfig {
        &self.live_config
    }

    pub fn remaining_material(&self) -> u64 {
        self.remaining_material
    }

    pub fn remaining_trials(&self) -> u64 {
        self.remaining_trials
    }

    pub fn log(&self) -> RepairLog {
        RepairLog {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            law: self.law.clone(),
            records: self.records.clone(),
        }
    }

    fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {
        self.records.len() as u64
    }

    fn last_hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        self.records
            .last()
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Chain("repair world has no seed record".into()))?
            .hash()
    }

    pub fn join(&mut self, participant_kp: &Keypair, now: u64) -> Result<RepairRecord> {
        let pid = participant_kp.did();
        if self.participants.contains(&pid) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("participant already joined".into()));
        }
        let rec = ParticipantJoined {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            participant_id: pid.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            participant_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let wrapped = RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(signed);
        self.participants.insert(pid);
        self.records.push(wrapped.clone());
        Ok(wrapped)
    }

    /// Take or revisit a station. Changing stations allows collaborators to
    /// inspect the view their partner was seeing.
    pub fn assign_station(
        &mut self,
        participant_kp: &Keypair,
        station: StationRole,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<RepairRecord> {
        let pid = participant_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&pid) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        let rec = StationAssigned {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            participant_id: pid.clone(),
            station,
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            participant_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let wrapped = RepairRecord::StationAssigned(signed);
        self.stations.insert(pid, station);
        self.records.push(wrapped.clone());
        Ok(wrapped)
    }

    /// Read-only partial observation scoped strictly to the actor's current station.
    pub fn inspect_station(&self, actor_id: &DidKey, input_time: u64) -> Result<StationView> {
        if !self.participants.contains(actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        let Some(&station) = self.stations.get(actor_id) else {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor has not taken a station yet".into()));
        };
        if input_time > self.law.horizon {
            return Err(Error::Policy("input_time exceeds world horizon".into()));
        }
        let outcome = simulate(&self.live_config, input_time, self.law.horizon);
        match station {
            StationRole::RoutingStation => Ok(StationView::Routing {
                input_time,
                links: self.live_config.links.clone(),
                link_events: outcome.link_events,
                delivered_at: outcome.delivered_at,
            }),
            StationRole::TimingStation => Ok(StationView::Timing {
                input_time,
                gates: self.live_config.gates.clone(),
                gate_events: outcome.gate_events,
                delivered_at: outcome.delivered_at,
            }),
        }
    }

    /// Evaluates a proposed sequence of adjustments in an isolated trial branch
    /// against `declared_suite` without mutating `live_config` or spending materials.
    pub fn test_trial_branch(
        &mut self,
        actor_kp: &Keypair,
        branch_id: &str,
        adjustments: Vec<Adjustment>,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<SuiteResult> {
        let actor_id = actor_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        if branch_id.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("branch_id cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        if adjustments.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "trial branch requires at least one adjustment".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.remaining_trials == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy("trial branch budget exhausted".into()));
        }

        let mut trial_cfg = self.live_config.clone();
        for adj in &adjustments {
            trial_cfg = apply_adjustment(&trial_cfg, adj)?;
        }
        let suite_result = run_suite(&trial_cfg, &self.law.declared_suite, self.law.horizon);
        let next_trials = self.remaining_trials - 1;

        let rec = TrialBranchTested {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            actor_id,
            branch_id: branch_id.to_string(),
            adjustments,
            suite_result: suite_result.clone(),
            remaining_trials: next_trials,
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            actor_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        self.remaining_trials = next_trials;
        self.records.push(RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(signed));
        Ok(suite_result)
    }

    /// Commits one adjustment to `live_config`, requiring the actor to occupy
    /// the station that owns that control and spending 1 material unit.
    pub fn commit_adjustment(
        &mut self,
        actor_kp: &Keypair,
        adjustment: Adjustment,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<RepairRecord> {
        let actor_id = actor_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        let Some(&station) = self.stations.get(&actor_id) else {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor has not taken a station yet".into()));
        };
        let required = adjustment.required_station();
        if station != required {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "adjustment requires {:?}, but actor occupies {:?}",
                required, station
            )));
        }
        if self.remaining_material == 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy("repair material budget exhausted".into()));
        }

        let next_cfg = apply_adjustment(&self.live_config, &adjustment)?;
        let config_hash = next_cfg.hash()?;
        let next_material = self.remaining_material - 1;

        let rec = AdjustmentCommitted {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            actor_id,
            station,
            adjustment: adjustment.clone(),
            remaining_material: next_material,
            config_hash,
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            actor_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        let wrapped = RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(signed);
        self.live_config = next_cfg;
        self.committed_adjustments.push(adjustment);
        self.remaining_material = next_material;
        self.records.push(wrapped.clone());
        Ok(wrapped)
    }

    pub fn run_check_suite(&mut self, actor_kp: &Keypair, now: u64) -> Result<SuiteResult> {
        let actor_id = actor_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&actor_id) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("actor is not a participant".into()));
        }
        let config_hash = self.live_config.hash()?;
        let suite_result = run_suite(
            &self.live_config,
            &self.law.declared_suite,
            self.law.horizon,
        );
        let rec = CheckSuiteRun {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            actor_id,
            config_hash,
            suite_result: suite_result.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            actor_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        self.records.push(RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(signed));
        Ok(suite_result)
    }

    pub fn export_report(
        &mut self,
        author_kp: &Keypair,
        unresolved_cases: Vec<String>,
        lesson_note: &str,
        now: u64,
    ) -> Result<RepairReport> {
        let author = author_kp.did();
        if !self.participants.contains(&author) {
            return Err(Error::Policy("author is not a participant".into()));
        }
        if lesson_note.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("lesson_note cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        let checked_suite = run_suite(
            &self.live_config,
            &self.law.declared_suite,
            self.law.horizon,
        );
        let report = RepairReport {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            final_config: self.live_config.clone(),
            committed_adjustments: self.committed_adjustments.clone(),
            checked_suite,
            unresolved_cases,
            lesson_note: lesson_note.to_string(),
            author,
        };
        let rec = ReportExported {
            world_id: self.world_id.clone(),
            seq: self.next_seq(),
            prev: self.last_hash()?,
            report: report.clone(),
            ts: now,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let signed = sign_repair_dual(
            rec,
            author_kp,
            &self.keypair,
            RepairRecord::ReportExported,
            |r, p| r.proof = p,
        )?;
        self.records.push(RepairRecord::ReportExported(signed));
        Ok(report)
    }
}

/// Independently replays and verifies an entire `RepairLog` offline.
pub fn verify_repair_log(log: &RepairLog) -> Result<()> {
    log.law.validate()?;
    let Some(RepairRecord::WorldOpened(seed)) = log.records.first() else {
        return Err(Error::Chain(
            "repair log must start with world_opened".into(),
        ));
    };
    if seed.world_id != log.world_id {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "repair log: seed world_id mismatch".into(),
        ));
    }
    if seed.law.hash()? != log.law.hash()? {
        return Err(Error::Verification(
            "repair log: seed law does not match log law".into(),
        ));
    }

    let mut prev: Option<String> = None;
    let mut participants: HashSet<DidKey> = HashSet::new();
    let mut stations: HashMap<DidKey, StationRole> = HashMap::new();
    let mut live_config = log.law.initial_config.clone();
    let mut committed_adjustments: Vec<Adjustment> = Vec::new();
    let mut remaining_material = log.law.material_budget;
    let mut remaining_trials = log.law.max_trials;

    for (i, rec) in log.records.iter().enumerate() {
        if rec.seq() != i as u64 {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "repair log record {i}: seq {} != expected {i}",
                rec.seq()
            )));
        }
        if rec.world_id() != &log.world_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "repair log record {i}: world_id mismatch"
            )));
        }
        match rec {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(_) => {
                if i != 0 {
                    return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                        "repair log record {i}: world_opened not at start"
                    )));
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if rec.prev() != prev.as_deref() {
                    return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                        "repair log record {i}: prev hash mismatch"
                    )));
                }
            }
        }

        let body = body_for_signing(rec)?;
        let world_proof = rec
            .proof()
            .find_by_method(&log.world_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing world proof")))?;
        world_proof.verify(&body)?;

        match rec {
            RepairRecord::WorldOpened(r) => {
                let cp = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.creator_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("seed: missing creator proof".into()))?;
                cp.verify(&body)?;
                participants.insert(r.creator_id.clone());
            }
            RepairRecord::ParticipantJoined(r) => {
                if !participants.insert(r.participant_id.clone()) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: participant already joined"
                    )));
                }
                let pp = r.proof.find_by_method(&r.participant_id).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing participant proof"))
                })?;
                pp.verify(&body)?;
            }
            RepairRecord::StationAssigned(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.participant_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: station assignee not a participant"
                    )));
                }
                let pp = r.proof.find_by_method(&r.participant_id).ok_or_else(|| {
                    Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing participant proof"))
                })?;
                pp.verify(&body)?;
                stations.insert(r.participant_id.clone(), r.station);
            }
            RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.actor_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: actor not a participant")));
                }
                if r.adjustments.is_empty() {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: trial branch has no adjustments"
                    )));
                }
                if remaining_trials == 0 {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: trial branch exceeds max_trials"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_trials = remaining_trials - 1;
                if r.remaining_trials != expected_trials {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: remaining_trials {} != expected {}",
                        r.remaining_trials, expected_trials
                    )));
                }
                let mut trial_cfg = live_config.clone();
                for adj in &r.adjustments {
                    trial_cfg = apply_adjustment(&trial_cfg, adj)?;
                }
                let expected_suite = run_suite(&trial_cfg, &log.law.declared_suite, log.law.horizon);
                if r.suite_result != expected_suite {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: trial suite_result does not match deterministic replay"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.actor_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing actor proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
                remaining_trials = expected_trials;
            }
            RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.actor_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: actor not a participant")));
                }
                let Some(&occupied) = stations.get(&r.actor_id) else {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: actor has no assigned station"
                    )));
                };
                if occupied != r.station || r.station != r.adjustment.required_station() {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: station authorization mismatch for adjustment"
                    )));
                }
                if remaining_material == 0 {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: material budget exhausted"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_material = remaining_material - 1;
                if r.remaining_material != expected_material {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: remaining_material {} != expected {}",
                        r.remaining_material, expected_material
                    )));
                }
                let next_cfg = apply_adjustment(&live_config, &r.adjustment)?;
                if r.config_hash != next_cfg.hash()? {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: committed config_hash mismatch"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.actor_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing actor proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
                live_config = next_cfg;
                committed_adjustments.push(r.adjustment.clone());
                remaining_material = expected_material;
            }
            RepairRecord::CheckSuiteRun(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.actor_id) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!("record {i}: actor not a participant")));
                }
                if r.config_hash != live_config.hash()? {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: check suite config_hash mismatch"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_suite =
                    run_suite(&live_config, &log.law.declared_suite, log.law.horizon);
                if r.suite_result != expected_suite {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: check suite_result mismatch"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.actor_id)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing actor proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
            }
            RepairRecord::ReportExported(r) => {
                if !participants.contains(&r.report.author) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "record {i}: report author not a participant"
                    )));
                }
                let expected_suite =
                    run_suite(&live_config, &log.law.declared_suite, log.law.horizon);
                if r.report.world_id != log.world_id
                    || r.report.final_config != live_config
                    || r.report.committed_adjustments != committed_adjustments
                    || r.report.checked_suite != expected_suite
                {
                    return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                        "record {i}: exported report does not match world state"
                    )));
                }
                let ap = r
                    .proof
                    .find_by_method(&r.report.author)
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification(format!("record {i}: missing author proof")))?;
                ap.verify(&body)?;
            }
        }

        prev = Some(rec.hash()?);
    }

    Ok(())
}

tests/repair.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::hash::body_for_signing;
use chat_world::repair::{
    apply_adjustment, simulate, verify_repair_log, Adjustment, AdjustmentCommitted, GateSpec,
    LinkSpec, MechanismConfig, RepairLaw, RepairLog, RepairRecord, RepairTestCase, RepairWorld,
    StationRole, StationView,
};
use chat_world::{Keypair, Proof, ProofOrArray};

fn sample_repair_law() -> RepairLaw {
    // Source -> Relay (link_a: 4, min 3) -> Sink (link_b: 6, min 5)
    // Relay gate: [2..=5] (max_close 5)
    // Sink gate:  [5..=8] (max_close 9)
    // Declared suite: input_time 0 and input_time 1, both must deliver by t <= 12.
    // Neither station can pass both cases alone under its physical limits!
    RepairLaw {
        topic: "Restore pulse delivery across relay and sink gates".into(),
        initial_config: MechanismConfig {
            source_node: "source".into(),
            sink_node: "sink".into(),
            links: vec![
                LinkSpec {
                    link_id: "link_a".into(),
                    from: "source".into(),
                    to: "relay".into(),
                    delay: 4,
                    min_delay: 3,
                    max_delay: 10,
                    enabled: true,
                },
                LinkSpec {
                    link_id: "link_b".into(),
                    from: "relay".into(),
                    to: "sink".into(),
                    delay: 6,
                    min_delay: 5,
                    max_delay: 10,
                    enabled: true,
                },
            ],
            gates: vec![
                GateSpec {
                    gate_id: "relay".into(),
                    open_at: 2,
                    close_at: 5,
                    max_close_at: 5,
                },
                GateSpec {
                    gate_id: "sink".into(),
                    open_at: 5,
                    close_at: 8,
                    max_close_at: 9,
                },
            ],
        },
        declared_suite: vec![
            RepairTestCase {
                name: "nominal_pulse".into(),
                input_time: 0,
                max_delivery_time: 12,
            },
            RepairTestCase {
                name: "shifted_pulse".into(),
                input_time: 1,
                max_delivery_time: 12,
            },
        ],
        horizon: 15,
        material_budget: 4,
        max_trials: 4,
    }
}

#[test]
fn cooperative_two_station_diagnosis_trial_branches_swap_and_honest_report() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let bob = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();

    let mut world = RepairWorld::open(sample_repair_law(), world_kp, &alice, 100)?;
    world.join(&bob, 101)?;

    // 1. Alice takes RoutingStation; Bob takes TimingStation.
    world.assign_station(&alice, StationRole::RoutingStation, 102)?;
    world.assign_station(&bob, StationRole::TimingStation, 103)?;

    // 2. Asymmetric partial views on input_time = 0:
    //    Alice sees links delivering a pulse to `sink` at t = 10, with no gate info.
    //    Bob sees `gate_sink` closing at t = 8 before the pulse arrives at t = 10, with no link info.
    let alice_view = world.inspect_station(&alice.did(), 0)?;
    let bob_view = world.inspect_station(&bob.did(), 0)?;

    let alice_json = serde_json::to_string(&alice_view).unwrap();
    let bob_json = serde_json::to_string(&bob_view).unwrap();
    assert!(!alice_json.contains("open_at"));
    assert!(!alice_json.contains("close_at"));
    assert!(!bob_json.contains("link_a"));
    assert!(!bob_json.contains("link_b"));

    match alice_view {
        StationView::Routing {
            link_events,
            delivered_at,
            ..
        } => {
            assert_eq!(delivered_at, None);
            assert_eq!(link_events.last().unwrap().arrived_at, 10);
        }
        _ => panic!("expected Routing view"),
    }
    match bob_view {
        StationView::Timing {
            gate_events,
            delivered_at,
            ..
        } => {
            assert_eq!(delivered_at, None);
            let sink_ev = gate_events.iter().find(|g| g.gate_id == "sink").unwrap();
            assert_eq!(sink_ev.arrival_time, 10);
            assert_eq!(sink_ev.close_at, 8);
            assert!(!sink_ev.passed);
        }
        _ => panic!("expected Timing view"),
    }

    // 3. Trial 1 (Routing adjustments alone): improves nominal_pulse (passes at t = 8),
    //    but shifted_pulse still arrives at t = 9 and fails [5..=8]!
    let trial1 = world.test_trial_branch(
        &alice,
        "trial-routing-only",
        vec![
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_a".into(),
                new_delay: 3,
            },
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_b".into(),
                new_delay: 5,
            },
        ],
        110,
    )?;
    assert!(!trial1.all_passed);
    assert!(trial1.cases[0].passed); // nominal_pulse passes
    assert!(!trial1.cases[1].passed); // shifted_pulse still fails
    // Trial branch did not mutate live_config or spend material.
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_material(), 4);
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_trials(), 3);

    // 4. Trial 2 (Timing adjustment alone): still fails both cases.
    let trial2 = world.test_trial_branch(
        &bob,
        "trial-timing-only",
        vec![Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
            gate_id: "sink".into(),
            open_at: 5,
            close_at: 9,
        }],
        112,
    )?;
    assert!(!trial2.all_passed);
    assert!(!trial2.cases[0].passed);
    assert!(!trial2.cases[1].passed);

    // 5. Trial 3 (Coordinated cross-station repair): passes full declared suite!
    let trial3 = world.test_trial_branch(
        &alice,
        "trial-coordinated",
        vec![
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_a".into(),
                new_delay: 3,
            },
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_b".into(),
                new_delay: 5,
            },
            Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
                gate_id: "sink".into(),
                open_at: 5,
                close_at: 9,
            },
        ],
        115,
    )?;
    assert!(trial3.all_passed);

    // 6. Each collaborator commits the adjustments owned by their own station.
    //    Alice cannot commit Bob's gate change from RoutingStation.
    assert!(world
        .commit_adjustment(
            &alice,
            Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
                gate_id: "sink".into(),
                open_at: 5,
                close_at: 9,
            },
            118,
        )
        .is_err());

    world.commit_adjustment(
        &alice,
        Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
            link_id: "link_a".into(),
            new_delay: 3,
        },
        120,
    )?;
    world.commit_adjustment(
        &alice,
        Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
            link_id: "link_b".into(),
            new_delay: 5,
        },
        121,
    )?;
    world.commit_adjustment(
        &bob,
        Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
            gate_id: "sink".into(),
            open_at: 5,
            close_at: 9,
        },
        122,
    )?;
    assert_eq!(world.remaining_material(), 1);

    // 7. Run official check suite on live_config -> passes!
    let live_suite = world.run_check_suite(&bob, 125)?;
    assert!(live_suite.all_passed);

    // 8. Check an untested case outside declared_suite: input_time = 2 still misses sink gate (t = 10 > 9).
    let untested = simulate(world.live_config(), 2, world.law().horizon);
    assert_eq!(untested.delivered_at, None);

    // 9. Swap stations so Alice inspects Bob's Timing view and Bob inspects Alice's Routing view.
    world.assign_station(&alice, StationRole::TimingStation, 130)?;
    world.assign_station(&bob, StationRole::RoutingStation, 131)?;
    assert!(matches!(
        world.inspect_station(&alice.did(), 0)?,
        StationView::Timing {
            delivered_at: Some(8),
            ..
        }
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        world.inspect_station(&bob.did(), 1)?,
        StationView::Routing {
            delivered_at: Some(9),
            ..
        }
    ));

    // 10. Export honest RepairReport noting the unresolved edge case and collaborative lesson.
    let report = world.export_report(
        &alice,
        vec!["input_time=2 still arrives at sink at t=10 after gate_sink closes at t=9".into()],
        "When collaborators disagree, examine how their station observations differ.".into(),
        140,
    )?;
    assert!(report.checked_suite.all_passed);
    assert_eq!(report.committed_adjustments.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(report.unresolved_cases.len(), 1);

    // Round-trip RepairLog through JSON and verify offline.
    let json = serde_json::to_string(&world.log()).unwrap();
    let restored: RepairLog = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
    verify_repair_log(&restored)?;

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn physical_bounds_material_budget_and_log_forgeries_are_refused() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();
    let mut law = sample_repair_law();
    law.material_budget = 1;
    law.max_trials = 1;

    let mut world = RepairWorld::open(law, world_kp.clone(), &alice, 10)?;
    world.assign_station(&alice, StationRole::RoutingStation, 11)?;

    // Physical lower bound violation: link_b min_delay is 5, so setting 4 is refused.
    assert!(world
        .commit_adjustment(
            &alice,
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_b".into(),
                new_delay: 4,
            },
            12,
        )
        .is_err());

    // Spending the single material unit succeeds; a second commit is refused.
    world.commit_adjustment(
        &alice,
        Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
            link_id: "link_a".into(),
            new_delay: 3,
        },
        13,
    )?;
    assert!(world
        .commit_adjustment(
            &alice,
            Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
                link_id: "link_b".into(),
                new_delay: 5,
            },
            14,
        )
        .is_err());

    // Forgery 1: tamper with a trial branch's suite_result to claim all_passed = true.
    world.test_trial_branch(
        &alice,
        "honest-failing-trial",
        vec![Adjustment::SetLinkDelay {
            link_id: "link_b".into(),
            new_delay: 5,
        }],
        15,
    )?;
    let mut forged_trial = world.log();
    if let RepairRecord::TrialBranchTested(t) = forged_trial.records.last_mut().unwrap() {
        t.suite_result.all_passed = true;
    }
    assert!(verify_repair_log(&forged_trial).is_err());

    // Forgery 2: properly dual-sign a station-unauthorized commit in the log -> refused.
    let mut forged_commit_log = world.log();
    let prev = forged_commit_log.records.last().unwrap().hash()?;
    let illegal_adj = Adjustment::SetGateWindow {
        gate_id: "sink".into(),
        open_at: 5,
        close_at: 9,
    };
    let next_cfg = apply_adjustment(world.live_config(), &illegal_adj)?;
    let mut forged_rec = AdjustmentCommitted {
        world_id: world.world_id().clone(),
        seq: forged_commit_log.records.len() as u64,
        prev,
        actor_id: alice.did(),
        station: StationRole::RoutingStation, // wrong station for SetGateWindow!
        adjustment: illegal_adj,
        remaining_material: 0,
        config_hash: next_cfg.hash()?,
        ts: 20,
        proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
    };
    let body = body_for_signing(&RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(forged_rec.clone()))?;
    forged_rec.proof = ProofOrArray::array(vec![
        Proof::create(&alice, &alice.sign(&body)),
        Proof::create(&world_kp, &world_kp.sign(&body)),
    ]);
    forged_commit_log
        .records
        .push(RepairRecord::AdjustmentCommitted(forged_rec));
    assert!(verify_repair_log(&forged_commit_log).is_err());

    // Forgery 3: unknown JSON field injected into RepairLog is rejected.
    let mut val = serde_json::to_value(&world.log()).unwrap();
    val["hidden_answer"] = serde_json::json!("link_a=3");
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<RepairLog>(val).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

::Perfect. Keep going: ➡️


Here is the Retelling World prototype (src/retelling.rs and tests/retelling.rs), turning World Type #12 and the midday cross-medium transformation scene from the transcript into a verifiable, drop-in Rust module (requiring only pub mod retelling; in src/lib.rs and zero changes to existing crate files).
The prototype enforces five core invariants:
 * Explicit transformation accounts: Every retelling must carry a signed TransformationAccount naming what was preserved, what changed, what proved hard_to_express (enforced non-empty when law.require_explicit_losses is set), and what was added_by_interpreter—separating source inheritance from each participant's own contribution.
 * Branching DAG and multi-parent synthesis: Seeds (NativeSeed or ImportedArtifact from another world) and retellings form an append-only, content-addressed DAG where multiple interpretations can branch from the same work without overwriting one another, or converge into a multi-parent synthesis.
 * Bidirectional lineage and attribution queries: ancestry_chain, descendants, shared_ancestors, and trace_attribution walk the graph forward and backward so any visitor can trace where a choice entered or what downstream works grew out of an earlier artifact.
 * Verified non-destructive comparisons and open invitations: record_comparison logs shared elements and divergences between two parallel branches while verifying that any claimed common_ancestor_hash actually lies in both ancestries, and leave_invitation anchors an open prompt to existing work hashes for future visitors.
 * Offline replay verification: verify_retelling_log checks the full hash chain, dual signatures, medium policy, unique node IDs, content digests, DAG causality, ancestor claims, and strict JSON deserialization (deny_unknown_fields).
src/retelling.rs
//! Retelling World: cross-medium transformation chains, explicit preservation
//! and loss accounts, branching comparisons, and bidirectional lineage queries.

use crate::did::{DidKey, Keypair};
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::hash::{body_for_signing, hash_of, sha256_hex};
use crate::proof::{Proof, ProofOrArray};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet, VecDeque};

fn looks_like_hash(s: &str) -> bool {
    s.len() == 64 && s.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit())
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "medium", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Medium {
    Poem,
    ProseScene,
    VisualPattern,
    MusicalScore,
    RelationDiagram,
    WorldTemplate,
    Custom { name: String },
}

impl Medium {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if let Medium::Custom { name } = self {
            if name.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy("custom medium name cannot be empty".into()));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "policy", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum MediumPolicy {
    Any,
    Restricted { allowed: Vec<Medium> },
}

impl MediumPolicy {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if let MediumPolicy::Restricted { allowed } = self {
            if allowed.is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "restricted medium policy must allow at least one medium".into(),
                ));
            }
            for m in allowed {
                m.validate()?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn permits(&self, medium: &Medium) -> bool {
        match self {
            MediumPolicy::Any => true,
            MediumPolicy::Restricted { allowed } => allowed.contains(medium),
        }
    }
}

/// Distinguishes a work created natively inside this room from an external
/// artifact carried in from another world (such as a Transformation World).
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "origin", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SourceOrigin {
    NativeSeed,
    ImportedArtifact {
        source_world_id: DidKey,
        artifact_hash: String,
        label: String,
    },
}

impl SourceOrigin {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if let SourceOrigin::ImportedArtifact {
            artifact_hash,
            label,
            ..
        } = self
        {
            if !looks_like_hash(artifact_hash) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "imported artifact_hash must be 64 hex chars".into(),
                ));
            }
            if label.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(Error::Policy(
                    "imported artifact label cannot be empty".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Attributable account attached to every retelling step, separating what
/// came from the source from what this interpreter altered or contributed.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct TransformationAccount {
    pub preserved: Vec<String>,
    pub changed: Vec<String>,
    pub hard_to_express: Vec<String>,
    pub added_by_interpreter: Vec<String>,
}

impl TransformationAccount {
    pub fn validate(&self, require_explicit_losses: bool) -> Result<()> {
        if self.preserved.is_empty() || self.preserved.iter().any(|s| s.trim().is_empty()) {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "transformation account must name at least one preserved element".into(),
            ));
        }
        if require_explicit_losses && self.hard_to_express.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "world law requires listing at least one hard_to_express element".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RetellingLaw {
    pub topic: String,
    pub medium_policy: MediumPolicy,
    pub require_explicit_losses: bool,
    pub allow_external_imports: bool,
}

impl RetellingLaw {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.topic.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("retelling law: topic cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        self.medium_policy.validate()
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ComparisonRecorded {

    pub seq: u64,
    pub prev: String,
    pub left_node_hash: String,
    pub right_node_hash: String,

    pub shared_elements: Vec<String>,
    pub divergences: Vec<String>,

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct InvitationLeft {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub seq: u64,
    pub prev: String,
    pub anchor_node_hashes: Vec<String>,
