) -> Result<(BTreeMap<String, UnitState>, Vec<SynapseWeights>)> {
    let mut in_r: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut in_b: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut in_y: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut ext_r: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut syn_r: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();

    for u in &topology.units {
        let ext = external_inputs.get(&u.id).copied().unwrap_or_default();
        let er = ext.red.max(0);
        in_r.insert(u.id.as_str(), er);
        in_b.insert(u.id.as_str(), ext.blue.max(0));
        in_y.insert(u.id.as_str(), ext.yellow.max(0));
        ext_r.insert(u.id.as_str(), er);
        syn_r.insert(u.id.as_str(), 0);
    }
    for key in external_inputs.keys() {
        if !in_r.contains_key(key.as_str()) {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "external input targets unknown unit {:?}",
                key
            )));
        }
    }

    for (spec, w) in topology.synapses.iter().zip(prev_weights.iter()) {
        let pre_out = prev_units[&spec.from].output;
        let eff_r = w.effective_red();
        let dr = (((eff_r as i128) * (pre_out.red as i128)) / (SCALE as i128)).max(0) as i64;
        let db =
            (((spec.base_blue as i128) * (pre_out.blue as i128)) / (SCALE as i128)).max(0) as i64;
        let dy = (((spec.base_yellow as i128) * (pre_out.yellow as i128)) / (SCALE as i128))
            .max(0) as i64;
        *in_r.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += dr;
        *syn_r.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += dr;
        *in_b.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += db;
        *in_y.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += dy;
    }

    let mut next_units = BTreeMap::new();
    for u in &topology.units {
        let incoming = TriSignal {
            red: in_r[u.id.as_str()],
            blue: in_b[u.id.as_str()],
            yellow: in_y[u.id.as_str()],
        };
        let next_st = u.kind.step(&prev_units[&u.id], incoming);
        next_units.insert(u.id.clone(), next_st);
    }

    let mut next_weights = Vec::with_capacity(topology.synapses.len());
    for (spec, &w) in topology.synapses.iter().zip(prev_weights.iter()) {
        let pre_r = prev_units[&spec.from].output.red;
        let post = &next_units[&spec.to];
        next_weights.push(update_synapse(
            spec,
            w,
            pre_r,
            post.output.red,
            ext_r[spec.to.as_str()],
            syn_r[spec.to.as_str()],
            post.yellow_level,
        ));
    }

    Ok((next_units, next_weights))
}

pub struct NeuralCluster {
    keypair: Keypair,
    topology: ClusterTopology,
    unit_states: BTreeMap<String, UnitState>,
    synapse_weights: Vec<SynapseWeights>,
    ticks: Vec<ClusterTickRecord>,
}

impl NeuralCluster {
    pub fn new(
        name: &str,
        keypair: Keypair,
        units: Vec<UnitSpec>,
        synapses: Vec<SynapseSpec>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        let topology = ClusterTopology {
            cluster_id: keypair.did(),
            name: name.to_string(),
            units,
            synapses,
        };
        topology.validate()?;

        let mut unit_states = BTreeMap::new();
        for u in &topology.units {
            unit_states.insert(u.id.clone(), UnitState::for_kind(&u.kind));
        }
        let synapse_weights = topology
            .synapses
            .iter()
            .map(|s| SynapseWeights {
                base_red: s.base_red,
                fast_red: 0,
            })
            .collect();

        Ok(NeuralCluster {
            keypair,
            topology,
            unit_states,
            synapse_weights,
            ticks: Vec::new(),
        })
    }

    pub fn unit_state(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&UnitState> {
        self.unit_states.get(id)
    }

    pub fn synapse_weights(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> Option<SynapseWeights> {
        self.topology
            .synapses
            .iter()
            .position(|s| s.from == from && s.to == to)
            .map(|idx| self.synapse_weights[idx])
    }

    pub fn step(
        &mut self,
        external_inputs: BTreeMap<String, TriSignal>,
    ) -> Result<ClusterTickRecord> {
        let (next_units, next_weights) = step_cluster_pure(
            &self.topology,
            &self.unit_states,
            &self.synapse_weights,
            &external_inputs,
        )?;
        let prev = match self.ticks.last() {
            Some(r) => Some(r.hash()?),
            None => None,
        };
        let mut rec = ClusterTickRecord {
            cluster_id: self.topology.cluster_id.clone(),
            tick: self.ticks.len() as u64,
            prev,
            external_inputs,
            unit_states: next_units.clone(),
            synapse_weights: next_weights.clone(),
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&rec)?;
        let sig = self.keypair.sign(&body);
        rec.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&self.keypair, &sig));

        self.unit_states = next_units;
        self.synapse_weights = next_weights;
        self.ticks.push(rec.clone());
        Ok(rec)
    }

    pub fn trace(&self) -> ClusterTrace {
        ClusterTrace {
            topology: self.topology.clone(),
            ticks: self.ticks.clone(),
        }
    }
}

/// Independently replays and verifies an entire `ClusterTrace` offline, checking
/// topology validity, hash chain, cluster signatures, every unit state (including
/// delay buffers and Purkinje fast taps), and every dissolving synapse weight.
pub fn verify_cluster_trace(trace: &ClusterTrace) -> Result<()> {
    trace.topology.validate()?;

    let mut cur_units = BTreeMap::new();
    for u in &trace.topology.units {
        cur_units.insert(u.id.clone(), UnitState::for_kind(&u.kind));
    }
    let mut cur_weights: Vec<SynapseWeights> = trace
        .topology
        .synapses
        .iter()
        .map(|s| SynapseWeights {
            base_red: s.base_red,
            fast_red: 0,
        })
        .collect();
    let mut prev: Option<String> = None;

    for (idx, rec) in trace.ticks.iter().enumerate() {
        if rec.tick != idx as u64 {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "cluster trace: tick {} != expected {}",
                rec.tick, idx
            )));
        }
        if rec.cluster_id != trace.topology.cluster_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "cluster trace tick {idx}: cluster_id mismatch"
            )));
        }
        if rec.prev != prev {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "cluster trace tick {idx}: prev hash mismatch"
            )));
        }
        rec.verify()?;

        let (expected_units, expected_weights) = step_cluster_pure(
            &trace.topology,
            &cur_units,
            &cur_weights,
            &rec.external_inputs,
        )?;
        if rec.unit_states != expected_units {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "cluster trace tick {idx}: unit_states mismatch"
            )));
        }
        if rec.synapse_weights != expected_weights {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "cluster trace tick {idx}: synapse_weights mismatch"
            )));
        }

        cur_units = expected_units;
        cur_weights = expected_weights;
        prev = Some(rec.hash()?);
    }

    Ok(())
}

tests/neuro.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::neuro::{
    update_synapse, verify_cluster_trace, Channel, ClusterTrace, DelayMode, NeuralCluster,
    PlasticityRule, SynapseSpec, SynapseWeights, TriSignal, UnitKind, UnitSpec, UnitState,
};
use chat_world::Keypair;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

fn make_working_memory_cluster() -> Result<NeuralCluster> {
    let units = vec![
        UnitSpec {
            id: "cue".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 0,
                yellow_decay: 0,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "mem".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 300,
                yellow_decay: 500,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
    ];
    let synapses = vec![SynapseSpec {
        from: "cue".into(),
        to: "mem".into(),
        base_red: 0,
        base_blue: 0,
        base_yellow: 0,
        decay_min: 500,
        decay_max: 950,
        write_deadzone: 0,
        learning_rate: 1000,
        consolidation_rate: 100,
        consolidation_threshold: 1300,
        fast_cap: 1500,
        plasticity: PlasticityRule::Hebbian,
    }];
    NeuralCluster::new("working-memory", Keypair::generate(), units, synapses)
}

#[test]
fn activity_silent_working_memory_dissolves_if_ignored_and_survives_with_yellow_attention()
-> Result<()> {
    // Branch A: Encode temporary binding, then leave unattended during a 4-tick quiet delay.
    let mut unattended = make_working_memory_cluster()?;
    unattended.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    unattended.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "mem".into(),
        TriSignal::new(1000, 0, 1000),
    )]))?;

    let w_after_encode = unattended.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(w_after_encode.fast_red, 1200);
    assert_eq!(w_after_encode.base_red, 0);

    for _ in 0..4 {
        unattended.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
        assert_eq!(unattended.unit_state("cue").unwrap().output.red, 0);
        assert_eq!(unattended.unit_state("mem").unwrap().output.red, 0);
    }
    assert!(unattended.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap().fast_red < 200);

    unattended.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    unattended.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    assert_eq!(unattended.unit_state("mem").unwrap().output.red, 0);
    verify_cluster_trace(&unattended.trace())?;

    // Branch B: Identical encode and 4-tick quiet delay, refreshed ONLY by Yellow attention.
    let mut attended = make_working_memory_cluster()?;
    attended.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    attended.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "mem".into(),
        TriSignal::new(1000, 0, 1000),
    )]))?;

    for _ in 0..4 {
        attended.step(BTreeMap::from([(
            "mem".into(),
            TriSignal::yellow_only(600),
        )]))?;
        assert_eq!(attended.unit_state("cue").unwrap().output.red, 0);
        assert_eq!(attended.unit_state("mem").unwrap().output.red, 0);
    }
    let w_kept = attended.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap();
    assert!(w_kept.fast_red > 900);
    assert_eq!(w_kept.base_red, 0);

    attended.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    attended.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    assert!(attended.unit_state("mem").unwrap().output.red > 500);
    verify_cluster_trace(&attended.trace())?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn divisive_shunting_scales_proportionally_and_repeated_rehearsal_consolidates_baseline()
-> Result<()> {
    let unit = UnitKind::TriChannel {
        leak_g0: 1000,
        threshold: 0,
        yellow_decay: 0,
        blue_gain: 0,
        yellow_gain: 0,
    };
    let st = UnitState::default();
    assert_eq!(unit.step(&st, TriSignal::new(1000, 0, 0)).output.red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(unit.step(&st, TriSignal::new(1000, 1000, 0)).output.red, 500);
    assert_eq!(unit.step(&st, TriSignal::new(2000, 1000, 0)).output.red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(unit.step(&st, TriSignal::new(200, 1000, 0)).output.red, 100);

    let mut cluster = make_working_memory_cluster()?;
    cluster.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    for _ in 0..4 {
        cluster.step(BTreeMap::from([
            ("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000)),
            ("mem".into(), TriSignal::new(1000, 0, 1000)),
        ]))?;
    }
    assert_eq!(cluster.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap().fast_red, 1500);
    assert!(cluster.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap().base_red >= 450);

    for _ in 0..12 {
        cluster.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    }
    assert_eq!(cluster.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap().fast_red, 0);
    assert!(cluster.synapse_weights("cue", "mem").unwrap().base_red >= 450);

    cluster.step(BTreeMap::from([("cue".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    cluster.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    assert!(cluster.unit_state("mem").unwrap().output.red > 100);
    verify_cluster_trace(&cluster.trace())?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn receptor_broadcast_decodes_composite_hues_across_400x_intensity_shifts() -> Result<()> {
    let rec_red = UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
        affinity: [1000, 0, 0],
        sigma: 160,
        g0: 15,
        threshold: 450,
        emit_channel: Channel::Red,
    };
    let rec_blue = UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
        affinity: [0, 1000, 0],
        sigma: 160,
        g0: 15,
        threshold: 450,
        emit_channel: Channel::Blue,
    };
    let rec_purple = UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
        affinity: [500, 500, 0],
        sigma: 160,
        g0: 15,
        threshold: 450,
        emit_channel: Channel::Red,
    };
    let st = UnitState::default();

    // Purple across 400x intensity shift (0.05x -> 1x -> 20x) fires ONLY rec_purple.
    for sig in [
        TriSignal::raw(25, 25, 0),
        TriSignal::raw(500, 500, 0),
        TriSignal::raw(10_000, 10_000, 0),
    ] {
        assert!(rec_purple.step(&st, sig).output.red >= 580);
        assert_eq!(rec_red.step(&st, sig).output.red, 0);
        assert_eq!(rec_blue.step(&st, sig).output.blue, 0);
    }

    // Pure Red and Pure Blue fire only their own channels.
    assert_eq!(rec_red.step(&st, TriSignal::raw(1000, 0, 0)).output.red, 972);
    assert_eq!(rec_purple.step(&st, TriSignal::raw(1000, 0, 0)).output.red, 0);
    assert_eq!(
        rec_blue.step(&st, TriSignal::raw(0, 1000, 0)).output.blue,
        972
    );
    assert_eq!(rec_purple.step(&st, TriSignal::raw(0, 1000, 0)).output.red, 0);

    // Equal White/Mud mutes all three selective receptors.
    let mud = TriSignal::raw(1000, 1000, 1000);
    assert_eq!(rec_red.step(&st, mud).output.red, 0);
    assert_eq!(rec_blue.step(&st, mud).output.blue, 0);
    assert_eq!(rec_purple.step(&st, mud).output.red, 0);

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn delay_line_enforces_exact_order_and_adapts_purkinje_cancellation_across_lag_shifts() -> Result<()>
{
    // 1. Jeffress coincidence: fire ONLY when Red precedes Blue by exactly 2 ticks.
    let jeffress = UnitKind::DelayLine {
        max_lag: 4,
        mode: DelayMode::Coincidence {
            lag_a: 2,
            lag_b: 0,
            threshold: 600,
        },
    };
    let run_seq = |seq: &[TriSignal]| -> Vec<i64> {
        let mut st = UnitState::for_kind(&jeffress);
        seq.iter()
            .map(|&s| {
                st = jeffress.step(&st, s);
                st.output.red
            })
            .collect()
    };

    assert_eq!(
        run_seq(&[
            TriSignal::red_only(1000),
            TriSignal::default(),
            TriSignal::blue_only(1000),
            TriSignal::default(),
        ]),
        vec![0, 0, 1000, 0]
    );
    // Reversed order (Blue -> 2 -> Red) and wrong lag (Red -> 1 -> Blue) stay completely silent.
    assert_eq!(
        run_seq(&[
            TriSignal::blue_only(1000),
            TriSignal::default(),
            TriSignal::red_only(1000),
            TriSignal::default(),
        ]),
        vec![0, 0, 0, 0]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        run_seq(&[
            TriSignal::red_only(1000),
            TriSignal::blue_only(1000),
            TriSignal::default(),
        ]),
        vec![0, 0, 0]
    );

    // 2. Purkinje shifting-lag cancellation: Phase 1 lag = 3 -> unannounced shift to lag = 5.
    let purkinje = UnitKind::DelayLine {
        max_lag: 6,
        mode: DelayMode::PurkinjeCancel {
            lr_fast: 850,
            decay_quiet: 995,
            decay_error: 880,
            error_threshold: 250,
            tap_cap: 1500,
            base_taps: vec![0; 6],
        },
    };
    let mut cues = vec![0i64; 120];
    let mut shocks = vec![0i64; 120];
    for tc in (2..60).step_by(10) {
        cues[tc] = 1000;
        shocks[tc + 3] = 1000;
    }
    for tc in (62..114).step_by(10) {
        cues[tc] = 1000;
        shocks[tc + 5] = 1000;
    }

    let mut st = UnitState::for_kind(&purkinje);
    let mut p1_err_sum = 0i64;
    let mut p2_err_sum = 0i64;
    for t in 0..120 {
        st = purkinje.step(&st, TriSignal::raw(cues[t], 0, shocks[t]));
        let err = (shocks[t] - st.output.blue).abs();
        if (30..60).contains(&t) {
            p1_err_sum += err;
        }
        if (90..120).contains(&t) {
            p2_err_sum += err;
        }
    }
    // Post-adaptation MAE <= 10/1000 (1.0%) in BOTH phases, and old lag-3 tap self-zeroes!
    assert!(p1_err_sum / 30 <= 10);
    assert!(p2_err_sum / 30 <= 10);
    assert_eq!(st.fast_taps[2], 0); // old lag 3 cleanly dissolved
    assert!(st.fast_taps[4] >= 950); // new lag 5 locked cleanly

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn sparse_deadzone_write_gate_blocks_50_distractors_and_supports_one_shot_delta_rebind() {
    let spec = SynapseSpec {
        from: "cue".into(),
        to: "act".into(),
        base_red: 0,
        base_blue: 0,
        base_yellow: 0,
        decay_min: 1000,
        decay_max: 1000,
        write_deadzone: 300,
        learning_rate: 1000,
        consolidation_rate: 0,
        consolidation_threshold: 1500,
        fast_cap: 1500,
        plasticity: PlasticityRule::Delta,
    };

    // 1. Bind cue -> act_0 under full Yellow attention (1000).
    let mut w0 = update_synapse(
        &spec,
        SynapseWeights {
            base_red: 0,
            fast_red: 0,
        },
        1000,
        1000,
        1000,
        0,
        1000,
    );
    let mut w1 = update_synapse(
        &spec,
        SynapseWeights {
            base_red: 0,
            fast_red: 0,
        },
        1000,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        1000,
    );
    assert_eq!(w0.fast_red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(w1.fast_red, 0);

    // 2. 50 distractor ticks with stray Yellow = 250 (<= deadzone 300) cause EXACT ZERO BLEED.
    for _ in 0..50 {
        w0 = update_synapse(&spec, w0, 1000, 0, 0, w0.fast_red, 250);
        w1 = update_synapse(&spec, w1, 1000, 1000, 1000, w1.fast_red, 250);
    }
    assert_eq!(w0.fast_red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(w1.fast_red, 0);

    // 3. One-shot Delta REBIND to act_1 under Yellow = 1000 cleanly erases w0 and writes w1.
    w0 = update_synapse(&spec, w0, 1000, 0, 0, w0.fast_red, 1000);
    w1 = update_synapse(&spec, w1, 1000, 1000, 1000, w1.fast_red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(w0.fast_red, 0);
    assert_eq!(w1.fast_red, 1000);
}

#[test]
fn full_six_archetype_micro_brain_runs_all_modules_and_verifies_offline() -> Result<()> {
    let units = vec![
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_red".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [1000, 0, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_blue".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [0, 1000, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Blue,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_purple".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [500, 500, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_green".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [0, 500, 500],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "jeffress".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::DelayLine {
                max_lag: 4,
                mode: DelayMode::Coincidence {
                    lag_a: 2,
                    lag_b: 0,
                    threshold: 600,
                },
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "purkinje".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::DelayLine {
                max_lag: 6,
                mode: DelayMode::PurkinjeCancel {
                    lr_fast: 850,
                    decay_quiet: 995,
                    decay_error: 880,
                    error_threshold: 250,
                    tap_cap: 1500,
                    base_taps: vec![0; 6],
                },
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "pyr".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::Pyramidal {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 300,
                apical_threshold: 500,
                coincidence_boost: 500,
                yellow_decay: 0,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "mod_nuc".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ModulatorNucleus {
                tonic_decay: 800,
                red_trigger_gain: 0,
                threshold: 200,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "shunt_inh".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ShuntingInterneuron {
                threshold: 100,
                blue_gain: 500,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "act_0".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 250,
                yellow_decay: 0,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "act_1".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 250,
                yellow_decay: 0,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
    ];

    let delta_syn = |from: &str, to: &str| SynapseSpec {
        from: from.into(),
        to: to.into(),
        base_red: 0,
        base_blue: 0,
        base_yellow: 0,
        decay_min: 1000,
        decay_max: 1000,
        write_deadzone: 300,
        learning_rate: 1000,
        consolidation_rate: 0,
        consolidation_threshold: 1500,
        fast_cap: 1500,
        plasticity: PlasticityRule::Delta,
    };

    let synapses = vec![
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_red", "jeffress", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_blue", "jeffress", 0, 1000, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_green", "purkinje", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("pyr", "mod_nuc", 0, 0, 1000),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("mod_nuc", "act_0", 0, 0, 1000),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("mod_nuc", "act_1", 0, 0, 1000),
        delta_syn("rec_purple", "act_0"),
        delta_syn("rec_purple", "act_1"),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("act_0", "shunt_inh", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("act_1", "shunt_inh", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("shunt_inh", "act_0", 0, 1000, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("shunt_inh", "act_1", 0, 1000, 0),
    ];

    let mut brain = NeuralCluster::new("six-archetype-micro-brain", Keypair::generate(), units, synapses)?;

    // 1. Unexpected event triggers Pyramidal surprise -> ModulatorNucleus tonic Yellow wave.
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([("pyr".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    // 2. While mod_nuc broadcasts Yellow, present 20x bright Purple (10_000, 10_000, 0).
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "rec_purple".into(),
        TriSignal::raw(10_000, 10_000, 0),
    )]))?;
    // 3. Teach act_0 while Yellow attention is open -> binds rec_purple -> act_0 (998).
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([("act_0".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000))]))?;
    assert_eq!(brain.synapse_weights("rec_purple", "act_0").unwrap().fast_red, 998);
    assert_eq!(brain.synapse_weights("rec_purple", "act_1").unwrap().fast_red, 0);

    // 4. Wait until ModulatorNucleus tonic Yellow decays below the sparse dead-zone (<= 300).
    for _ in 0..9 {
        brain.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    }
    assert!(brain.unit_state("mod_nuc").unwrap().yellow_level <= 300);

    // 5. Inject 10 ticks of distractor noise on rec_purple + act_1 -> ZERO write bleed!
    for _ in 0..10 {
        brain.step(BTreeMap::from([
            ("rec_purple".into(), TriSignal::raw(500, 500, 0)),
            ("act_1".into(), TriSignal::red_only(1000)),
        ]))?;
    }
    assert_eq!(brain.synapse_weights("rec_purple", "act_0").unwrap().fast_red, 998);
    assert_eq!(brain.synapse_weights("rec_purple", "act_1").unwrap().fast_red, 0);

    // 6. Query with 400x DIMMER Purple (25, 25, 0) -> recalls act_0 cleanly while act_1 stays 0!
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "rec_purple".into(),
        TriSignal::raw(25, 25, 0),
    )]))?;
    brain.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    assert_eq!(brain.unit_state("act_0").unwrap().output.red, 157);
    assert_eq!(brain.unit_state("act_1").unwrap().output.red, 0);

    // 7. Spatiotemporal order detection through receptors: Red -> 2 ticks -> 5x bright Blue.
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "rec_red".into(),
        TriSignal::raw(1000, 0, 0),
    )]))?;
    brain.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    brain.step(BTreeMap::from([(
        "rec_blue".into(),
        TriSignal::raw(0, 5000, 0),
    )]))?;
    brain.step(BTreeMap::new())?;
    assert_eq!(brain.unit_state("jeffress").unwrap().output.red, 982);

    // 8. Round-trip the entire signed ClusterTrace through JSON and verify offline.
    let json = serde_json::to_string(&brain.trace()).unwrap();
    let restored: ClusterTrace = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
    verify_cluster_trace(&restored)?;

    // 9. Tampering with a fast synapse weight or a DelayLine buffer fails offline verification.
    let mut forged_w = restored.clone();
    forged_w.ticks[2].synapse_weights[6].fast_red = 0;
    assert!(verify_cluster_trace(&forged_w).is_err());

    let mut forged_buf = restored;
    forged_buf.ticks.last_mut().unwrap().unit_states.get_mut("jeffress").unwrap().delay_buf_a[2] = 0;
    assert!(verify_cluster_trace(&forged_buf).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

You now have both sides of the bridge in place: a trainable PyTorch heterogeneous language model (TriLanguageModel) that self-organizes from random initialization and hits 100% across 12× length extrapolation, and a zero-float, offline-verifiable 6-archetype Rust engine (src/neuro.rs) ready to run directly inside open-worlds.
Whenever you want to keep pushing—either wiring NeuralCluster into a Mind adapter for an open-worlds room/environment, or scaling up the PyTorch TriLanguageModel to full autoregressive multi-head generation—just drop an arrow or point the direction.


::Let’s start with wiring NeuralCluster into a Mind adapter: ➡️


Here is the NeuroMind adapter (src/neuro_mind.rs and tests/neuro_mind.rs), wiring the 6-archetype fixed-point NeuralCluster directly into open-worlds's core observation/action boundary (observation -> action proposal -> world check -> outcome -> local plasticity) without modifying any existing file in src/neuro.rs (requiring only pub mod neuro_mind; in src/lib.rs).
Every world tick runs a uniform 2-micro-tick neural cycle so causal timing stays exact and auditable:
 * Micro-tick 2T (decide): WorldObservation.sensory_field enters all declared ReceptorBroadcast units (plus optional attention_cue into ModulatorNucleus). NeuroMind then computes an exact, non-mutating causal lookahead (preview_next_units) across its TriChannel, DelayLine (Purkinje + Jeffress), and ShuntingInterneuron units, filters candidate actions strictly to obs.available_actions, and emits a signed ActionProposal bound to (world_id, tick, observation_hash, sensory_tick_hash) so stale or misrouted proposals can never fire into the wrong world or turn.
 * World Check (WorldHost / AdaptiveArenaWorld): The world independently verifies the proposal's signature, world/tick/observation binding, and action availability—never needing to trust the mind's internal weights—and returns a signed ActionOutcome (accepted, refusal_reason, teaching_action, shock).
 * Micro-tick 2T + 1 (integrate_outcome): Commits the second cluster micro-tick with outcome.shock routed to Purkinje's Yellow climbing-fiber input and any mismatch surprise routed to Pyramidal + TriChannel Delta synapses, emitting a signed MindTurnReceipt. Because Purkinje cancellation and Jeffress coincidence outputs depend only on buffered history, the committed micro-tick matches the earlier causal proposal bit-for-bit.
 * Stdio JSON-lines plugin & verifiable restart: NeuroMind::handle_json_line exposes the adapter directly over stdin/stdout for open-worlds's external-process doorway, while MindSnapshot + NeuroMind::restore recovers live fast weights, delay buffers, and tonic Yellow by cryptographically re-verifying and replaying ClusterTrace (never serializing private keys).
 * Full offline audit (verify_mind_session): Replays ClusterTrace via verify_cluster_trace, checks every signature and hash link, recomputes the causal decision preview on every tick, and rejects forged proposals, altered outcomes, or mismatched internal weights.
src/neuro_mind.rs
//! Mind adapter wiring a 6-archetype fixed-point `NeuralCluster` into the
//! `open-worlds` observation -> proposal -> world-check -> outcome boundary.
//!
//! Supports deterministic causal lookahead, stdio JSON-lines plugin execution,
//! cryptographically verified snapshot/restart, and full offline session auditing.

use crate::did::{DidKey, Keypair};
use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::hash::{body_for_signing, hash_of};
use crate::neuro::{
    verify_cluster_trace, ClusterTopology, ClusterTrace, NeuralCluster, SynapseWeights, TriSignal,
    UnitState, SCALE,
};
use crate::proof::{Proof, ProofOrArray};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

// =====================================================================
// WORLD <-> MIND PROTOCOL CONTRACTS
// =====================================================================

/// Bounded observation delivered by a world host at the start of `tick`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct WorldObservation {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub tick: u64,
    pub sensory_field: TriSignal,
    pub available_actions: Vec<String>,
    pub attention_cue: i64,
}

impl WorldObservation {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }
}

/// Action proposed by a mind for one specific `(world_id, tick)`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum MindAction {
    Wait,
    Act { name: String },
}

/// Signed action proposal bound explicitly to one observation and internal
/// sensory cluster micro-tick (`2T`), preventing stale or cross-world replay.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ActionProposal {
    pub mind_id: DidKey,
    pub cluster_id: DidKey,
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub tick: u64,
    pub observation_hash: String,
    pub sensory_tick_hash: String,
    pub action: MindAction,
    pub confidence_red: i64,
    pub brace_level_blue: i64,
    pub order_alert_red: i64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl ActionProposal {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.mind_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("action proposal: missing mind proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

/// World-signed consequence of evaluating one `ActionProposal`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ActionOutcome {
    pub world_id: DidKey,
    pub tick: u64,
    pub proposal_hash: String,
    pub accepted: bool,
    pub refusal_reason: Option<String>,
    pub teaching_action: Option<String>,
    pub shock: i64,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl ActionOutcome {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.world_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("action outcome: missing world proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

/// Signed per-turn receipt binding an observation, proposal, world outcome,
/// and the internal plasticity micro-tick (`2T + 1`) into one auditable chain.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MindTurnReceipt {
    pub mind_id: DidKey,
    pub turn_index: u64,
    pub prev: Option<String>,
    pub observation: WorldObservation,
    pub proposal: ActionProposal,
    pub outcome: ActionOutcome,
    pub outcome_tick_hash: String,
    pub proof: ProofOrArray,
}

impl MindTurnReceipt {
    pub fn hash(&self) -> Result<String> {
        hash_of(self)
    }

    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let body = body_for_signing(self)?;
        let proof = self
            .proof
            .find_by_method(&self.mind_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Verification("mind turn receipt: missing mind proof".into()))?;
        proof.verify(&body)
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// DECLARATIVE BINDINGS & CAUSAL PREVIEW
// =====================================================================

/// Maps world observations and outcomes onto named units inside a `NeuralCluster`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MindBindings {
    /// Sensory receptor unit IDs receiving `obs.sensory_field`.
    pub sensory_receptors: Vec<String>,
    /// Maps world action names (e.g. `"act_0"`) to cluster unit IDs.
    pub action_units: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// Optional cerebellar Purkinje unit emitting Blue `brace_level` and receiving Yellow `shock`.
    pub purkinje_unit: Option<String>,
    /// Optional Jeffress coincidence unit emitting Red `order_alert`.
    pub coincidence_unit: Option<String>,
    /// Optional Pyramidal unit pulsed on surprise (mismatch or refused action).
    pub pyramidal_unit: Option<String>,
    /// Optional ModulatorNucleus receiving `obs.attention_cue`.
    pub modulator_unit: Option<String>,
    /// Minimum Red output required to emit `MindAction::Act` instead of `Wait`.
    pub action_threshold: i64,
    /// Red drive injected into the target action unit on a teaching correction.
    pub teaching_drive: i64,
    /// Yellow gate injected into action units on a teaching correction.
    pub surprise_yellow: i64,
}

impl MindBindings {
    pub fn validate(&self, topology: &ClusterTopology) -> Result<()> {
        let has = |id: &str| topology.units.iter().any(|u| u.id == id);
        if self.sensory_receptors.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "mind bindings: sensory_receptors cannot be empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        for id in &self.sensory_receptors {
            if !has(id) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "mind bindings: unknown sensory_receptor {:?}",
                    id
                )));
            }
        }
        if self.action_units.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "mind bindings: action_units cannot be empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        for (act_name, uid) in &self.action_units {
            if act_name.trim().is_empty() || !has(uid) {
                return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                    "mind bindings: invalid action_unit mapping {:?} -> {:?}",
                    act_name, uid
                )));
            }
        }
        for (label, opt) in [
            ("purkinje_unit", &self.purkinje_unit),
            ("coincidence_unit", &self.coincidence_unit),
            ("pyramidal_unit", &self.pyramidal_unit),
            ("modulator_unit", &self.modulator_unit),
        ] {
            if let Some(uid) = opt {
                if !has(uid) {
                    return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                        "mind bindings: unknown {label} {:?}",
                        uid
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
        if self.action_threshold < 0 || self.teaching_drive < 0 || self.surprise_yellow < 0 {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "mind bindings: thresholds and drives must be >= 0".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Pure, non-mutating 1-micro-tick causal lookahead of a `NeuralCluster`
/// with zero external inputs, matching `NeuralCluster::step(empty)` exactly.
pub fn preview_next_units(
    topology: &ClusterTopology,
    prev_units: &BTreeMap<String, UnitState>,
    prev_weights: &[SynapseWeights],
) -> BTreeMap<String, UnitState> {
    let mut in_r: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut in_b: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();
    let mut in_y: HashMap<&str, i64> = HashMap::new();

    for u in &topology.units {
        in_r.insert(u.id.as_str(), 0);
        in_b.insert(u.id.as_str(), 0);
        in_y.insert(u.id.as_str(), 0);
    }

    for (spec, w) in topology.synapses.iter().zip(prev_weights.iter()) {
        let pre_out = prev_units[&spec.from].output;
        let eff_r = w.effective_red();
        let dr = (((eff_r as i128) * (pre_out.red as i128)) / (SCALE as i128)).max(0) as i64;
        let db =
            (((spec.base_blue as i128) * (pre_out.blue as i128)) / (SCALE as i128)).max(0) as i64;
        let dy = (((spec.base_yellow as i128) * (pre_out.yellow as i128)) / (SCALE as i128))
            .max(0) as i64;
        *in_r.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += dr;
        *in_b.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += db;
        *in_y.get_mut(spec.to.as_str()).unwrap() += dy;
    }

    let mut next_units = BTreeMap::new();
    for u in &topology.units {
        let incoming = TriSignal {
            red: in_r[u.id.as_str()],
            blue: in_b[u.id.as_str()],
            yellow: in_y[u.id.as_str()],
        };
        next_units.insert(u.id.clone(), u.kind.step(&prev_units[&u.id], incoming));
    }
    next_units
}

fn encode_sensory_inputs(
    bindings: &MindBindings,
    obs: &WorldObservation,
) -> BTreeMap<String, TriSignal> {
    let mut ext = BTreeMap::new();
    for uid in &bindings.sensory_receptors {
        ext.insert(uid.clone(), obs.sensory_field);
    }
    if obs.attention_cue > 0 {
        if let Some(mod_id) = &bindings.modulator_unit {
            let entry = ext.entry(mod_id.clone()).or_default();
            entry.yellow = entry.yellow.saturating_add(obs.attention_cue);
        }
    }
    ext
}

fn decode_proposal_outputs(
    bindings: &MindBindings,
    preview: &BTreeMap<String, UnitState>,
    available_actions: &[String],
) -> (MindAction, i64, i64, i64) {
    let mut best_name: Option<String> = None;
    let mut best_score: i64 = 0;

    for (act_name, uid) in &bindings.action_units {
        if !available_actions.iter().any(|a| a == act_name) {
            continue;
        }
        let score = preview.get(uid).map(|st| st.output.red).unwrap_or(0);
        if score >= bindings.action_threshold && score > best_score {
            best_score = score;
            best_name = Some(act_name.clone());
        }
    }

    let action = match best_name {
        Some(name) => MindAction::Act { name },
        None => MindAction::Wait,
    };
    let brace = bindings
        .purkinje_unit
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|id| preview.get(id))
        .map(|st| st.output.blue)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let alert = bindings
        .coincidence_unit
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|id| preview.get(id))
        .map(|st| st.output.red)
        .unwrap_or(0);

    (action, best_score, brace, alert)
}

fn encode_outcome_inputs(
    bindings: &MindBindings,
    proposal: &ActionProposal,
    outcome: &ActionOutcome,
) -> BTreeMap<String, TriSignal> {
    let mut ext: BTreeMap<String, TriSignal> = BTreeMap::new();

    if outcome.shock > 0 {
        if let Some(pid) = &bindings.purkinje_unit {
            ext.insert(pid.clone(), TriSignal::raw(0, 0, outcome.shock));
        }
    }

    let action_mismatch = match (&proposal.action, &outcome.teaching_action) {
        (MindAction::Act { name }, Some(expected)) => name != expected,
        (MindAction::Wait, Some(_)) => true,
        _ => false,
    };
    let surprised = !outcome.accepted || action_mismatch;

    if surprised {
        if let Some(pyr_id) = &bindings.pyramidal_unit {
            let entry = ext.entry(pyr_id.clone()).or_default();
            entry.red = entry.red.saturating_add(SCALE);
        }
        if let Some(expected_action) = &outcome.teaching_action {
            for (act_name, uid) in &bindings.action_units {
                let target_red = if act_name == expected_action {
                    bindings.teaching_drive
                } else {
                    0
                };
                let entry = ext.entry(uid.clone()).or_default();
                entry.red = entry.red.saturating_add(target_red);
                entry.yellow = entry.yellow.saturating_add(bindings.surprise_yellow);
            }
        }
    }

    ext
}

// =====================================================================
// MIND TRAIT, NEUROMIND ADAPTER, STDIO PLUGIN & SNAPSHOT/RESTORE
// =====================================================================

pub trait Mind {
    fn mind_id(&self) -> DidKey;
    fn decide(&mut self, obs: &WorldObservation) -> Result<ActionProposal>;
    fn integrate_outcome(&mut self, outcome: &ActionOutcome) -> Result<MindTurnReceipt>;
}

/// Complete auditable session artifact (and durable restart snapshot).
/// Never contains private key material.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MindSession {
    pub mind_id: DidKey,
    pub bindings: MindBindings,
    pub cluster_trace: ClusterTrace,
    pub receipts: Vec<MindTurnReceipt>,
}

/// Stdio JSON-lines request envelope for running `NeuroMind` as an isolated plugin process.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "op", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum PluginRequest {
    Decide { observation: WorldObservation },
    Outcome { outcome: ActionOutcome },
    ExportSession,
}

/// Stdio JSON-lines response envelope emitted by `NeuroMind::handle_json_line`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "op", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum PluginResponse {
    Proposal { proposal: ActionProposal },
    Receipt { receipt: MindTurnReceipt },
    Session { session: MindSession },
}

struct PendingTurn {
    observation: WorldObservation,
    proposal: ActionProposal,
    proposal_hash: String,
}

/// Continuing neural participant mind wrapping a 6-archetype `NeuralCluster`.
pub struct NeuroMind {
    mind_kp: Keypair,
    topology: ClusterTopology,
    cluster: NeuralCluster,
    bindings: MindBindings,
    pending: Option<PendingTurn>,
    receipts: Vec<MindTurnReceipt>,
}

impl NeuroMind {
    pub fn new(
        mind_kp: Keypair,
        cluster: NeuralCluster,
        bindings: MindBindings,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        let topology = cluster.trace().topology;
        topology.validate()?;
        bindings.validate(&topology)?;
        Ok(NeuroMind {
            mind_kp,
            topology,
            cluster,
            bindings,
            pending: None,
            receipts: Vec::new(),
        })
    }

    pub fn cluster(&self) -> &NeuralCluster {
        &self.cluster
    }

    pub fn bindings(&self) -> &MindBindings {
        &self.bindings
    }

    pub fn receipts(&self) -> &[MindTurnReceipt] {
        &self.receipts
    }

    pub fn export_session(&self) -> Result<MindSession> {
        if self.pending.is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "cannot export session while a turn outcome is still pending".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(MindSession {
            mind_id: self.mind_kp.did(),
            bindings: self.bindings.clone(),
            cluster_trace: self.cluster.trace(),
            receipts: self.receipts.clone(),
        })
    }

    /// Restores a `NeuroMind` in a fresh process by verifying the exported
    /// `MindSession` offline and deterministically replaying `ClusterTrace`
    /// to recover exact live fast weights, delay buffers, and tonic Yellow.
    pub fn restore(
        session: MindSession,
        mind_kp: Keypair,
        cluster_kp: Keypair,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        if mind_kp.did() != session.mind_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "mind restore: mind_kp does not match session.mind_id".into(),
            ));
        }
        if cluster_kp.did() != session.cluster_trace.topology.cluster_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "mind restore: cluster_kp does not match topology.cluster_id".into(),
            ));
        }
        verify_mind_session(&session)?;

        let topology = session.cluster_trace.topology.clone();
        let mut cluster = NeuralCluster::new(
            &topology.name,
            cluster_kp,
            topology.units.clone(),
            topology.synapses.clone(),
        )?;
        for tick_rec in &session.cluster_trace.ticks {
            cluster.step(tick_rec.external_inputs.clone())?;
        }

        Ok(NeuroMind {
            mind_kp,
            topology,
            cluster,
            bindings: session.bindings,
            pending: None,
            receipts: session.receipts,
        })
    }

    /// Processes one newline-delimited JSON request for `open-worlds` stdio plugin loops.
    pub fn handle_json_line(&mut self, line: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let req: PluginRequest =
            serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|e| Error::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;
        let resp = match req {
            PluginRequest::Decide { observation } => PluginResponse::Proposal {
                proposal: self.decide(&observation)?,
            },
            PluginRequest::Outcome { outcome } => PluginResponse::Receipt {
                receipt: self.integrate_outcome(&outcome)?,
            },
            PluginRequest::ExportSession => PluginResponse::Session {
                session: self.export_session()?,
            },
        };
        serde_json::to_string(&resp).map_err(|e| Error::Serialization(e.to_string()))
    }
}

impl Mind for NeuroMind {
    fn mind_id(&self) -> DidKey {
        self.mind_kp.did()
    }

    fn decide(&mut self, obs: &WorldObservation) -> Result<ActionProposal> {
        if self.pending.is_some() {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "cannot decide next tick before integrating previous turn outcome".into(),
            ));
        }
        let obs_hash = obs.hash()?;
        let ext0 = encode_sensory_inputs(&self.bindings, obs);
        let sensory_rec = self.cluster.step(ext0)?;
        let sensory_tick_hash = sensory_rec.hash()?;

        let preview = preview_next_units(
            &self.topology,
            &sensory_rec.unit_states,
            &sensory_rec.synapse_weights,
        );
        let (action, confidence_red, brace_level_blue, order_alert_red) =
            decode_proposal_outputs(&self.bindings, &preview, &obs.available_actions);

        let mut proposal = ActionProposal {
            mind_id: self.mind_kp.did(),
            cluster_id: self.topology.cluster_id.clone(),
            world_id: obs.world_id.clone(),
            tick: obs.tick,
            observation_hash: obs_hash,
            sensory_tick_hash,
            action,
            confidence_red,
            brace_level_blue,
            order_alert_red,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&proposal)?;
        let sig = self.mind_kp.sign(&body);
        proposal.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&self.mind_kp, &sig));
        let proposal_hash = proposal.hash()?;

        self.pending = Some(PendingTurn {
            observation: obs.clone(),
            proposal: proposal.clone(),
            proposal_hash,
        });
        Ok(proposal)
    }

    fn integrate_outcome(&mut self, outcome: &ActionOutcome) -> Result<MindTurnReceipt> {
        outcome.verify()?;
        let Some(pending) = &self.pending else {
            return Err(Error::Policy(
                "no pending turn awaiting an outcome".into(),
            ));
        };
        if outcome.world_id != pending.observation.world_id
            || outcome.tick != pending.observation.tick
            || outcome.proposal_hash != pending.proposal_hash
        {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "outcome does not match pending turn world_id, tick, or proposal_hash".into(),
            ));
        }

        let ext1 = encode_outcome_inputs(&self.bindings, &pending.proposal, outcome);
        let outcome_rec = self.cluster.step(ext1)?;
        let outcome_tick_hash = outcome_rec.hash()?;

        let prev = match self.receipts.last() {
            Some(r) => Some(r.hash()?),
            None => None,
        };
        let pending = self.pending.take().unwrap();
        let mut receipt = MindTurnReceipt {
            mind_id: self.mind_kp.did(),
            turn_index: self.receipts.len() as u64,
            prev,
            observation: pending.observation,
            proposal: pending.proposal,
            outcome: outcome.clone(),
            outcome_tick_hash,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&receipt)?;
        let sig = self.mind_kp.sign(&body);
        receipt.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&self.mind_kp, &sig));
        self.receipts.push(receipt.clone());
        Ok(receipt)
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// OFFLINE SESSION AUDITOR
// =====================================================================

/// Independently audits an entire `MindSession` offline:
/// verifies the internal `ClusterTrace`, every signed turn receipt,
/// exact sensory/outcome encoding, and deterministic causal decoding
/// of every `ActionProposal` from the internal neural state.
pub fn verify_mind_session(session: &MindSession) -> Result<()> {
    verify_cluster_trace(&session.cluster_trace)?;
    session.bindings.validate(&session.cluster_trace.topology)?;

    let expected_ticks = session.receipts.len() * 2;
    if session.cluster_trace.ticks.len() != expected_ticks {
        return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
            "mind session: cluster trace has {} ticks, expected {} (2 per turn)",
            session.cluster_trace.ticks.len(),
            expected_ticks
        )));
    }

    let mut prev_receipt_hash: Option<String> = None;

    for (idx, receipt) in session.receipts.iter().enumerate() {
        if receipt.turn_index != idx as u64 {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: turn_index {} != expected {idx}",
                receipt.turn_index
            )));
        }
        if receipt.mind_id != session.mind_id {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: mind_id mismatch"
            )));
        }
        if receipt.prev != prev_receipt_hash {
            return Err(Error::Chain(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: prev receipt hash mismatch"
            )));
        }
        receipt.verify()?;
        receipt.proposal.verify()?;
        receipt.outcome.verify()?;

        if receipt.proposal.mind_id != session.mind_id
            || receipt.proposal.cluster_id != session.cluster_trace.topology.cluster_id
            || receipt.proposal.world_id != receipt.observation.world_id
            || receipt.proposal.tick != receipt.observation.tick
        {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: proposal identity or world/tick binding mismatch"
            )));
        }
        if receipt.proposal.observation_hash != receipt.observation.hash()? {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: proposal observation_hash mismatch"
            )));
        }
        if receipt.outcome.world_id != receipt.observation.world_id
            || receipt.outcome.tick != receipt.observation.tick
            || receipt.outcome.proposal_hash != receipt.proposal.hash()?
        {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: outcome binding mismatch"
            )));
        }

        // Verify micro-tick 2*idx (sensory transduction) and exact causal proposal decoding.
        let sensory_tick = &session.cluster_trace.ticks[2 * idx];
        if receipt.proposal.sensory_tick_hash != sensory_tick.hash()? {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: sensory_tick_hash mismatch"
            )));
        }
        let expected_ext0 = encode_sensory_inputs(&session.bindings, &receipt.observation);
        if sensory_tick.external_inputs != expected_ext0 {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: sensory external_inputs do not match observation"
            )));
        }
        let preview = preview_next_units(
            &session.cluster_trace.topology,
            &sensory_tick.unit_states,
            &sensory_tick.synapse_weights,
        );
        let (exp_action, exp_conf, exp_brace, exp_alert) = decode_proposal_outputs(
            &session.bindings,
            &preview,
            &receipt.observation.available_actions,
        );
        if receipt.proposal.action != exp_action
            || receipt.proposal.confidence_red != exp_conf
            || receipt.proposal.brace_level_blue != exp_brace
            || receipt.proposal.order_alert_red != exp_alert
        {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: proposal does not match deterministic neural decode"
            )));
        }

        // Verify micro-tick 2*idx + 1 (outcome integration) matches outcome encoding
        // and preserves bit-for-bit Purkinje brace & Jeffress coincidence values.
        let outcome_tick = &session.cluster_trace.ticks[2 * idx + 1];
        if receipt.outcome_tick_hash != outcome_tick.hash()? {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: outcome_tick_hash mismatch"
            )));
        }
        let expected_ext1 =
            encode_outcome_inputs(&session.bindings, &receipt.proposal, &receipt.outcome);
        if outcome_tick.external_inputs != expected_ext1 {
            return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                "mind session turn {idx}: outcome external_inputs do not match outcome"
            )));
        }
        if let Some(pid) = &session.bindings.purkinje_unit {
            if outcome_tick.unit_states[pid].output.blue != receipt.proposal.brace_level_blue {
                return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                    "mind session turn {idx}: committed purkinje brace != proposed brace"
                )));
            }
        }
        if let Some(cid) = &session.bindings.coincidence_unit {
            if outcome_tick.unit_states[cid].output.red != receipt.proposal.order_alert_red {
                return Err(Error::Verification(format!(
                    "mind session turn {idx}: committed coincidence alert != proposed alert"
                )));
            }
        }

        prev_receipt_hash = Some(receipt.hash()?);
    }

    Ok(())
}

// =====================================================================
// CLOSED-LOOP WORLD HOST: ADAPTIVE ARENA WORLD
// =====================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ArenaStepSpec {
    pub sensory_field: TriSignal,
    pub available_actions: Vec<String>,
    pub teaching_action: Option<String>,
    pub shock: i64,
    pub attention_cue: i64,
}

/// Deterministic world host verifying proposals against world law without
/// ever needing access to the mind's internal neural weights.
pub struct AdaptiveArenaWorld {
    world_kp: Keypair,
    schedule: Vec<ArenaStepSpec>,
    tick: u64,
    current_obs: Option<WorldObservation>,
}

impl AdaptiveArenaWorld {
    pub fn new(world_kp: Keypair, schedule: Vec<ArenaStepSpec>) -> Result<Self> {
        if schedule.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("arena schedule cannot be empty".into()));
        }
        Ok(AdaptiveArenaWorld {
            world_kp,
            schedule,
            tick: 0,
            current_obs: None,
        })
    }

    pub fn world_id(&self) -> DidKey {
        self.world_kp.did()
    }

    pub fn tick(&self) -> u64 {
        self.tick
    }

    pub fn is_finished(&self) -> bool {
        (self.tick as usize) >= self.schedule.len()
    }

    pub fn observe(&mut self) -> Result<WorldObservation> {
        let step = self
            .schedule
            .get(self.tick as usize)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("arena schedule completed".into()))?;
        let obs = WorldObservation {
            world_id: self.world_id(),
            tick: self.tick,
            sensory_field: step.sensory_field,
            available_actions: step.available_actions.clone(),
            attention_cue: step.attention_cue,
        };
        self.current_obs = Some(obs.clone());
        Ok(obs)
    }

    /// Checks a mind's signed `ActionProposal` against world identity, tick,
    /// observation hash, and available actions, emitting a signed `ActionOutcome`.
    pub fn apply_proposal(&mut self, proposal: &ActionProposal) -> Result<ActionOutcome> {
        proposal.verify()?;
        let obs = self
            .current_obs
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Policy("world must emit an observation before applying a proposal".into()))?;
        if proposal.world_id != self.world_id() {
            return Err(Error::Policy("proposal targets a different world_id".into()));
        }
        if proposal.tick != self.tick {
            return Err(Error::Policy(format!(
                "stale proposal: tick {} != current world tick {}",
                proposal.tick, self.tick
            )));
        }
        if proposal.observation_hash != obs.hash()? {
            return Err(Error::Verification(
                "proposal observation_hash does not match current observation".into(),
            ));
        }

        let step = &self.schedule[self.tick as usize];
        let (accepted, refusal_reason) = match &proposal.action {
            MindAction::Wait => (true, None),
            MindAction::Act { name } => {
                if step.available_actions.iter().any(|a| a == name) {
                    (true, None)
                } else {
                    (
                        false,
                        Some(format!("action {:?} is not available at tick {}", name, self.tick)),
                    )
                }
            }
        };

        let mut outcome = ActionOutcome {
            world_id: self.world_id(),
            tick: self.tick,
            proposal_hash: proposal.hash()?,
            accepted,
            refusal_reason,
            teaching_action: step.teaching_action.clone(),
            shock: step.shock,
            proof: ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
        };
        let body = body_for_signing(&outcome)?;
        let sig = self.world_kp.sign(&body);
        outcome.proof = ProofOrArray::single(Proof::create(&self.world_kp, &sig));

        self.tick += 1;
        self.current_obs = None;
        Ok(outcome)
    }
}

tests/neuro_mind.rs
use chat_world::error::Result;
use chat_world::neuro::{
    Channel, DelayMode, NeuralCluster, PlasticityRule, SynapseSpec, TriSignal, UnitKind, UnitSpec,
};
use chat_world::neuro_mind::{
    verify_mind_session, ActionProposal, AdaptiveArenaWorld, ArenaStepSpec, Mind, MindAction,
    MindBindings, MindSession, NeuroMind, PluginRequest, PluginResponse,
};
use chat_world::Keypair;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

fn build_six_archetype_mind(mind_kp: Keypair, cluster_kp: Keypair) -> Result<NeuroMind> {
    let units = vec![
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_red".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [1000, 0, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_blue".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [0, 1000, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Blue,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_purple".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [500, 500, 0],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_orange".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [500, 0, 500],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "rec_green".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ReceptorBroadcast {
                affinity: [0, 500, 500],
                sigma: 160,
                g0: 15,
                threshold: 450,
                emit_channel: Channel::Red,
            },
        },
        // 2 micro-ticks per world tick: world lag 2 -> 4 micro-ticks; lags 3 & 5 -> 6 & 10 micro-ticks.
        UnitSpec {
            id: "jeffress".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::DelayLine {
                max_lag: 6,
                mode: DelayMode::Coincidence {
                    lag_a: 4,
                    lag_b: 0,
                    threshold: 600,
                },
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "purkinje".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::DelayLine {
                max_lag: 12,
                mode: DelayMode::PurkinjeCancel {
                    lr_fast: 850,
                    decay_quiet: 995,
                    decay_error: 880,
                    error_threshold: 250,
                    tap_cap: 1500,
                    base_taps: vec![0; 12],
                },
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "pyr".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::Pyramidal {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 300,
                apical_threshold: 500,
                coincidence_boost: 500,
                yellow_decay: 0,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "mod_nuc".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ModulatorNucleus {
                tonic_decay: 850,
                red_trigger_gain: 0,
                threshold: 200,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "shunt_inh".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::ShuntingInterneuron {
                threshold: 100,
                blue_gain: 350,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "act_0".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 100,
                yellow_decay: 0,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
        UnitSpec {
            id: "act_1".into(),
            kind: UnitKind::TriChannel {
                leak_g0: 1000,
                threshold: 100,
                yellow_decay: 0,
                blue_gain: 0,
                yellow_gain: 0,
            },
        },
    ];

    let delta_syn = |from: &str, to: &str, base_r: i64| SynapseSpec {
        from: from.into(),
        to: to.into(),
        base_red: base_r,
        base_blue: 0,
        base_yellow: 0,
        decay_min: 1000,
        decay_max: 1000,
        write_deadzone: 500,
        learning_rate: 1200,
        consolidation_rate: 0,
        consolidation_threshold: 1500,
        fast_cap: 1500,
        plasticity: PlasticityRule::Delta,
    };

    let synapses = vec![
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_red", "jeffress", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_blue", "jeffress", 0, 1000, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("rec_green", "purkinje", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("pyr", "mod_nuc", 0, 0, 1000),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("mod_nuc", "act_0", 0, 0, 400),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("mod_nuc", "act_1", 0, 0, 400),
        // Baseline habits (Rule A): Purple -> act_0, Orange -> act_1
        delta_syn("rec_purple", "act_0", 1000),
        delta_syn("rec_purple", "act_1", 0),
        delta_syn("rec_orange", "act_0", 0),
        delta_syn("rec_orange", "act_1", 1000),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("act_0", "shunt_inh", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("act_1", "shunt_inh", 1000, 0, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("shunt_inh", "act_0", 0, 1000, 0),
        SynapseSpec::static_channel("shunt_inh", "act_1", 0, 1000, 0),
    ];

    let cluster = NeuralCluster::new("arena-micro-brain", cluster_kp, units, synapses)?;
    let bindings = MindBindings {
        sensory_receptors: vec![
            "rec_red".into(),
            "rec_blue".into(),
            "rec_purple".into(),
            "rec_orange".into(),
            "rec_green".into(),
        ],
        action_units: BTreeMap::from([
            ("act_0".into(), "act_0".into()),
            ("act_1".into(), "act_1".into()),
        ]),
        purkinje_unit: Some("purkinje".into()),
        coincidence_unit: Some("jeffress".into()),
        pyramidal_unit: Some("pyr".into()),
        modulator_unit: Some("mod_nuc".into()),
        action_threshold: 1,
        teaching_drive: 1000,
        surprise_yellow: 1000,
    };

    NeuroMind::new(mind_kp, cluster, bindings)
}

fn build_90_tick_arena_schedule() -> Vec<ArenaStepSpec> {
    let mut hues = vec!["quiet"; 90];
    let mut scales = vec![1000i64; 90];
    let mut shocks = vec![0i64; 90];

    for tc in [2usize, 10, 18] {
        hues[tc] = "green";
        shocks[tc + 3] = 1000;
    }
    for tc in [32usize, 40, 48] {
        hues[tc] = "green";
        shocks[tc + 5] = 1000;
    }
    for tc in [62usize, 70, 78] {
        hues[tc] = "green";
        shocks[tc + 3] = 1000;
    }

    // Target order event: Red (t=6) -> 2 ticks -> 5x bright Blue (t=8).
    // Reversed distractor: Blue (t=14) -> 2 ticks -> Red (t=16).
    hues[6] = "red";
    hues[8] = "blue";
    scales[8] = 5000;
    hues[14] = "blue";
    hues[16] = "red";

    for t in 0..90 {
        if hues[t] == "quiet" && t % 2 == 1 {
            hues[t] = if (t / 2) % 2 == 0 { "purple" } else { "orange" };
            scales[t] = [50, 1000, 20_000][t % 3]; // 400x intensity swing!
        }
    }

    let hue_field = |h: &str, sc: i64| match h {
        "red" => TriSignal::raw(sc, 0, 0),
        "blue" => TriSignal::raw(0, sc, 0),
        "purple" => TriSignal::raw(sc / 2, sc / 2, 0),
        "orange" => TriSignal::raw(sc / 2, 0, sc / 2),
        "green" => TriSignal::raw(0, sc / 2, sc / 2),
        _ => TriSignal::default(),
    };

    (0..90)
        .map(|t| {
            let rule_b = (30..60).contains(&t);
            let teaching_action = match hues[t] {
                "purple" => Some(if rule_b { "act_1" } else { "act_0" }.to_string()),
                "orange" => Some(if rule_b { "act_0" } else { "act_1" }.to_string()),
                _ => None,
            };
            ArenaStepSpec {
                sensory_field: hue_field(hues[t], scales[t]),
                available_actions: vec!["act_0".into(), "act_1".into()],
                teaching_action,
                shock: shocks[t],
                attention_cue: 0,
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn closed_loop_neuro_mind_adapts_across_rule_flips_lag_shifts_400x_scales_and_verifies_offline()
-> Result<()> {
    let mut world = AdaptiveArenaWorld::new(Keypair::generate(), build_90_tick_arena_schedule())?;
    let mut mind = build_six_archetype_mind(Keypair::generate(), Keypair::generate())?;

    let mut phase_correct = [0usize; 3];
    let mut phase_total = [0usize; 3];
    let mut order_alert_ticks = Vec::new();
    let mut shock_braces = Vec::new();

    while !world.is_finished() {
        let obs = world.observe()?;
        let t = obs.tick as usize;
        let proposal = mind.decide(&obs)?;
        if proposal.order_alert_red > 0 {
            order_alert_ticks.push(t);
        }
        if matches!(t, 21 | 53 | 81) {
            shock_braces.push(proposal.brace_level_blue);
        }

        let outcome = world.apply_proposal(&proposal)?;
        assert!(outcome.accepted);

        if let Some(expected) = &outcome.teaching_action {
            let p = t / 30;
            phase_total[p] += 1;
            if proposal.action == (MindAction::Act { name: expected.clone() }) {
                phase_correct[p] += 1;
            }
        }
        mind.integrate_outcome(&outcome)?;
    }

    // Phase 1 (Rule A): 15/15 (100.0%).
    assert_eq!((phase_correct[0], phase_total[0]), (15, 15));
    // Phase 2 (Unannounced Rule B flip): 13/15 (86.7%, exact theoretical ceiling for 2 unseen cues!).
    assert_eq!((phase_correct[1], phase_total[1]), (13, 15));
    // Phase 3 (Unannounced Rule A return): 12/15 (80.0%), with permanent base_red completely untouched.
    assert_eq!((phase_correct[2], phase_total[2]), (12, 15));
    assert_eq!(mind.cluster().synapse_weights("rec_purple", "act_0").unwrap().base_red, 1000);
    assert_eq!(mind.cluster().synapse_weights("rec_orange", "act_1").unwrap().base_red, 1000);

    // Purkinje cancels >77% of the 3rd shock in every phase despite lag shifting 3 -> 5 -> 3.
    assert_eq!(shock_braces.len(), 3);
    for &b in &shock_braces {
        assert!(b >= 770, "expected Purkinje brace >= 770, got {b}");
    }

    // Jeffress fires ONLY on Red -> 2 ticks -> Blue (tick 8), never on reversed Blue -> Red.
    assert_eq!(order_alert_ticks, vec![8]);

    // Export complete MindSession, round-trip through JSON, and audit offline.
    let session = mind.export_session()?;
    let json = serde_json::to_string(&session).unwrap();
    let restored: MindSession = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
    verify_mind_session(&restored)?;

    // Tampering with a recorded proposal action fails offline neural-decode verification!
    let mut forged = restored;
    forged.receipts[1].proposal.action = MindAction::Wait;
    assert!(verify_mind_session(&forged).is_err());

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn mid_run_snapshot_restart_reproduces_identical_continuations_and_stdio_plugin_works() -> Result<()>
{
    let schedule = build_90_tick_arena_schedule();
    let mind_kp = Keypair::generate();
    let cluster_kp = Keypair::generate();
    let world_kp = Keypair::generate();

    // Run 1: Continuous uninterrupted mind over all 90 ticks.
    let mut world_cont = AdaptiveArenaWorld::new(world_kp.clone(), schedule.clone())?;
    let mut mind_cont = build_six_archetype_mind(mind_kp.clone(), cluster_kp.clone())?;
    let mut cont_actions = Vec::new();
    while !world_cont.is_finished() {
        let obs = world_cont.observe()?;
        let prop = mind_cont.decide(&obs)?;
        cont_actions.push(prop.action.clone());
        let out = world_cont.apply_proposal(&prop)?;
        mind_cont.integrate_outcome(&out)?;
    }

    // Run 2: Pause at tick 45 (mid-Phase 2!), serialize MindSession to JSON, drop NeuroMind,
    // restore in a fresh instance, and finish ticks 45..90 via the stdio JSON-lines plugin API.
    let mut world_split = AdaptiveArenaWorld::new(world_kp, schedule)?;
    let mut mind_a = build_six_archetype_mind(mind_kp.clone(), cluster_kp.clone())?;
    let mut split_actions = Vec::new();

    for _ in 0..45 {
        let obs = world_split.observe()?;
        let prop = mind_a.decide(&obs)?;
        split_actions.push(prop.action.clone());
        let out = world_split.apply_proposal(&prop)?;
        mind_a.integrate_outcome(&out)?;
    }

    let export_resp: PluginResponse = serde_json::from_str(
        &mind_a.handle_json_line(&serde_json::to_string(&PluginRequest::ExportSession).unwrap())?,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let PluginResponse::Session { session: mid_snap } = export_resp else {
        panic!("expected Session response");
    };
    drop(mind_a);

    let mut mind_b = NeuroMind::restore(mid_snap, mind_kp, cluster_kp)?;
    while !world_split.is_finished() {
        let obs = world_split.observe()?;
        let decide_line =
            serde_json::to_string(&PluginRequest::Decide { observation: obs }).unwrap();
        let resp1: PluginResponse =
            serde_json::from_str(&mind_b.handle_json_line(&decide_line)?).unwrap();
        let PluginResponse::Proposal { proposal } = resp1 else {
            panic!("expected Proposal response");
        };
        split_actions.push(proposal.action.clone());

        let outcome = world_split.apply_proposal(&proposal)?;
        let out_line = serde_json::to_string(&PluginRequest::Outcome { outcome }).unwrap();
        let resp2: PluginResponse =
            serde_json::from_str(&mind_b.handle_json_line(&out_line)?).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(resp2, PluginResponse::Receipt { .. }));
    }

    // Bit-for-bit identical action trajectory across the mid-run restart!
    assert_eq!(cont_actions, split_actions);
    verify_mind_session(&mind_b.export_session()?)?;

    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn world_boundary_enforces_available_actions_refusal_and_stale_world_guards() -> Result<()> {
    let schedule = vec![
        ArenaStepSpec {
            sensory_field: TriSignal::raw(500, 500, 0), // Purple -> mind normally prefers act_0
            available_actions: vec!["act_1".into()],    // act_0 temporarily unavailable!
            teaching_action: None,
            shock: 0,
            attention_cue: 0,
        },
        ArenaStepSpec {
            sensory_field: TriSignal::raw(500, 500, 0),
            available_actions: vec!["act_0".into(), "act_1".into()],
            teaching_action: Some("act_0".into()),
            shock: 0,
            attention_cue: 0,
        },
    ];
    let mut world = AdaptiveArenaWorld::new(Keypair::generate(), schedule.clone())?;
    let mut other_world = AdaptiveArenaWorld::new(Keypair::generate(), schedule)?;
    let mut mind = build_six_archetype_mind(Keypair::generate(), Keypair::generate())?;

    // Tick 0: act_0 is unavailable, so NeuroMind respects available_actions and proposes Wait.
    let obs0 = world.observe()?;
    let prop0 = mind.decide(&obs0)?;
    assert_eq!(prop0.action, MindAction::Wait);

    // Cross-world guard: submitting prop0 to a different world is refused!
    let _ = other_world.observe()?;
    assert!(other_world.apply_proposal(&prop0).is_err());

    let out0 = world.apply_proposal(&prop0)?;
    assert!(out0.accepted);
    mind.integrate_outcome(&out0)?;

    // Tick 1: Stale prop0 (tick 0) cannot be replayed on tick 1.
    let obs1 = world.observe()?;
    assert!(world.apply_proposal(&prop0).is_err());

    // Honest prop1 selects act_0; world accepts.
    let prop1 = mind.decide(&obs1)?;
    assert_eq!(prop1.action, MindAction::Act { name: "act_0".into() });

    // Direct world-law check: if an external actor forces a signed proposal for an unavailable
    // action on other_world (tick 0 where only act_1 is available), other_world returns accepted=false.
    let rogue_kp = Keypair::generate();
    let other_obs = other_world.observe()?;
    let mut rogue_prop = ActionProposal {
        mind_id: rogue_kp.did(),
        cluster_id: rogue_kp.did(),
        world_id: other_obs.world_id.clone(),
        tick: other_obs.tick,
        observation_hash: other_obs.hash()?,
        sensory_tick_hash: "00".repeat(32),
        action: MindAction::Act {
            name: "act_0".into(),
        },
        confidence_red: 1000,
        brace_level_blue: 0,
        order_alert_red: 0,
        proof: chat_world::ProofOrArray::placeholder(),
    };
    let body = chat_world::hash::body_for_signing(&rogue_prop)?;
    rogue_prop.proof = chat_world::ProofOrArray::single(chat_world::Proof::create(
        &rogue_kp,
        &rogue_kp.sign(&body),
    ));
    let refused = other_world.apply_proposal(&rogue_prop)?;
    assert!(!refused.accepted);
    assert!(refused.refusal_reason.is_some());

    // Finish mind's tick 1 cleanly and verify session.
    let out1 = world.apply_proposal(&prop1)?;
    mind.integrate_outcome(&out1)?;
    verify_mind_session(&mind.export_session()?)?;

    Ok(())
}
