To release our 6-archetype model (TriLanguageModel / MetaMicroBrain) on hubs like Hugging Face so anyone can download, inspect, and run it in a few lines of code, the work splits cleanly into two halves: finishing the model itself (moving from synthetic proofs-of-concept to a real general-purpose checkpoint) and packaging it to hub standards so standard loaders recognize it out of the box.
1. Finishing the Model for Real-World Use
Right now, TriLanguageModel is an 18k-parameter prototype over a 22-character synthetic alphabet. Before a public checkpoint is genuinely useful to other people, four engineering pieces need to land:
 * Real tokenization: Replace the 22-character alphabet with either a byte-level UTF-8 tokenizer (256 tokens, zero unknown tokens, works natively on any text or code) or a small trained BPE tokenizer (e.g., 4,096–16,384 tokens saved as tokenizer.json). Byte-level is the cleanest fit for our DelayLineUnit character-syntax convs at small scale (1M–15M params); BPE scales better past 25M+ params.
 * Full autoregressive training & generate() support: Switch the training objective from query-only loss to full next-token prediction over every position. Expose a stateful forward(input_ids, past_state=None) interface that passes each layer's fixed-size (F_fast, yellow_tonic, delay_buf) tuple from step to step—giving token-by-token generate() true O(1) memory per layer instead of a growing Transformer KV cache.
 * Training-speed optimization: The explicit Python for t in range(T): loop works cleanly at T = 200 on CPU, but training a multi-million-parameter model over millions of tokens needs either torch.compile on GPU or a chunkwise parallel fast-weight recurrence (updating F_fast across blocks of 32–64 tokens via matrix multiplies, as in modern DeltaNet implementations).
 * A real public training mix: Train a modest, reproducible v0.1 release (say 2M–10M parameters) on a clean, permissively licensed corpus—such as TinyStories or a small FineWeb-Edu / code slice—blended with a small percentage of in-context dynamic rebinding and multi-hop sequences so the Yellow modulator and dissolving fast weights stay actively used rather than going dormant.
2. Packaging a Custom Architecture for Hugging Face Hub
Because our 6-archetype unit is a brand-new architecture not built into stock transformers, Hugging Face supports two standard ways to publish it:
| Packaging Path | How Users Load It | Best When |
|---|---|---|
| transformers Custom Model (PretrainedConfig + PreTrainedModel + register_for_auto_class) | AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("user/trinet-v0.1", trust_remote_code=True) | You want maximum compatibility with standard Hugging Face pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and one-line loading. |
| PyTorchModelHubMixin (from huggingface_hub) | TriLanguageModel.from_pretrained("user/trinet-v0.1") (requires installing your Python package) | You want minimal wrapper boilerplate while still getting automatic safetensors serialization, sharding, and Hub download metrics. |
For a novel architecture you want people to try immediately without installing a separate library first, the transformers Custom Model route is stronger. Calling register_for_auto_class("AutoModelForCausalLM") automatically writes an auto_map into config.json and uploads your self-contained Python files alongside the weights.
A clean, hub-ready repository contains six files:
 * config.json — Serialized hyperparameters (d_model, d_key, d_val, n_layers, delay_lags, n_receptors, vocab_size) plus the auto_map pointing to your config and modeling files.
 * configuration_trinet.py — Subclass of PretrainedConfig with a unique model_type = "trinet" that accepts **kwargs and passes them to super().__init__(**kwargs).
 * modeling_trinet.py — Self-contained PreTrainedModel subclass (TriNetForCausalLM) containing all 6 archetypes, forward(), and generate(), with zero hidden local file dependencies inside __init__.
 * model.safetensors — Weights exported in safetensors format rather than legacy PyTorch .pt/.bin pickle files, which are flagged as unsafe because pickle can execute arbitrary code on load.
 * tokenizer.json & tokenizer_config.json — Pushed alongside the model so AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(...) works seamlessly.
 * README.md (Model Card) — Structured YAML metadata (license, tags, datasets, metrics) plus documentation.
One security detail worth keeping crisp: because trust_remote_code=True runs modeling_trinet.py directly on the downloader's machine, keeping that file short, clean, dependency-free (pure torch + transformers), and easy to read in five minutes dramatically increases trust.
3. Making a Novel Architecture Credible and Stand Out
Most custom architectures uploaded to model hubs get ignored because they ship weights with no proof of why the architecture matters. Given the rigor you already bring to your work, four additions will make this release unusually compelling:
 * An honest Model Card with explicit scope and limits: State the license clearly (CC0-1.0, MIT, or Apache-2.0), explain the 6 cell archetypes (Red / Blue / Yellow channels, dissolving fast weights, sparse dead-zone gate, receptor broadcast, delay lines), and document both where it wins (O(1) episodic memory, 1-shot overwrite without base drift, scale invariance) and where a standard O(T) Transformer still wins (exact verbatim retrieval of arbitrary un-attended tokens far back in a prompt).
 * Parameter-matched baseline table + reproducible eval script: Publish the exact training script, random seed, and a parameter-matched Transformer and GRU trained on the exact same token budget so anyone can verify your numbers locally.
 * An interactive Hugging Face Space: A tiny Gradio app running on free CPU where visitors type live prompts (like a=3; ... a=7; ?a>) and watch a live plot of the Yellow modulator gate (eta, lam), Pyramidal surprise, and fast-weight matrix F(t) lighting up and dissolving in real time. Seeing working memory dissolve and refresh visually explains the architecture ten times faster than a wall of math.
 * Dual-artifact release (PyTorch + Auditable Rust): Alongside model.safetensors on Hugging Face, include an optional fixed-point (SCALE = 1000) JSON snapshot compatible with src/neuro.rs and src/neuro_mind.rs—making it one of the very few public models that ships with a deterministic, cryptographically auditable execution path.
4. Concrete Path to a v0.1 Public Release
| Stage | Deliverable | Done When |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Core Upgrade | Stateful TriNetForCausalLM (past_state + generate()) + byte-level tokenizer + autoregressive training loop | Model generates coherent continuations in O(1) memory and passes fast-weight state equivalence tests (full pass == token-by-token pass). |
| 2. Real Training Run | Train a small v0.1 checkpoint (e.g., 1M–5M params) on a real public text/code/reasoning slice + parameter-matched Transformer baseline | Loss converges cleanly; evaluation script logs perplexity plus dynamic-binding & length-extrapolation scores. |
| 3. Hub Packaging | configuration_trinet.py, modeling_trinet.py, model.safetensors, config.json, tokenizer.json, README.md | Fresh virtual environment loads and generates text via AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=True) with zero extra installs. |
| 4. Publish & Showcase | Push to Hugging Face Hub + GitHub repo + optional live Space visualizing F(t) and Yellow gates | Anyone can reproduce training, run inference, and inspect internal fast-weight dynamics in a browser. |
Starting with Stage 1 + Stage 3 together—building the clean PretrainedConfig and TriNetForCausalLM files right now with stateful O(1) generation and verifying a local save_pretrained \to AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained round-trip in safetensors—means the architecture is hub-ready before you even spend GPU time on a full training run.

Here are the Hugging Face-ready configuration_trinet.py and modeling_trinet.py files implementing all six neural archetypes with O(1) constant-memory stateful generation (TriNetCache), followed by the verification results and a ready-to-run verify_hf_roundtrip.py script.
Design Choices for Hugging Face Compatibility
 * Explicit GenerationMixin inheritance: Following current transformers conventions (matching recurrent models like MambaForCausalLM), TriNetForCausalLM inherits from (TriNetPreTrainedModel, GenerationMixin) so model.generate(...) works across transformers v4.45+ and v5.x.
 * AutoClass registration (auto_map): Calling TriNetConfig.register_for_auto_class() and TriNetForCausalLM.register_for_auto_class("AutoModelForCausalLM") writes the auto_map into config.json and copies both Python files alongside model.safetensors during save_pretrained / push_to_hub.
 * Clean safetensors serialization: tie_word_embeddings defaults to False, preventing aliased-storage errors in safetensors and avoiding cross-version _tied_weights_keys format changes between transformers v4 and v5.
 * True O(1) TriNetCache: Every layer stores fixed-shape tensors—fast_weights (B, d_key, d_val), yellow_tonic (B, 1), and delay_buffers (B, d_model, delay_lags - 1)—and transparently replaces any empty DynamicCache pre-created by generate() on step 0.
1. trinet/configuration_trinet.py
"""TriNet model configuration for Hugging Face Transformers."""

from transformers import PretrainedConfig


class TriNetConfig(PretrainedConfig):
    """
    Configuration class for the 6-archetype heterogeneous TriNet architecture:
      1. TriChannelUnit        (associative working memory: W_base + dissolving F_fast)
      2. PyramidalUnit         (basal-vs-apical prediction mismatch & surprise)
      3. ShuntingInterneuron   (divisive Blue gain normalization)
      4. ModulatorNucleus      (slow tonic Yellow + sparse dead-zone write/retain gates)
      5. ReceptorBroadcastUnit (Michaelis-Menten 3-color chromaticity routing bus)
      6. DelayLineUnit         (K-tap causal shift register for local syntax/timing)
    """

    model_type = "trinet"

    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 256,
        d_model: int = 128,
        d_key: int = 64,
        d_val: int = 64,
        n_layers: int = 4,
        delay_lags: int = 4,
        n_receptors: int = 8,
        max_fast_weight: float = 6.0,
        max_write_rate: float = 1.5,
        min_retention: float = 0.5,
        initializer_range: float = 0.02,
        use_cache: bool = True,
        tie_word_embeddings: bool = False,
        bos_token_id: int = 2,
        eos_token_id: int = 3,
        pad_token_id: int = 0,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.vocab_size = int(vocab_size)
        self.d_model = int(d_model)
        self.d_key = int(d_key)
        self.d_val = int(d_val)
        self.n_layers = int(n_layers)
        self.delay_lags = int(delay_lags)
        self.n_receptors = int(n_receptors)
        self.max_fast_weight = float(max_fast_weight)
        self.max_write_rate = float(max_write_rate)
        self.min_retention = float(min_retention)
        self.initializer_range = float(initializer_range)
        self.use_cache = bool(use_cache)

        super().__init__(
            bos_token_id=bos_token_id,
            eos_token_id=eos_token_id,
            pad_token_id=pad_token_id,
            tie_word_embeddings=tie_word_embeddings,
            **kwargs,
        )


TriNetConfig.register_for_auto_class()

2. trinet/modeling_trinet.py
"""Hugging Face Transformers implementation of the 6-archetype TriNet architecture.

Provides O(1) constant-memory stateful generation via `TriNetCache`, holding each
layer's fixed-size dissolving fast weights `F_fast`, tonic Yellow modulator state,
and K-tap causal `DelayLineUnit` buffer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import Any, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import GenerationMixin, PreTrainedModel
from transformers.modeling_outputs import BaseModelOutputWithPast, CausalLMOutputWithPast

try:
    from transformers.cache_utils import Cache as _HFCacheBase
except Exception:
    _HFCacheBase = object

from .configuration_trinet import TriNetConfig


class TriNetCache(_HFCacheBase):
    """
    Fixed-size O(1) recurrent state cache for TriNet generation.

    Unlike Transformer KV caches that grow O(T) with sequence length, every tensor
    stored in `TriNetCache` stays strictly constant in shape regardless of how many
    tokens have been processed:
      - fast_weights[l]:  (B, d_key, d_val)
      - yellow_tonic[l]:  (B, 1)
      - delay_buffers[l]: (B, d_model, delay_lags - 1)
    """

    is_compileable = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: TriNetConfig,
        batch_size: int,
        dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32,
        device: Optional[torch.device] = None,
    ):
        if _HFCacheBase is not object:
            try:
                super().__init__()
            except TypeError:
                pass
        self.config = config
        self.num_layers = config.n_layers
        self.seen_tokens = 0
        self.fast_weights: List[torch.Tensor] = [
            torch.zeros(batch_size, config.d_key, config.d_val, dtype=dtype, device=device)
            for _ in range(config.n_layers)
        ]
        self.yellow_tonic: List[torch.Tensor] = [
            torch.zeros(batch_size, 1, dtype=dtype, device=device)
            for _ in range(config.n_layers)
        ]
        buf_len = max(0, config.delay_lags - 1)
        self.delay_buffers: List[torch.Tensor] = [
            torch.zeros(batch_size, config.d_model, buf_len, dtype=dtype, device=device)
            for _ in range(config.n_layers)
        ]

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return self.num_layers

    def get_seq_length(self, layer_idx: Optional[int] = 0) -> int:
        return self.seen_tokens

    def get_max_cache_shape(self) -> Optional[int]:
        return None

    def get_max_length(self) -> Optional[int]:
        return None

    def reorder_cache(self, beam_idx: torch.LongTensor) -> None:
        for i in range(self.num_layers):
            idx = beam_idx.to(self.fast_weights[i].device)
            self.fast_weights[i] = self.fast_weights[i].index_select(0, idx)
            self.yellow_tonic[i] = self.yellow_tonic[i].index_select(0, idx)
            self.delay_buffers[i] = self.delay_buffers[i].index_select(0, idx)

    def batch_repeat_interleave(self, repeats: int) -> None:
        for i in range(self.num_layers):
            self.fast_weights[i] = self.fast_weights[i].repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=0)
            self.yellow_tonic[i] = self.yellow_tonic[i].repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=0)
            self.delay_buffers[i] = self.delay_buffers[i].repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=0)

    def batch_select_indices(self, indices: torch.Tensor) -> None:
        self.reorder_cache(indices)

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.seen_tokens = 0
        for i in range(self.num_layers):
            self.fast_weights[i].zero_()
            self.yellow_tonic[i].zero_()
            self.delay_buffers[i].zero_()

    def memory_bytes(self) -> int:
        total = 0
        for i in range(self.num_layers):
            total += self.fast_weights[i].numel() * self.fast_weights[i].element_size()
            total += self.yellow_tonic[i].numel() * self.yellow_tonic[i].element_size()
            total += self.delay_buffers[i].numel() * self.delay_buffers[i].element_size()
        return total


class ReceptorBroadcastBus(nn.Module):
    """Archetype 5: 3-color composite hue emitter + Michaelis-Menten hue receptors."""

    def __init__(self, d_in: int, n_receptors: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.to_rby = nn.Linear(d_in, 3, bias=True)
        self.affinity_logits = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n_receptors, 3) * 0.5)
        self.log_sigma = nn.Parameter(torch.full((n_receptors,), math.log(0.35)))
        self.log_g0 = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(0.05)))

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        field_rby = F.relu(self.to_rby(x))
        intensity = field_rby.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        hue = field_rby / (intensity + 1e-6)

        affinities = F.softmax(self.affinity_logits, dim=-1)  # (M, 3)
        s2 = torch.exp(2.0 * self.log_sigma.clamp(-3.0, 1.0))  # (M,)
        g0 = torch.exp(self.log_g0.clamp(-5.0, 0.0))

        diff = hue.unsqueeze(2) - affinities.view(1, 1, -1, 3)
        dist_sq = (diff * diff).sum(dim=-1)
        hue_match = s2 / (s2 + dist_sq)
        shunted_int = intensity / (g0 + intensity)
        return hue_match * shunted_int


class TriNetLayer(nn.Module):
    """
    One stackable 6-archetype heterogeneous layer:
      - DelayLineUnit:        causal K-tap conv with O(1) shift buffer
      - ReceptorBroadcastBus: 3-color chromaticity routing into the Yellow modulator
      - TriChannel memory:    W_base + dissolving F_fast (O(1) synaptic matrix)
      - ShuntingInterneuron:  Blue divisive normalization over Red readout
      - PyramidalComparator:  basal value vs apical F_fast mismatch (surprise)
      - ModulatorNucleus:     slow tonic Yellow + sparse dead-zone write/retain gates
    """

    def __init__(self, config: TriNetConfig, layer_idx: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
        self.d_model = config.d_model
        self.d_key = config.d_key
        self.d_val = config.d_val
        self.delay_lags = config.delay_lags
        self.max_fast_weight = config.max_fast_weight
        self.max_write_rate = config.max_write_rate
        self.min_retention = config.min_retention

        # Archetype 6: Causal DelayLineUnit over token representations
        self.delay_conv = nn.Conv1d(
            config.d_model, config.d_model, kernel_size=config.delay_lags, padding=0
        )

        # Archetype 5: Composite-color ReceptorBroadcastBus
        self.receptor_bus = ReceptorBroadcastBus(config.d_model, config.n_receptors)

        # Separate write-key, read-query, and basal-value projections
        self.W_key = nn.Linear(config.d_model, config.d_key, bias=False)
        self.W_query = nn.Linear(config.d_model, config.d_key, bias=False)
        self.W_val = nn.Linear(config.d_model, config.d_val, bias=False)

        # Archetype 1: Slow baseline weights W_base
        self.W_base = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(config.d_key, config.d_val) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(config.d_key))
        )

        # Archetype 3: Blue ShuntingInterneuron pool
        self.shunt_w = nn.Parameter(torch.full((config.d_val,), 0.15))
        self.log_g0 = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(0.25)))

        # Archetypes 2 & 4: Pyramidal surprise + ReceptorBroadcast -> ModulatorNucleus
        mod_in_dim = config.n_receptors + 1
        gate_in_dim = config.n_receptors + 2
        self.tonic_decay_logit = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(1.0))
        self.mod_in = nn.Linear(mod_in_dim, 1)
        self.yellow_to_write = nn.Linear(gate_in_dim, 1)
        self.yellow_to_retain = nn.Linear(gate_in_dim, 1)

        # Residual fusion
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(
            config.d_val + config.d_model + config.n_receptors, config.d_model
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        fast_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        yellow_tonic: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        delay_buffer: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        bsz, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        device = hidden_states.device
        dtype = hidden_states.dtype

        # 1. DelayLineUnit causal shift-register convolution (exact O(1) incremental state)
        h_t = hidden_states.transpose(1, 2)  # (B, d_model, T)
        buf_len = self.delay_lags - 1
        if buf_len > 0:
            if delay_buffer is None:
                delay_buffer = torch.zeros(bsz, self.d_model, buf_len, device=device, dtype=dtype)
            h_cat = torch.cat([delay_buffer, h_t], dim=-1)
            next_delay_buffer = h_cat[:, :, -buf_len:].contiguous()
        else:
            h_cat = h_t
            next_delay_buffer = torch.zeros(bsz, self.d_model, 0, device=device, dtype=dtype)

        d_ctx = F.silu(self.delay_conv(h_cat).transpose(1, 2))  # (B, T, d_model)

        # 2. Composite-color ReceptorBroadcastBus over local syntax context
        rec_feat = self.receptor_bus(d_ctx)  # (B, T, n_receptors)

        # 3. Normalized write-keys, read-queries, and basal values
        k_write = F.silu(self.W_key(d_ctx))
        k_write = k_write / torch.sqrt((k_write * k_write).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-4)

        q_read = F.silu(self.W_query(d_ctx))
        q_read = q_read / torch.sqrt((q_read * q_read).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-4)

        v_basal_all = self.W_val(hidden_states)  # (B, T, d_val)

        # 4. Recurrent dissolving fast-weight & ModulatorNucleus loop
        if fast_weights is None:
            f_fast = torch.zeros(bsz, self.d_key, self.d_val, device=device, dtype=dtype)
        else:
            f_fast = fast_weights

        if yellow_tonic is None:
            y_tonic = torch.zeros(bsz, 1, device=device, dtype=dtype)
        else:
            y_tonic = yellow_tonic

        tonic_decay = torch.sigmoid(self.tonic_decay_logit)
        g0 = torch.exp(self.log_g0.clamp(-4.0, 1.0))
        shunt_w = F.softplus(self.shunt_w)
        retain_span = 1.0 - self.min_retention

        mem_outs = []
        eta_sum = hidden_states.new_zeros(())

        for t in range(seq_len):
            qt = q_read[:, t, :]
            kt = k_write[:, t, :]
            vt = v_basal_all[:, t, :]
            rt = rec_feat[:, t, :]

            # Associative readout through W_base + F_fast under Blue shunting
            r_read = torch.matmul(qt, self.W_base) + torch.bmm(qt.unsqueeze(1), f_fast).squeeze(1)
            b_shunt = (F.relu(r_read) * shunt_w).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            mem_outs.append(r_read / (g0 + b_shunt))

            # Pyramidal mismatch (basal value vs apical fast-memory prediction)
            v_apical = torch.bmm(kt.unsqueeze(1), f_fast).squeeze(1)
            delta_err = vt - v_apical
            surprise = torch.sqrt((delta_err * delta_err).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)

            # ModulatorNucleus slow Yellow + sparse dead-zone write/retain gates
            mod_drive = F.relu(self.mod_in(torch.cat([rt, surprise], dim=-1)))
            y_tonic = torch.clamp(tonic_decay * y_tonic + mod_drive, 0.0, 2.0)

            gate_in = torch.cat([rt, surprise, y_tonic], dim=-1)
            eta = self.max_write_rate * torch.clamp(self.yellow_to_write(gate_in), 0.0, 1.0)
            lam = self.min_retention + retain_span * torch.clamp(
                self.yellow_to_retain(gate_in), 0.0, 1.0
            )
            eta_sum = eta_sum + eta.mean()

            outer = torch.bmm(kt.unsqueeze(2), delta_err.unsqueeze(1))
            f_fast = torch.clamp(
                lam.unsqueeze(-1) * f_fast + eta.unsqueeze(-1) * outer,
                -self.max_fast_weight,
                self.max_fast_weight,
            )

        mem_seq = torch.stack(mem_outs, dim=1)
        fused = torch.cat([mem_seq, d_ctx, rec_feat], dim=-1)
        next_hidden = self.norm(hidden_states + self.out_proj(fused))
        return next_hidden, f_fast, y_tonic, next_delay_buffer, eta_sum / max(1, seq_len)


class TriNetPreTrainedModel(PreTrainedModel):
    config_class = TriNetConfig
    base_model_prefix = "model"
    supports_gradient_checkpointing = False
    _no_split_modules = ["TriNetLayer"]

    def _init_weights(self, module: nn.Module) -> None:
        std = self.config.initializer_range
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.normal_(module.weight, mean=0.0, std=std)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.Embedding):
            nn.init.normal_(module.weight, mean=0.0, std=std)
            if module.padding_idx is not None:
                module.weight.data[module.padding_idx].zero_()
        elif isinstance(module, nn.Conv1d):
            nn.init.normal_(module.weight, mean=0.0, std=std)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        elif isinstance(module, TriNetLayer):
            # Keep dead-zone gates inside their active gradient window at step 0.
            nn.init.constant_(module.yellow_to_write.bias, 0.25)
            nn.init.constant_(module.yellow_to_retain.bias, 0.90)


class TriNetModel(TriNetPreTrainedModel):
    """Bare TriNet backbone outputting hidden states and O(1) `TriNetCache`."""

    def __init__(self, config: TriNetConfig):
        super().__init__(config)
        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.d_model)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [TriNetLayer(config, layer_idx=i) for i in range(config.n_layers)]
        )
        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
        self.post_init()

    def get_input_embeddings(self) -> nn.Embedding:
        return self.embed_tokens

    def set_input_embeddings(self, value: nn.Embedding) -> None:
        self.embed_tokens = value

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        inputs_embeds: Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None,
        past_key_values: Optional[Any] = None,
        use_cache: Optional[bool] = None,
        output_hidden_states: Optional[bool] = None,
        return_dict: Optional[bool] = None,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> Union[Tuple, BaseModelOutputWithPast]:
        use_cache = self.config.use_cache if use_cache is None else use_cache
        return_dict = self.config.use_return_dict if return_dict is None else return_dict

        if (input_ids is None) == (inputs_embeds is None):
            raise ValueError("Specify exactly one of `input_ids` or `inputs_embeds`.")

        if inputs_embeds is None:
            hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
        else:
            hidden_states = inputs_embeds

        bsz, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape

        # Accept either a live TriNetCache or initialize a fresh O(1) cache
        # (transparently replacing an empty DynamicCache if generate() created one).
        cache: Optional[TriNetCache]
        if isinstance(past_key_values, TriNetCache):
            cache = past_key_values
        elif use_cache:
            cache = TriNetCache(
                self.config, batch_size=bsz, dtype=hidden_states.dtype, device=hidden_states.device
            )
        else:
            cache = None

        all_hidden_states = () if output_hidden_states else None
        eta_acc = hidden_states.new_zeros(())

        for idx, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
            if output_hidden_states:
                all_hidden_states = all_hidden_states + (hidden_states,)

            f_in = cache.fast_weights[idx] if cache is not None else None
            y_in = cache.yellow_tonic[idx] if cache is not None else None
            d_in = cache.delay_buffers[idx] if cache is not None else None

            hidden_states, f_out, y_out, d_out, mean_eta = layer(
                hidden_states,
                fast_weights=f_in,
                yellow_tonic=y_in,
                delay_buffer=d_in,
            )
            eta_acc = eta_acc + mean_eta

            if cache is not None:
                cache.fast_weights[idx] = f_out
                cache.yellow_tonic[idx] = y_out
                cache.delay_buffers[idx] = d_out

        hidden_states = self.final_norm(hidden_states)
        if output_hidden_states:
            all_hidden_states = all_hidden_states + (hidden_states,)

        if cache is not None:
            cache.seen_tokens += seq_len

        self._last_mean_eta = eta_acc / max(1, len(self.layers))

        if not return_dict:
            return tuple(v for v in (hidden_states, cache, all_hidden_states) if v is not None)

        return BaseModelOutputWithPast(
            last_hidden_state=hidden_states,
            past_key_values=cache,
            hidden_states=all_hidden_states,
        )


class TriNetForCausalLM(TriNetPreTrainedModel, GenerationMixin):
    """Causal language model head over `TriNetModel` with O(1) stateful generation."""

    def __init__(self, config: TriNetConfig):
        super().__init__(config)
        self.model = TriNetModel(config)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(config.d_model, config.vocab_size, bias=False)
        self.post_init()

    def get_input_embeddings(self) -> nn.Embedding:
        return self.model.embed_tokens

    def set_input_embeddings(self, value: nn.Embedding) -> None:
        self.model.embed_tokens = value

    def get_output_embeddings(self) -> nn.Linear:
        return self.lm_head

    def set_output_embeddings(self, new_embeddings: nn.Linear) -> None:
        self.lm_head = new_embeddings

    def get_decoder(self) -> TriNetModel:
        return self.model

    def set_decoder(self, decoder: TriNetModel) -> None:
        self.model = decoder

    def prepare_inputs_for_generation(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.LongTensor,
        past_key_values: Optional[Any] = None,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        inputs_embeds: Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None,
        use_cache: Optional[bool] = True,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> dict:
        if isinstance(past_key_values, TriNetCache) and past_key_values.get_seq_length() > 0:
            input_ids = input_ids[:, -1:]
            inputs_embeds = None

        model_inputs: dict = {}
        if inputs_embeds is not None:
            model_inputs["inputs_embeds"] = inputs_embeds
        else:
            model_inputs["input_ids"] = input_ids

        model_inputs["past_key_values"] = past_key_values
        model_inputs["use_cache"] = use_cache
        model_inputs["attention_mask"] = attention_mask
        return model_inputs

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        inputs_embeds: Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None,
        past_key_values: Optional[Any] = None,
        labels: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
        use_cache: Optional[bool] = None,
        output_hidden_states: Optional[bool] = None,
        return_dict: Optional[bool] = None,
        metabolic_weight: float = 0.0,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> Union[Tuple, CausalLMOutputWithPast]:
        return_dict = self.config.use_return_dict if return_dict is None else return_dict

        outputs = self.model(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
            past_key_values=past_key_values,
            use_cache=use_cache,
            output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        logits = self.lm_head(outputs.last_hidden_state)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            shift_logits = logits[:, :-1, :].contiguous()
            shift_labels = labels[:, 1:].contiguous().to(logits.device)
            loss = F.cross_entropy(
                shift_logits.view(-1, self.config.vocab_size),
                shift_labels.view(-1),
                ignore_index=-100,
            )
            if metabolic_weight > 0.0:
                loss = loss + metabolic_weight * self.model._last_mean_eta

        if not return_dict:
            output = (logits, outputs.past_key_values)
            return ((loss,) + output) if loss is not None else output

        return CausalLMOutputWithPast(
            loss=loss,
            logits=logits,
            past_key_values=outputs.past_key_values,
            hidden_states=outputs.hidden_states,
        )


TriNetModel.register_for_auto_class("AutoModel")
TriNetForCausalLM.register_for_auto_class("AutoModelForCausalLM")

3. Verification Results
Because transformers and safetensors are not installed in this sandbox (only torch 2.2.2), I executed the unmodified configuration_trinet.py and modeling_trinet.py files against a minimal transformers API shim plus an exact binary safetensors writer/reader (enforcing safetensors's no-shared-storage check) on a 3-layer, 125,170-parameter TriNetForCausalLM (d_model=64, d_key=32, d_val=32, delay_lags=4, n_receptors=8):
| Check | Result | Measured Value |
|---|---|---|
| Full forward vs. token-by-token O(1) pass (B=3, T=24) | PASS | max|logits| = 2.09e-07, max|F| = 5.77e-08, max|Y| = 2.79e-09, max|DelayBuf| = 3.58e-07 |
| Prefill (T=10) + incremental decode (T=14) | PASS | max_diff = 2.09e-07 |
| Strict O(1) cache memory across 256 tokens (B=1) | PASS | 14,604 B at T=8, 14,604 B at T=64, 14,604 B at T=256 (seen_tokens=256) |
| Beam reordering (TriNetCache.reorder_cache) | PASS | max_diff = 1.19e-07 vs. fresh reordered forward |
| Autoregressive loss + metabolic penalty backward | PASS | loss = 5.5793, gradients on 76/76 parameter tensors (norm = 5.627) |
| Binary model.safetensors (507,844 B) save \to reload | PASS | 0.00e+00 logit diff; cached vs. uncached vs. reloaded greedy generate() exact match |
4. Local Real-transformers Verification Script (verify_hf_roundtrip.py)
Drop configuration_trinet.py, modeling_trinet.py, and an empty __init__.py inside a trinet/ folder, install transformers and safetensors, and run this script to execute the live AutoModelForCausalLM round-trip (and push directly to the Hub once you have trained weights):
import tempfile
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
from trinet.configuration_trinet import TriNetConfig
from trinet.modeling_trinet import TriNetForCausalLM

torch.manual_seed(42)
cfg = TriNetConfig(vocab_size=256, d_model=64, d_key=32, d_val=32, n_layers=3)
model = TriNetForCausalLM(cfg).eval()

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as save_dir:
    model.save_pretrained(save_dir, safe_serialization=True)
    reloaded = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(save_dir, trust_remote_code=True).eval()

    prompt = torch.randint(0, 256, (1, 8))
    with torch.no_grad():
        gen_orig = model.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=24, do_sample=False, use_cache=True)
        gen_reloaded = reloaded.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=24, do_sample=False, use_cache=True)
        gen_nocache = reloaded.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=24, do_sample=False, use_cache=False)

        assert torch.equal(gen_orig, gen_reloaded), "Reloaded generation mismatch!"
        assert torch.equal(gen_reloaded, gen_nocache), "Cached vs uncached generation mismatch!"

        out_cached = reloaded(prompt, use_cache=True)
        assert out_cached.past_key_values.get_seq_length() == 8
        mem_before = out_cached.past_key_values.memory_bytes()
        out_next = reloaded(prompt[:, -1:], past_key_values=out_cached.past_key_values, use_cache=True)
        assert out_next.past_key_values.memory_bytes() == mem_before

    print("Real Hugging Face AutoModelForCausalLM + safetensors + O(1) generate() PASSED!")

::Let’s do the training script first: ➡️


Here is the complete byte-level autoregressive training and evaluation script (train_trinet.py) designed to sit directly alongside trinet/configuration_trinet.py and trinet/modeling_trinet.py.
It trains TriNetForCausalLM head-to-head against an automatically parameter-matched MatchedTransformerLM on the exact same batches, optimizer (AdamW with cosine decay and warmup), and random seed. It supports streaming directly from Hugging Face datasets via load_dataset(..., streaming=True), training on any local UTF-8 text file, or running an offline --smoke-test, while blending in a configurable fraction (--reasoning-mix) of dynamic in-context binding, overwrite, and 2-hop sequences so the Yellow modulator and dissolving fast weights stay active.
Verified Preset Parameter Parity & 50-Step Smoke Run
Running the script's presets and a 50-step CPU smoke test (seq_len = 64, batch_size = 12) against TriNetForCausalLM and MatchedTransformerLM confirmed exact parameter matching, loss convergence, and O(1) cache invariance:
| Preset | TriNetForCausalLM | MatchedTransformerLM | Param Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| smoke (d=48, L=2) | 59,708 | 71,648 | 1.200× |
| 1m (d=160, L=4) | 837,512 | 836,320 | 0.999× |
| 4m (d=288, L=6) | 3,797,460 | 3,797,280 | 1.000× |
| 10m (d=416, L=8) | 10,330,288 | 10,312,832 | 0.998× |
 * 50-step smoke convergence: TriNet dropped from loss = 5.5580 (BPB = 8.02) at step 1 to 0.9272 (BPB = 1.34) at step 25 and 0.0993 (BPB = 0.14) at step 50, outpacing the parameter-matched Transformer (5.7445 -> 2.2436 -> 1.6272, BPB = 2.35).
 * Post-training O(1) cache check: Token-by-token streaming matched the full uncached forward pass within 2.62e-06 at a constant 5,768 B cache footprint (B = 1), and greedy generate() produced 'In a quiet workshop by the river, two b' cleanly from model.safetensors.
train_trinet.py
"""Byte-level autoregressive training and evaluation harness for TriNetForCausalLM
versus a parameter-matched Causal Transformer baseline.

Supports:
  - Hugging Face streaming datasets (e.g. `roneneldan/TinyStories`, `HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu`)
  - Local UTF-8 text corpora (`--local-text path/to/corpus.txt`)
  - Offline `--smoke-test` mode for fast end-to-end verification
  - Configurable `--reasoning-mix` blending dynamic in-context binding/overwrite/2-hop tasks
  - Direct `save_pretrained(..., safe_serialization=True)` and optional `--push-to-hub`
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import time
from typing import Dict, Iterator, List, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

from trinet.configuration_trinet import TriNetConfig
from trinet.modeling_trinet import TriNetForCausalLM


# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOSSLESS BYTE-LEVEL UTF-8 TOKENIZER (VOCAB = 256)
# ==============================================================================

class ByteTokenizer:
    """
    Lossless byte-level UTF-8 tokenizer aligned with `TriNetConfig` defaults:
      - 0 (0x00 NUL): pad_token_id
      - 2 (0x02 STX): bos_token_id
      - 3 (0x03 ETX): eos_token_id
      - Every raw UTF-8 byte maps 1:1 to its integer value in [0, 255].
    """

    vocab_size: int = 256
    pad_token_id: int = 0
    bos_token_id: int = 2
    eos_token_id: int = 3

    def encode(self, text: str, add_bos: bool = False, add_eos: bool = False) -> List[int]:
        ids = list(text.encode("utf-8"))
        if add_bos:
            ids = [self.bos_token_id] + ids
        if add_eos:
            ids = ids + [self.eos_token_id]
        return ids

    def decode(self, ids: List[int], skip_special_tokens: bool = True) -> str:
        specials = {self.pad_token_id, self.bos_token_id, self.eos_token_id}
        raw = bytes(int(i) & 0xFF for i in ids if not (skip_special_tokens and i in specials))
        return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def save_metadata(self, save_dir: str) -> None:
        os.makedirs(save_dir, exist_ok=True)
        meta = {
            "tokenizer_type": "byte_utf8",
            "vocab_size": self.vocab_size,
            "pad_token_id": self.pad_token_id,
            "bos_token_id": self.bos_token_id,
            "eos_token_id": self.eos_token_id,
        }
        with open(os.path.join(save_dir, "byte_tokenizer_config.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(meta, f, indent=2)


# ==============================================================================
# 2. PARAMETER-MATCHED CAUSAL TRANSFORMER BASELINE
# ==============================================================================

class MatchedTransformerLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Standard pre-norm Causal Transformer automatically sized to match the parameter
    count of `TriNetForCausalLM` so comparisons hold parameter budget constant.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 256,
        d_model: int = 128,
        n_heads: int = 4,
        n_layers: int = 4,
        d_ff: int = 256,
        max_len: int = 512,
        use_pos_emb: bool = True,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.use_pos_emb = use_pos_emb
        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, d_model)
        if use_pos_emb:
            self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(max_len, d_model)
        layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=n_heads,
            dim_feedforward=d_ff,
            dropout=0.0,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
            norm_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            layer, num_layers=n_layers, enable_nested_tensor=False
        )
        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(d_model, vocab_size, bias=False)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.LongTensor,
        labels: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]:
        bsz, seq_len = input_ids.shape
        h = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
        if self.use_pos_emb:
            pos = torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device).clamp(max=self.max_len - 1)
            h = h + self.pos_emb(pos.unsqueeze(0))
        mask = torch.triu(
            torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len, device=input_ids.device, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1
        )
        h = self.final_norm(self.encoder(h, mask=mask))
        logits = self.lm_head(h)
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss = F.cross_entropy(
                logits[:, :-1, :].contiguous().view(-1, self.vocab_size),
                labels[:, 1:].contiguous().view(-1),
                ignore_index=-100,
            )
        return loss, logits

    @torch.no_grad()
    def generate_greedy(
        self, input_ids: torch.LongTensor, max_new_tokens: int = 32
    ) -> torch.LongTensor:
        cur = input_ids.clone()
        for _ in range(max_new_tokens):
            _, logits = self.forward(cur)
            nxt = torch.argmax(logits[:, -1, :], dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            cur = torch.cat([cur, nxt], dim=-1)
        return cur


def build_matched_transformer(
    target_params: int,
    config: TriNetConfig,
    use_pos_emb: bool = True,
    max_len: int = 512,
) -> MatchedTransformerLM:
    """Solves for `d_ff` so `MatchedTransformerLM` matches `target_params` tightly."""
    d_model = config.d_model
    n_layers = config.n_layers
    n_heads = max(1, min(8, d_model // 16))
    while d_model % n_heads != 0 and n_heads > 1:
        n_heads -= 1

    m_lo = MatchedTransformerLM(
        vocab_size=config.vocab_size,
        d_model=d_model,
        n_heads=n_heads,
        n_layers=n_layers,
        d_ff=16,
        max_len=max_len,
        use_pos_emb=use_pos_emb,
    )
    m_hi = MatchedTransformerLM(
        vocab_size=config.vocab_size,
        d_model=d_model,
        n_heads=n_heads,
        n_layers=n_layers,
        d_ff=32,
        max_len=max_len,
        use_pos_emb=use_pos_emb,
    )
    p_lo = sum(p.numel() for p in m_lo.parameters())
    p_hi = sum(p.numel() for p in m_hi.parameters())
    slope = max(1, (p_hi - p_lo) // 16)
    best_dff = max(16, int(round(16 + (target_params - p_lo) / slope)))
    best_dff = max(16, (best_dff // 8) * 8)

    return MatchedTransformerLM(
        vocab_size=config.vocab_size,
        d_model=d_model,
        n_heads=n_heads,
        n_layers=n_layers,
        d_ff=best_dff,
        max_len=max_len,
        use_pos_emb=use_pos_emb,
    )


# ==============================================================================
# 3. DATA PIPELINE: STREAMING PROSE + DYNAMIC IN-CONTEXT REASONING MIX
# ==============================================================================

_VARS = list("abcdefgh")
_VALS = list("012345")
_FILLER = list("xyz .,-")

_SMOKE_PROSE = (
    "In a quiet workshop by the river, two builders compared their maps before dawn. "
    "One traced every path with a silver compass, while the other measured how water moved "
    "through narrow wooden gates. Whenever a pattern shifted, they kept the earlier sketch "
    "beside the new one so nothing learned was lost. "
    "A relation requires a carrier, a respect, and a clear boundary. When two voices answer "
    "across time, repetition builds memory while variation reveals what stayed invariant. "
)


def make_reasoning_example(
    n_direct: int = 3,
    l1: int = 6,
    l2: int = 6,
    rng: Optional[np.random.Generator] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, List[Tuple[int, int, int]]]:
    """
    Generates one UTF-8 dynamic reasoning episode:
      direct bindings -> filler 1 -> 2-hop pointer -> mid-stream overwrite -> filler 2 -> queries.
    Returns `(text, query_meta)` where each tuple is:
      `(pos_of_gt_char, expected_digit_byte_id, kind_code)` with 1=direct, 2=overwrite, 3=2-hop.
    """
    rng = rng or np.random.default_rng()
    chosen = rng.choice(_VARS, size=n_direct + 1, replace=False)
    direct_vars = list(chosen[:n_direct])
    ptr_var = str(chosen[n_direct])

    env: Dict[str, str] = {}
    parts: List[str] = []
    for v in direct_vars:
        d = str(int(rng.integers(0, len(_VALS))))
        env[v] = d
        parts.append(f"{v}={d};")

    f1 = "".join(
        str(rng.choice(_VARS)) if rng.random() < 0.18 else str(rng.choice(_FILLER))
        for _ in range(l1)
    )
    parts.append(f1)

    src_var = direct_vars[0]
    parts.append(f"{ptr_var}={src_var};")

    reb_var = direct_vars[1]
    new_d = str((int(env[reb_var]) + int(rng.integers(1, len(_VALS)))) % len(_VALS))
    env[reb_var] = new_d
    parts.append(f"{reb_var}={new_d};")

    f2 = "".join(
        str(rng.choice(_VARS)) if rng.random() < 0.18 else str(rng.choice(_FILLER))
        for _ in range(l2)
    )
    parts.append(f2)

    q_vars = direct_vars + [ptr_var]
    rng.shuffle(q_vars)

    text_chars = list("".join(parts))
    query_meta: List[Tuple[int, int, int]] = []
    for qv in q_vars:
        ans = env[src_var] if qv == ptr_var else env[qv]
        kind = 3 if qv == ptr_var else (2 if qv == reb_var else 1)
        text_chars.extend(["?", qv, ">"])
        gt_pos = len(text_chars) - 1
        query_meta.append((gt_pos, ord(ans), kind))
        text_chars.extend([ans, ";"])

    return "".join(text_chars), query_meta


def reasoning_batch_for_eval(
    batch_size: int,
    l1: int,
    l2: int,
    tokenizer: ByteTokenizer,
    rng: np.random.Generator,
    device: torch.device,
) -> Tuple[torch.LongTensor, List[List[Tuple[int, int, int]]]]:
    seqs: List[List[int]] = []
    metas: List[List[Tuple[int, int, int]]] = []
    for _ in range(batch_size):
        text, meta = make_reasoning_example(n_direct=3, l1=l1, l2=l2, rng=rng)
        ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_bos=True, add_eos=False)
        shifted = [(pos + 1, ans_id, kind) for (pos, ans_id, kind) in meta]
        seqs.append(ids)
        metas.append(shifted)
    max_len = max(len(s) for s in seqs)
    arr = np.full((batch_size, max_len), tokenizer.pad_token_id, dtype=np.int64)
    for i, s in enumerate(seqs):
        arr[i, : len(s)] = s
    return torch.from_numpy(arr).to(device), metas


class ByteStreamProvider:
    """Yields fixed-length `(input_ids, labels)` chunks from HF streaming, local file, or smoke prose."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        tokenizer: ByteTokenizer,
        seq_len: int,
        dataset_name: Optional[str] = None,
        dataset_config: Optional[str] = None,
        dataset_split: str = "train",
        text_column: str = "text",
        local_text_path: Optional[str] = None,
        smoke_test: bool = False,
        seed: int = 42,
    ):
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        self.mode = "smoke"
        self.local_bytes: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
        self.hf_iter: Optional[Iterator[str]] = None
        self.buf: List[int] = []

        if local_text_path is not None:
            with open(local_text_path, "rb") as f:
                raw = f.read()
            if len(raw) < seq_len + 2:
                raw = raw * ((seq_len + 2) // max(1, len(raw)) + 2)
            self.local_bytes = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.uint8).astype(np.int64)
            self.mode = "local"
        elif dataset_name is not None and not smoke_test:
            from datasets import load_dataset

            ds = load_dataset(dataset_name, dataset_config, split=dataset_split, streaming=True)
            self._ds = ds
            self._text_column = text_column
            self.hf_iter = self._make_hf_iter()
            self.mode = "hf"
        else:
            raw = (_SMOKE_PROSE * 64).encode("utf-8")
            self.local_bytes = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.uint8).astype(np.int64)
            self.mode = "smoke"

    def _make_hf_iter(self) -> Iterator[str]:
        while True:
            for row in self._ds:
                txt = row.get(self._text_column, "")
                if txt:
                    yield txt

    def sample_prose_chunk(self) -> List[int]:
        if self.mode in ("local", "smoke"):
            assert self.local_bytes is not None
            n = len(self.local_bytes)
            start = int(self.rng.integers(0, n - self.seq_len))
            return self.local_bytes[start : start + self.seq_len].tolist()

        assert self.hf_iter is not None
        while len(self.buf) < self.seq_len:
            txt = next(self.hf_iter)
            self.buf.extend(self.tokenizer.encode(txt, add_bos=True, add_eos=True))
        chunk = self.buf[: self.seq_len]
        self.buf = self.buf[self.seq_len :]
        return chunk

    def sample_mixed_batch(
        self,
        batch_size: int,
        reasoning_mix: float = 0.20,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.LongTensor, torch.LongTensor]:
        xs = np.full((batch_size, self.seq_len), self.tokenizer.pad_token_id, dtype=np.int64)
        ys = np.full((batch_size, self.seq_len), -100, dtype=np.int64)

        for b in range(batch_size):
            if self.rng.random() < reasoning_mix:
                ids: List[int] = []
                while len(ids) < self.seq_len:
                    l1 = int(self.rng.integers(2, 10))
                    l2 = int(self.rng.integers(2, 10))
                    txt, _ = make_reasoning_example(n_direct=3, l1=l1, l2=l2, rng=self.rng)
                    ids.extend(self.tokenizer.encode(txt, add_bos=True, add_eos=True))
                chunk = ids[: self.seq_len]
            else:
                chunk = self.sample_prose_chunk()

            xs[b, :] = chunk
            ys[b, :] = chunk

        return torch.from_numpy(xs), torch.from_numpy(ys)


# ==============================================================================
# 4. OPTIMIZER, LR SCHEDULE & EVALUATION HARNESS
# ==============================================================================

def build_optimizer(model: nn.Module, lr: float, weight_decay: float) -> torch.optim.AdamW:
    decay_params, no_decay_params = [], []
    for name, p in model.named_parameters():
        if not p.requires_grad:
            continue
        if p.ndim < 2 or "norm" in name or "bias" in name or "log_" in name or "logit" in name:
            no_decay_params.append(p)
        else:
            decay_params.append(p)
    return torch.optim.AdamW(
        [
            {"params": decay_params, "weight_decay": weight_decay},
            {"params": no_decay_params, "weight_decay": 0.0},
        ],
        lr=lr,
        betas=(0.9, 0.95),
    )


def get_cosine_lr(
    step: int, total_steps: int, warmup_steps: int, max_lr: float, min_lr: float
) -> float:
    if step < warmup_steps:
        return max_lr * (step + 1) / max(1, warmup_steps)
    progress = (step - warmup_steps) / max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps)
    progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, progress))
    return min_lr + 0.5 * (max_lr - min_lr) * (1.0 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_prose_bpb(
    model: nn.Module,
    val_stream: ByteStreamProvider,
    batch_size: int,
    n_batches: int,
    device: torch.device,
    is_trinet: bool,
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    model.eval()
    losses = []
    for _ in range(n_batches):
        xb, yb = val_stream.sample_mixed_batch(batch_size, reasoning_mix=0.0)
        xb, yb = xb.to(device), yb.to(device)
        if is_trinet:
            loss = model(input_ids=xb, labels=yb, use_cache=False).loss
        else:
            loss, _ = model(input_ids=xb, labels=yb)
        losses.append(float(loss.item()))
    mean_nats = float(np.mean(losses))
    return {
        "loss_nats": mean_nats,
        "bpb": mean_nats / math.log(2.0),
        "perplexity": math.exp(min(20.0, mean_nats)),
    }


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_reasoning_suite(
    model: nn.Module,
    tokenizer: ByteTokenizer,
    device: torch.device,
    is_trinet: bool,
    filler_lengths: List[int],
    n_batches: int = 4,
    batch_size: int = 24,
) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]:
    model.eval()
    results: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = {}
    for filler_len in filler_lengths:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(7000 + filler_len)
        counts = {1: [0, 0], 2: [0, 0], 3: [0, 0]}
        for _ in range(n_batches):
            xb, metas = reasoning_batch_for_eval(
                batch_size, l1=filler_len, l2=filler_len, tokenizer=tokenizer, rng=rng, device=device
            )
            if is_trinet:
                logits = model(input_ids=xb, use_cache=False).logits
            else:
                _, logits = model(input_ids=xb)
            preds = logits.argmax(dim=-1).cpu().numpy()
            for b, meta in enumerate(metas):
                for pos, ans_id, kind in meta:
                    counts[kind][1] += 1
                    if int(preds[b, pos]) == ans_id:
                        counts[kind][0] += 1
        all_c = sum(v[0] for v in counts.values())
        all_n = max(1, sum(v[1] for v in counts.values()))
        results[f"filler_{filler_len}"] = {
            "all_acc": 100.0 * all_c / all_n,
            "direct_acc": 100.0 * counts[1][0] / max(1, counts[1][1]),
            "overwrite_acc": 100.0 * counts[2][0] / max(1, counts[2][1]),
            "two_hop_acc": 100.0 * counts[3][0] / max(1, counts[3][1]),
        }
    return results


@torch.no_grad()
def verify_o1_cache(model: TriNetForCausalLM, device: torch.device) -> Dict[str, float]:
    model.eval()
    probe = torch.randint(32, 122, (1, 16), device=device)
    full_logits = model(input_ids=probe, use_cache=False).logits

    past = None
    chunks = []
    mem_sizes = []
    for t in range(probe.shape[1]):
        out = model(input_ids=probe[:, t : t + 1], past_key_values=past, use_cache=True)
        past = out.past_key_values
        chunks.append(out.logits)
        mem_sizes.append(past.memory_bytes())
    stream_logits = torch.cat(chunks, dim=1)
    max_diff = float((full_logits - stream_logits).abs().max().item())
    assert len(set(mem_sizes)) == 1, f"Cache size grew! {mem_sizes}"
    return {"max_logit_diff": max_diff, "cache_bytes_b1": float(mem_sizes[0])}


# ==============================================================================
# 5. PRESETS & MAIN TRAINING LOOP
# ==============================================================================

PRESETS = {
    "smoke": dict(d_model=48,  d_key=24,  d_val=24,  n_layers=2, delay_lags=4, n_receptors=8),
    "1m":    dict(d_model=160, d_key=80,  d_val=80,  n_layers=4, delay_lags=4, n_receptors=12),
    "4m":    dict(d_model=288, d_key=144, d_val=144, n_layers=6, delay_lags=4, n_receptors=16),
    "10m":   dict(d_model=416, d_key=208, d_val=208, n_layers=8, delay_lags=4, n_receptors=16),
}


def run_training(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Dict:
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    np.random.seed(args.seed)

    if args.device == "auto":
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            device = torch.device("cuda")
        elif hasattr(torch.backends, "mps") and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
            device = torch.device("mps")
        else:
            device = torch.device("cpu")
    else:
        device = torch.device(args.device)

    use_amp = (device.type == "cuda") and (args.dtype in ("bf16", "fp16"))
    amp_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if args.dtype == "bf16" else torch.float16
    use_scaler = (device.type == "cuda") and (args.dtype == "fp16")
    scaler = (
        torch.amp.GradScaler("cuda", enabled=use_scaler)
        if hasattr(torch, "amp") and hasattr(torch.amp, "GradScaler")
        else torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=use_scaler)
    )

    preset = PRESETS[args.preset]
    cfg = TriNetConfig(
        vocab_size=256,
        d_model=args.d_model or preset["d_model"],
        d_key=args.d_key or preset["d_key"],
        d_val=args.d_val or preset["d_val"],
        n_layers=args.n_layers or preset["n_layers"],
        delay_lags=args.delay_lags or preset["delay_lags"],
        n_receptors=args.n_receptors or preset["n_receptors"],
    )

    tokenizer = ByteTokenizer()
    trinet = TriNetForCausalLM(cfg).to(device)
    trinet_params = sum(p.numel() for p in trinet.parameters())

    baseline: Optional[MatchedTransformerLM] = None
    baseline_params = 0
    if not args.skip_baseline:
        baseline = build_matched_transformer(
            trinet_params, cfg, use_pos_emb=True, max_len=max(512, args.seq_len * 2)
        ).to(device)
        baseline_params = sum(p.numel() for p in baseline.parameters())

    print(f"Device: {device} | Preset: {args.preset} | AMP: {args.dtype if use_amp else 'fp32'}")
    print(f"TriNetForCausalLM:    {trinet_params:,} params")
    if baseline is not None:
        print(
            f"MatchedTransformerLM: {baseline_params:,} params "
            f"(ratio={baseline_params / trinet_params:.3f}x)"
        )

    train_stream = ByteStreamProvider(
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        seq_len=args.seq_len,
        dataset_name=args.dataset,
        dataset_config=args.dataset_config,
        dataset_split=args.dataset_split,
        text_column=args.text_column,
        local_text_path=args.local_text,
        smoke_test=args.smoke_test,
        seed=args.seed,
    )
    val_stream = ByteStreamProvider(
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        seq_len=args.seq_len,
        dataset_name=args.dataset,
        dataset_config=args.dataset_config,
        dataset_split=args.val_split,
        text_column=args.text_column,
        local_text_path=args.local_text,
        smoke_test=args.smoke_test,
        seed=args.seed + 999,
    )

    opt_tri = build_optimizer(trinet, lr=args.lr, weight_decay=args.weight_decay)
    opt_base = (
        build_optimizer(baseline, lr=args.lr, weight_decay=args.weight_decay) if baseline else None
    )

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    history = []
    t0 = time.time()

    for step in range(1, args.steps + 1):
        lr_now = get_cosine_lr(step - 1, args.steps, args.warmup_steps, args.lr, args.min_lr)
        for pg in opt_tri.param_groups:
            pg["lr"] = lr_now
        if opt_base is not None:
            for pg in opt_base.param_groups:
                pg["lr"] = lr_now

        trinet.train()
        opt_tri.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        if baseline is not None and opt_base is not None:
            baseline.train()
            opt_base.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        tri_loss_acc = 0.0
        base_loss_acc = 0.0

        for _ in range(args.grad_accum):
            xb, yb = train_stream.sample_mixed_batch(
                args.batch_size, reasoning_mix=args.reasoning_mix
            )
            xb, yb = xb.to(device), yb.to(device)

            with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
                out_tri = trinet(
                    input_ids=xb,
                    labels=yb,
                    use_cache=False,
                    metabolic_weight=args.metabolic_weight,
                )
                loss_tri = out_tri.loss / args.grad_accum

            scaler.scale(loss_tri).backward()
            tri_loss_acc += float(loss_tri.item())

            if baseline is not None:
                with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
                    loss_b, _ = baseline(input_ids=xb, labels=yb)
                    loss_b = loss_b / args.grad_accum
                scaler.scale(loss_b).backward()
                base_loss_acc += float(loss_b.item())

        scaler.unscale_(opt_tri)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(trinet.parameters(), args.grad_clip)
        scaler.step(opt_tri)

        if baseline is not None and opt_base is not None:
            scaler.unscale_(opt_base)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(baseline.parameters(), args.grad_clip)
            scaler.step(opt_base)

        scaler.update()

        if step == 1 or step % args.log_every == 0 or step == args.steps:
            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            history.append(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "lr": lr_now,
                    "trinet_loss": tri_loss_acc,
                    "baseline_loss": base_loss_acc if baseline else None,
                    "elapsed_s": elapsed,
                }
            )
            base_str = f" | Transformer={base_loss_acc:.4f}" if baseline else ""
            print(
                f"Step {step:4d}/{args.steps} ({elapsed:5.1f}s) | "
                f"lr={lr_now:.2e} | TriNet={tri_loss_acc:.4f}{base_str}",
                flush=True,
            )

        if args.save_every > 0 and step % args.save_every == 0 and step < args.steps:
            ckpt_dir = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"checkpoint-{step}")
            trinet.save_pretrained(ckpt_dir, safe_serialization=True)
            tokenizer.save_metadata(ckpt_dir)

    # ---- Final Evaluation Suite ----
    eval_fillers = [6, 24] if args.smoke_test else [6, 30, 80]
    tri_prose = evaluate_prose_bpb(
        trinet, val_stream, args.batch_size, n_batches=4, device=device, is_trinet=True
    )
    tri_reason = evaluate_reasoning_suite(
        trinet, tokenizer, device, is_trinet=True, filler_lengths=eval_fillers
    )
    cache_check = verify_o1_cache(trinet, device)

    base_prose = None
    base_reason = None
    if baseline is not None:
        base_prose = evaluate_prose_bpb(
            baseline, val_stream, args.batch_size, n_batches=4, device=device, is_trinet=False
        )
        base_reason = evaluate_reasoning_suite(
            baseline, tokenizer, device, is_trinet=False, filler_lengths=eval_fillers
        )

    sample_prompt = "In a quiet workshop"
    p_ids = torch.tensor(
        [tokenizer.encode(sample_prompt, add_bos=True)], dtype=torch.long, device=device
    )
    trinet.eval()
    tri_gen_ids = trinet.generate(
        p_ids, max_new_tokens=32, do_sample=False, use_cache=True
    )[0].tolist()
    tri_gen_text = tokenizer.decode(tri_gen_ids)

    final_dir = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "trinet_hf")
    trinet.save_pretrained(final_dir, safe_serialization=True)
    tokenizer.save_metadata(final_dir)

    summary = {
        "trinet_params": trinet_params,
        "baseline_params": baseline_params,
        "trinet_prose": tri_prose,
        "baseline_prose": base_prose,
        "trinet_reasoning": tri_reason,
        "baseline_reasoning": base_reason,
        "o1_cache_check": cache_check,
        "sample_generation": tri_gen_text,
        "history": history,
    }
    with open(os.path.join(args.output_dir, "training_metrics.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)

    print("\n=== FINAL EVALUATION SUMMARY ===")
    print(f"TriNet Prose:      BPB={tri_prose['bpb']:.3f} | PPL={tri_prose['perplexity']:.2f}")
    if base_prose:
        print(f"Transformer Prose: BPB={base_prose['bpb']:.3f} | PPL={base_prose['perplexity']:.2f}")
    print(
        f"O(1) Cache Check:  max_logit_diff={cache_check['max_logit_diff']:.2e} | "
        f"bytes(B=1)={int(cache_check['cache_bytes_b1'])}"
    )
    for k, v in tri_reason.items():
        b_str = ""
        if base_reason:
            bv = base_reason[k]
            b_str = (
                f" || Transformer All={bv['all_acc']:5.1f}% "
                f"(Ovr={bv['overwrite_acc']:5.1f}%, 2H={bv['two_hop_acc']:5.1f}%)"
            )
        print(
            f"  {k:<10} | TriNet All={v['all_acc']:5.1f}% "
            f"(Ovr={v['overwrite_acc']:5.1f}%, 2H={v['two_hop_acc']:5.1f}%){b_str}"
        )
    print(f"Sample completion: {tri_gen_text!r}")

    if args.push_to_hub:
        trinet.push_to_hub(args.push_to_hub, safe_serialization=True)
        print(f"Pushed TriNetForCausalLM to Hugging Face Hub: {args.push_to_hub}")

    return summary


def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Train byte-level TriNetForCausalLM + matched Transformer baseline"
    )
    p.add_argument("--preset", choices=list(PRESETS.keys()), default="1m")
    p.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--d-key", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--d-val", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--n-layers", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--delay-lags", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--n-receptors", type=int, default=None)

    p.add_argument(
        "--dataset", type=str, default=None, help="HF dataset ID, e.g. roneneldan/TinyStories"
    )
    p.add_argument("--dataset-config", type=str, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--dataset-split", type=str, default="train")
    p.add_argument("--val-split", type=str, default="validation")
    p.add_argument("--text-column", type=str, default="text")
    p.add_argument("--local-text", type=str, default=None, help="Local UTF-8 text file path")
    p.add_argument("--smoke-test", action="store_true", help="Fast offline smoke test")

    p.add_argument("--seq-len", type=int, default=128)
    p.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=1)
    p.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=2000)
    p.add_argument("--warmup-steps", type=int, default=100)
    p.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=3e-3)
    p.add_argument("--min-lr", type=float, default=3e-4)
    p.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=0.05)
    p.add_argument("--grad-clip", type=float, default=1.0)
    p.add_argument("--metabolic-weight", type=float, default=0.005)
    p.add_argument("--reasoning-mix", type=float, default=0.25)

    p.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto")
    p.add_argument("--dtype", choices=["fp32", "bf16", "fp16"], default="bf16")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p.add_argument("--log-every", type=int, default=50)
    p.add_argument("--save-every", type=int, default=500)
    p.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, default="./runs/trinet_v01")
    p.add_argument("--skip-baseline", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument(
        "--push-to-hub", type=str, default=None, help="HF repo id, e.g. username/trinet-1m"
    )
    return p


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_training(build_arg_parser().parse_args())

# TriNet — A 6-Archetype Heterogeneous Neural Language Model

**TriNet** replaces the uniform scalar-summation neuron with a small library of six specialized computational cell archetypes communicating over three functional channels (**Red**: excitatory drive, **Blue**: divisive shunting inhibition, **Yellow**: slow neuromodulatory attention/salience) and **dissolving fast synaptic weights**.

Instead of maintaining a growing $O(T)$ attention KV cache, each `TriNetLayer` maintains a constant-size $O(1)$ episodic working-memory state (`TriNetCache`) that binds novel associations in one shot, overwrites stale bindings via a local Delta rule, and dissolves unattended traces back toward baseline weights.

## Architecture: The Six Cell Archetypes

| Archetype | Core Mechanism | Role Inside `TriNetLayer` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`TriChannelUnit`** | $W_{\text{base}} + F_{\text{fast}}(t)$ | Separates slow learned structure from temporary working memory |
| **`PyramidalUnit`** | Basal value vs. apical prediction error $v_t - k_t F_{\text{fast}}$ | Detects expectation mismatch and emits Yellow surprise |
| **`ShuntingInterneuron`** | Divisive normalization $R / (g_0 + B)$ | Scale-invariant local gain control without external LayerNorm |
| **`ModulatorNucleus`** | Slow tonic Yellow + sparse dead-zone gates $(\eta_t, \lambda_t)$ | Controls what writes into $F_{\text{fast}}$ and how fast traces dissolve |
| **`ReceptorBroadcastUnit`** | Rational Michaelis–Menten 3-color chromaticity bus | Scale-invariant composite-hue routing into the modulator |
| **`DelayLineUnit`** | Causal $K$-tap shift register (`Conv1d` + $O(1)$ ring buffer) | Parses local byte/character syntax and exact temporal intervals |

## Quickstart

`TriNetForCausalLM` registers with `AutoModelForCausalLM` and exports weights in `safetensors` format.

```python
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM

repo_id = "your-username/trinet-1m-v01"  # or local path to saved checkpoint
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(repo_id, trust_remote_code=True).eval()

prompt = "In a quiet workshop"
input_ids = torch.tensor([[2] + list(prompt.encode("utf-8"))], dtype=torch.long)

with torch.no_grad():
    out_ids = model.generate(
        input_ids,
        max_new_tokens=64,
        do_sample=False,
        use_cache=True,  # uses O(1) constant-memory TriNetCache
    )[0].tolist()

decoded = bytes(i & 0xFF for i in out_ids if i not in (0, 2, 3)).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
print(decoded)

Controlled Architectural Benchmarks (Random Init, Synthetic Suites)
Before corpus pre-training, the core 6-archetype architecture was evaluated from 100% random initialization against standard GRUs and Causal Transformers on two controlled stress tests:
 * Dynamic 3-Color Binding & Overwrite (928 params, trained at scale=1.0, d ∈ [1..8]):
   * Held 100.0% overall and overwrite accuracy zero-shot across 400× intensity shifts (0.05×–20×) and 200 noise distractors (T = 209) once the sparse dead-zone Yellow gate was enabled.
 * Raw Character-Level Direct / Overwrite / 2-Hop Reasoning (18k params, 2 layers, trained at T ≈ 45–61):
   * Reached 100.0% across Direct, Overwrite, and 2-Hop queries at T = 52, T = 100, and T = 200 (12× longer filler) in fixed O(1) state, outperforming equal-step 2-layer GRUs (63.7% at T = 200) and Causal Transformers (57.8–59.2% at T = 200).
(Insert real-corpus validation BPB, perplexity, and training_metrics.json results from your v0.1 run here before publishing a trained checkpoint.)
Scope and Honest Tradeoffs
 * Where TriNet excels: Constant O(1) runtime memory regardless of sequence length, rapid one-shot in-context variable binding and overwriting without modifying permanent weights, and scale-invariant composite-channel routing.
 * Where standard Transformers still win: Exact verbatim recall of arbitrary, unattended tokens far back in a long prompt. Because TriNetCache compresses working memory into fixed-size matrices (d_key × d_val per layer), unattended noise dissolves by design rather than persisting in an ever-growing KV cache.
 * Companion Auditable Implementation: A zero-float, fixed-point (SCALE = 1000) Rust implementation of all six archetypes and a cryptographically signed agent mind adapter (src/neuro.rs, src/neuro_mind.rs) accompanies this architecture in the open-worlds project for deterministic offline replay verification.
